samples.hypothesis: The confidence level in the table should be indicated with a label rather than just a bare number.

samples.source: 一个功能未覆盖全部平台时要显式标注范围。
samples.reference: Mark scope when a feature is not present on every platform.
samples.hypothesis: When a feature is not available on all platforms, the scope should be explicitly indicated.

samples.source: 界面要能隐藏内部术语列，给非技术用户简化视图。
samples.reference: Offer a simplified view that hides internal columns.
samples.hypothesis: The interface should be able to hide internal term columns to simplify the view for non-technical users.

samples.source: 操作耗时较长要给出预期时长而不是转圈。
samples.reference: Estimate expected duration for slow operations rather than spinning.
samples.hypothesis: The operation takes a long time, and an expected duration should be provided instead of circularity.

samples.source: 提示里的示例路径要用占位符而不是真实目录。
samples.reference: Use placeholders in example paths, never a real directory.
samples.hypothesis: The example path in the prompt should use placeholders instead of the actual directory.

samples.source: 一次操作的结果要能被再次读取以确认。
samples.reference: Make an operation's effect readable back for confirmation.
samples.hypothesis: The result of a operation should be readable again for confirmation.

samples.source: 界面元素的禁用状态要与原因并列出现。
samples.reference: Show a disabled control together with its reason.
samples.hypothesis: The disabled status of interface elements should appear alongside the reason.

samples.source: 一个批次的失败行要能在界面里筛出。
samples.reference: Let a UI filter show only the failed rows of a batch.
samples.hypothesis: A batch of failed rows should be able to be filtered on the interface.

samples.source: 状态消息要避免术语缩写与内部代号。
samples.reference: Keep status messages free of internal shorthand.
samples.hypothesis: Status messages should avoid abbreviations and internal codes.

samples.source: 长表格的表头要在滚动时保持可见。
samples.reference: Keep a long table's header pinned while scrolling.
samples.hypothesis: The headers of long tables should remain visible during scrolling.

samples.source: 一个数字的展示要与其来源同口径。
samples.reference: Present a number under the same definition as its source.
samples.hypothesis: A numerical display should be consistent with its source.

samples.source: 界面要能在无网络时完整可用。
samples.reference: The interface must work fully with no network access.
samples.hypothesis: The interface should be fully functional without network access.

samples.source: 提示文案的默认值要与实际默认值同源。
samples.reference: Keep stated defaults drawn from the same source as real defaults.
samples.hypothesis: The default value of the prompt文案 should be from the same source as the actual default value.

samples.source: 提交信息要一行说清改了什么的一部分。
samples.reference: A commit subject names the part of the system a change touches.
samples.hypothesis: The submission information should clearly state what has been changed in one line.

samples.source: 文档写完之后要跑一次形近字扫描，不靠目测。
samples.reference: Run the lookalike scan after writing prose; do not trust the eye.
samples.hypothesis: After writing the document, run a scan of similar-shaped characters to ensure accuracy rather than relying on visual inspection.

samples.source: 台账里的状态变更要附证据，测试名或命令都可以。
samples.reference: Attach evidence to a ledger status change: a test name or a command.
samples.hypothesis: Evidence should be provided for status changes in the ledger, either a test name or a command.

samples.source: 带日期的历史条目只追加订正，不改写。
samples.reference: Append corrections to dated entries; never rewrite them.
samples.hypothesis: Historical entries with dates are only appended and corrected, not rewritten.

samples.source: 一次变更只解决一类问题，混合口径会让归因失效。
samples.reference: Keep one change to one kind of problem, or attribution dies.
samples.hypothesis: A single change addresses only one type of issue; mixed metrics will render attribution ineffective.

samples.source: 并发会话下用路径限定的提交，避免共享暂存区互扫。
samples.reference: Use path-scoped commits with concurrent sessions, so shared staging cannot sweep another's work.
samples.hypothesis: Submit via path-constrained operations under concurrent sessions to avoid cross-checking in the shared cache area.

samples.source: 脚本入口要成对提供平台薄壳，逻辑只放一处。
samples.reference: Provide one thin launcher per OS and keep the logic in a single place.
samples.hypothesis: The script entry should provide a paired platform shell, and the logic should be placed in one place.

samples.source: 新增测试套件要同时登记进本地门禁与流水线。
samples.reference: Register a new suite in both the local gate and the pipeline.
samples.hypothesis: The new test suite must be registered in both the local access control and the pipeline.

samples.source: 一次性探针的结论要落进可复跑入口，否则无法复核。
samples.reference: Promote a one-off probe's finding into a re-runnable entry point, or nobody can re-check it.
samples.hypothesis: The conclusions of the one-time probe must be recorded in the repeatable entry, otherwise they cannot be reviewed.

samples.source: 测试不得依赖开发者机器上的常驻服务。
samples.reference: Tests must not depend on a developer's running services.
samples.hypothesis: Testing should not rely on persistent services on the developer machine.

samples.source: 门禁比眼睛可靠：它会把漏改的旧假设直接报出来。
samples.reference: The gate beats eyeballing: it reports assumptions you forgot to update.
samples.hypothesis: Access control is more reliable than eyes: it will directly report the missed revisions of old assumptions.

samples.source: 断言要能失败，写不出失败的断言等于没有断言。
samples.reference: An assertion that cannot fail is not an assertion.
samples.hypothesis: An assertion must be able to fail; failing to write an assertion means there is no assertion at all.

samples.source: 文档不能成为实现依据，现状以代码与测试为准。
samples.reference: Docs are not an implementation basis; code and tests are current truth.
samples.hypothesis: The document cannot serve as a basis for implementation; the current status should be determined by code and testing.

samples.source: 度量口径的变更要在报告里显式声明。
samples.reference: Declare a metric definition change inside the report.
samples.hypothesis: Changes to the measurement caliber must be explicitly stated in the report.

samples.source: 一次修复要连带删除它当初的遮盖手段。
samples.reference: Remove the workaround that masked a defect when fixing it.
samples.hypothesis: A fix requires deleting its original covering method as well.

samples.source: 测量结论要写清它不能证明什么。
samples.reference: State what a measurement cannot prove.
samples.hypothesis: The measurement conclusion should clearly state what it does not prove.

samples.source: 行尾由版本控制的属性决定，不由本地配置决定。
samples.reference: Line endings come from repository attributes, not local configuration.
samples.hypothesis: The end of the line is determined by version-controlled attributes, not by local configuration.

samples.source: 源码注释统一英文，面向用户的文案按产品语言。
samples.reference: Keep source comments in English and user-facing copy in the product language.
samples.hypothesis: All source code comments are in English, and user-facing copy is in the product language.

samples.source: 每个对外数字都要能追到一次可复现运行。
samples.reference: Trace every published number to one reproducible run.
samples.hypothesis: Every external number should be able to be traced and reproduce a run once.

samples.source: 评审前要自查规范合规缺口，不等他人指出。
samples.reference: Self-check convention compliance before review, not after being told.
samples.hypothesis: Before the review, conduct self-checks to identify any gaps in standards and compliance, without waiting for others to point them out.

samples.source: 变更后的旧承诺句要一并搜干净，避免残留两处。
samples.reference: Search out stale promises after a change, so no second copy survives.
samples.hypothesis: The modified old commitments must be completely removed to avoid residual entries.

samples.source: 台账与代码不一致时先信代码并回写台账。
samples.reference: Trust code over the ledger on conflict, then correct the ledger.
samples.hypothesis: When the ledger and code are inconsistent, trust the code first and rewrite the ledger.

samples.source: 一次跑批前要确认范围参数与它可能覆盖什么。
samples.reference: Confirm a run's scope and what it can overwrite before starting it.
samples.hypothesis: Before running a batch, confirm the scope parameters and what it may cover.

samples.source: 文档里的命令要能直接执行，不写伪代码。
samples.reference: Keep documented commands executable, never pseudocode.
samples.hypothesis: The commands in the document should be executable directly, without pseudocode.

samples.source: 测试的跳过原因要打印出来，SKIP 不是通过。
samples.reference: Print a skip reason; a skip is not a pass.
samples.hypothesis: The reason for skipping the test should be printed out; SKIP indicates failure.

samples.source: 一次修复的解释要绑定到具体证据而不是印象。
samples.reference: Bind an explanation to concrete evidence, not to recollection.
samples.hypothesis: The explanation of a fix should be tied to specific evidence rather than impressions.

samples.source: 共享计数只允许一处真相，两处会互相打脸。
samples.reference: Keep one source of truth for a shared counter, or two disagree.
samples.hypothesis: The sharing count allows only one truth; two would contradict each other.

samples.source: 新旋钮要有上下界与注入接缝，便于测试钉住。
samples.reference: Give a new knob bounds and an injection seam so tests can pin it.
samples.hypothesis: The new knob should have upper and lower boundaries and a injection seam for easy testing and fixation.

samples.source: 一次变更的边界要在提交信息里写清未做什么。
samples.reference: State what a change deliberately did not do, in its message.
samples.hypothesis: The boundaries of a single change should be clearly stated in the submission information.

samples.source: 缺陷编号要与分项口径一致，避免按编号排工错位.
samples.reference: Keep a defect's sub-item numbering consistent, or work split by number misaligns.
samples.hypothesis: The defect number should be consistent with the sub-item criteria to avoid misalignment in arrangement by number.

samples.source: 可复跑的入口要登记在意图清单里，别只留在聊天记录。
samples.reference: Register a re-runnable entry in the intent table, not in chat history.
samples.hypothesis: The recoverable entries should be recorded in the intention list, not just left in chat history.

samples.source: 一次评测的输入与脚本一起入库，便于重放。
samples.reference: Commit an evaluation's inputs with its script, to allow replay.
samples.hypothesis: The input and script of a evaluation are stored together for easy replay.

samples.source: 测量结果要注明环境前提，跨机引用时不可省略。
samples.reference: Note environment preconditions; they are not optional in a cross-machine citation.
samples.hypothesis: The measurement results should indicate the environmental conditions, and cannot be omitted when referenced across machines.

samples.source: 文档的引用要指向能被他人跑起来的东西。
samples.reference: Cite things other people can actually run.
samples.hypothesis: The reference in the document should point to something that can be run by others.

samples.source: 一次修复要连带检查同一形状的其他位置。
samples.reference: After a fix, check for the same shape elsewhere in the tree.
samples.hypothesis: A repair requires checking other positions of the same shape as well.

samples.source: 语音闭环的耗时由分段、识别、翻译与合成四段串联而成。
samples.reference: The voice loop chains segmentation, recognition, translation and synthesis in series.
samples.hypothesis: The time spent on speech round-trip consists of the segmentation, recognition, translation, and synthesis stages connected together.

samples.source: 识别错误会向翻译与合成传染，段级评估要独立跑。
samples.reference: Recognition errors propagate into translation and synthesis, so score segments independently.
samples.hypothesis: Translation and synthesis will be affected by recognition errors, and segment-level evaluation should be performed independently.

samples.source: 麦克风增益过高会让削波后的波形失去可识别性。
samples.reference: Excessive microphone gain pushes the waveform into clipping and ruins recognisability.
samples.hypothesis: Too high microphone gain can cause the Clipping waveform to become unrecognizable.

samples.source: 录音静音裁剪要在分段之后做，不能在波形上做能量阈值一刀切。
samples.reference: Trim silence after segmentation, not by a blanket energy threshold on the waveform.
samples.hypothesis: The silence trimming of the recording should be done after segmentation, not by applying a uniform energy threshold on the waveform.

samples.source: 扬声器输出的音量归一化要放在编码前而不是编码后。
samples.reference: Normalise speaker output volume before encoding, not after.
samples.hypothesis: The volume normalization of the loudspeaker output should be done before encoding, not after.

samples.source: 播放头跨段跳变时要触发一次冲刷，避免残留上一段音频。
samples.reference: Flush the buffer when the playhead crosses a segment, or the previous audio lingers.
samples.hypothesis: When the playhead jumps across segments, a flush is triggered to prevent residual previous audio.

samples.source: 多说话人播客要先分流再分配合成通道。
samples.reference: Route multiple speakers apart before assigning synthesis channels.
samples.hypothesis: For multi-speaker podcasts, the stream needs to be split, then allocated, and finally synthesized into a channel.

samples.source: 语音链路的模型体积上限要按首装下载条件定。
samples.reference: Set the voice model size ceiling by first-install download conditions.
samples.hypothesis: The maximum size of the speech link model should be determined according to the initial installation download conditions.

samples.source: 演示阶段的转写加翻译不能被称为同传。
samples.reference: A transcript plus translation in a demo must not be called simultaneous interpretation.
samples.hypothesis: The transcription and translation during the presentation stage cannot be called simultaneous interpretation.

samples.source: 合成侧的音色切换要在段边界生效，避免段内跳变。
samples.reference: Switch timbre at segment boundaries, not mid-segment.
samples.hypothesis: The speaker timbre switch on the synthesis side must take effect at segment boundaries to prevent jumps within the segment.

samples.source: 识别与翻译用同一语言代码集合，避免两侧口径分叉。
samples.reference: Share one set of language codes between recognition and translation, or the two diverge.
samples.hypothesis: Identify and translate using the same language code set to avoid divergent interpretations on both sides.

samples.source: 语音素材的采样率要与模型要求对齐。
samples.reference: Match voice material's sample rate to what the model expects.
samples.hypothesis: The sample rate of the speech material should be aligned with the model requirements.

samples.source: 分段策略改变会同时影响可懂度与延迟，需一起评估。
samples.reference: A segmentation change moves both intelligibility and latency, so judge them together.
samples.hypothesis: The change in segmentation strategy will affect both intelligibility and latency, and needs to be evaluated together.

samples.source: 合成失败时保留文本结果，不能连带丢弃转写。
samples.reference: Keep the text result when synthesis fails, rather than losing the transcript too.
samples.hypothesis: Keep the text result when synthesis fails, and do not discard the transcription.

samples.source: 端到端语音评测的样本要包含噪声与口音两种条件。
samples.reference: Voice evaluation samples must cover both noisy and accented conditions.
samples.hypothesis: The sample for end-to-end speech evaluation should include both noise and accent conditions.

samples.source: 声码器的选择影响自然度上限，与模型规模不完全同向。
samples.reference: A vocoder bounds naturalness, and not in lockstep with model size.
samples.hypothesis: The selection of the vocoder affects the upper limit of naturalness, which is not entirely consistent with the model size.

samples.source: 识别语言检测在中英混排素材上不稳定，需要按语段回退。
samples.reference: Language detection is unstable on mixed Chinese-English material, so fall back per segment.
samples.hypothesis: The language recognition is unstable on code-switching material, and needs to revert by speech segment.

samples.source: 模型量化到 int8 后体积下降明显，自然度损失要按任务测。
samples.reference: Int8 quantisation shrinks size; measure the naturalness cost per task.
samples.hypothesis: The volume decreases significantly after quantization to int8, and the naturalness loss should be measured per task.

samples.source: 链路里任何一段换模型，都要重跑端到端指标。
samples.reference: Rerun end-to-end metrics whenever any single model in the chain changes.
samples.hypothesis: Any segment in the link that changes to a model requires rerunning the end-to-end metrics.

samples.source: 语音交付要能只给转写与字幕，不强制合成。
samples.reference: Allow delivery of transcript and subtitles without forcing synthesis.
samples.hypothesis: The speech delivery should only provide transcription and subtitle, without forcing synthesis.

samples.source: 离线语音包要能单独更新识别或合成一侧。
samples.reference: Let an offline voice package update recognition or synthesis independently.
samples.hypothesis: The offline speech package should allow for independent updating of recognition or synthesis.

samples.source: 说话人分离在重叠语音上会合并两人，需人工复核。
samples.reference: Speaker diarization merges two voices on overlap, so keep human review.
samples.hypothesis: Speaker diarization merges two speakers in overlapping speech, requiring manual review.

samples.source: 强制对齐的时间戳精度决定字幕可用性与配音定位。
samples.reference: Forced-alignment timestamp accuracy decides subtitle usability and dubbing placement.
samples.hypothesis: The precision of the forced alignment timestamp determines the availability of subtitle and dubbing positioning.

samples.source: 逆文本规整把口语数字转成书面形式，影响下游解析。
samples.reference: Inverse text normalization turns spoken numbers into written form, which downstream parsing depends on.
samples.hypothesis: Inverse text normalization converts spoken numbers into written form, affecting downstream parsing.

samples.source: 词表覆盖不足会让专名切成碎片，识别质量随之下降。
samples.reference: A thin vocabulary shreds proper nouns and drags recognition down.
samples.hypothesis: Insufficient vocabulary coverage will break up proper names, leading to a decline in recognition quality.

samples.source: 半精度推理在部分硬件上不支持，需要回退路径。
samples.reference: Half-precision inference is unsupported on some hardware, so keep a fallback.
samples.hypothesis: Half precision inference is not supported on some hardware, so a fallback path is required.

samples.source: 模型权重的来源与许可要一并交付，不能只给文件。
samples.reference: Deliver a model's provenance and licence with the weights, not the file alone.
samples.hypothesis: The source and permissions of the model weights must be provided in the delivery, not just the files.

samples.source: 流式合成落地前，语音产品叙述只承诺转写与翻译。
samples.reference: Until streaming synthesis lands, voice product copy promises transcript and translation only.
samples.hypothesis: Before streaming synthesis is implemented, speech products only promise transcription and translation.

samples.source: 语音链路的评测要避免与常驻服务争用同一设备。
samples.reference: Keep voice evaluation off the device a resident service is using.
samples.hypothesis: Evaluating speech links should avoid competing with persistent services for the same device.

samples.source: 识别置信度低的段要在字幕里标注而非静默替换成猜测。
samples.reference: Flag low-confidence segments in subtitles rather than guessing silently.
samples.hypothesis: Mark the segments with low recognition confidence in the subtitle instead of silently replacing them with guesses.

samples.source: 音频格式转换要显式选择是否重采样并声明滤波器。
samples.reference: Make resampling and filter choice explicit in audio format conversion.
samples.hypothesis: Audio format conversion requires explicit selection of resampling and declaration of the filter.

samples.source: 语音模型的更新周期与产品发布周期不同步，要能独立升级。
samples.reference: Voice model updates land off the product release cycle, so allow independent upgrade.
samples.hypothesis: The update cycle of the speech model is not synchronized with the product release cycle, and it should be able to upgrade independently.

samples.source: 转写与译文要能分别导出，供不同下游使用。
samples.reference: Export transcript and translation separately for different downstream needs.
samples.hypothesis: The transcription and translation should be able to be exported separately for different downstream applications.

samples.source: 合成语速与字幕停留时长要共同满足阅读约束。
samples.reference: Match synthesis pace and subtitle dwell to one reading constraint.
samples.hypothesis: The combined speech pace and subtitle duration must meet the reading constraints together.

samples.source: 语音素材的时长统计要按有效语音段而非文件长度。
samples.reference: Measure voice material by active speech span, not file length.
samples.hypothesis: The duration statistics of speech material should be based on valid speech segments rather than file length.

samples.source: 链路里的每段延迟都要单独可测，否则优化无据。
samples.reference: Make each stage's latency measurable, or optimisation has no basis.
samples.hypothesis: Every segment of latency in the link must be individually measurable; otherwise, optimization has no basis.

samples.source: 模型体积与首次可用时间的权衡由产品场景决定。
samples.reference: Balance model size against time-to-first-use by product scenario.
samples.hypothesis: The trade-off between model size and first available time is determined by the product scenario.

samples.source: 语音交付的验收要在目标机型上做，而不是开发机。
samples.reference: Accept voice delivery on the target machine, not the development box.
samples.hypothesis: The acceptance of speech delivery should be carried out on the target model, not on the development machine.

samples.source: 语音闭环的失败要指出是哪一段失败，不整体报错.
samples.reference: Failures in the voice loop must name the failing stage, not the loop as a whole.
samples.hypothesis: Indicate which section causes the failure of the speech round-trip. Do not report an error for the whole system.

samples.source: 识别词表要能按客户领域追加，避免硬改模型。
samples.reference: Extend recognition vocabularies per customer domain instead of patching a model.
samples.hypothesis: The vocabulary for identification should be able to be extended according to the customer's domain, avoiding forced modification of the model.

samples.source: 合成产物要能保留参数记录，便于复现同一效果。
samples.reference: Keep synthesis parameters so the same result can be reproduced.
samples.hypothesis: The synthesis product should retain parameter records to facilitate reproducing the same effect.

samples.source: 语音链路的质量与延迟要在同一报表里对照呈现。
samples.reference: Show voice quality and latency side by side in one report.
samples.hypothesis: The quality of the speech link and latency should be presented in a consistent report.

samples.source: 模型清单要注明每个模型的许可、体积与获取方式。
samples.reference: List each model's licence, size and fetch method in the manifest.
samples.hypothesis: The model list should indicate the license, size, and acquisition method for each model.

samples.source: 语音评测的语料许可要与产物许可一致，避免污染。
samples.reference: Keep voice evaluation corpora licence-compatible with the product.
samples.hypothesis: The corpus for speech evaluation should be consistent with the output to avoid contamination.

samples.source: 链路的可观测性要覆盖到每段起止时间。
samples.reference: Instrument start and end times for every stage of the chain.
samples.hypothesis: The observability of the link should cover the start and end times of each segment.

samples.source: 识别与合成的语言支持面要分别声明，不共用一个列表。
samples.reference: Declare recognition and synthesis language support separately, not as one list.
samples.hypothesis: The language support aspects for recognition and synthesis should be declared separately, without sharing a single list.

samples.source: 模型获取失败要给出可复制命令与校验和预期。
samples.reference: On a model fetch failure, print the copyable command and the expected digest.
samples.hypothesis: Provide a reproducible command and checksum expectation when the model acquisition fails.

samples.source: 一次请求要能回读它走过的路径、耗时与最终引擎。
samples.reference: A request should read back the path it took, the time each stage spent and the engine that answered.
samples.hypothesis: A request should be able to read the path it took, the time taken, and the final engine.

samples.source: 健康检查要区分存活、就绪与忙碌三种状态。
samples.reference: A health check should separate alive, ready and busy rather than collapsing them.
samples.hypothesis: Health checks should distinguish between three states: alive, ready, and busy.

samples.source: 排队中的请求要计入可见指标，否则运维只能从时间推断。
samples.reference: Requests waiting in a queue need a visible metric, or operators can only infer them from timing.
samples.hypothesis: Requests in the queue should be counted in the visible metrics; otherwise, operations and maintenance can only infer them from time.

samples.source: 超时配置要有上界，超出表示范围会直接断开而不是等更久。
samples.reference: A wait limit needs an upper bound; past the representable range it severs instead of waiting.
samples.hypothesis: The timeout configuration should have an upper limit; exceeding the range will result in immediate disconnection instead of waiting longer.

samples.source: 被放弃的请求要记账，因为它仍然消耗了一次真实计算。
samples.reference: Record abandoned requests, since they still consumed a real computation.
samples.hypothesis: Abandoned requests should be recorded, as they still consume a real computation.

samples.source: 一个建议等待时长要来自已完成工作的分位数，而不是平均值。
samples.reference: A suggested wait should come from a quantile of finished work, not from an average.
samples.hypothesis: The suggestion wait time should come from the percentile of completed work, not the average.

samples.source: 重启兜底要能被主动触发，而不是等它自己发生。
samples.reference: A bounded restart must be triggerable on purpose, not only by accident.
samples.hypothesis: The restart fallback should be actively triggered, rather than waiting for it to occur on its own.

samples.source: 评测跑批要按语言对限定范围，避免覆盖其他引擎的证据。
samples.reference: Scope an evaluation run by pair and engine, so evidence belonging elsewhere survives.
samples.hypothesis: The evaluation runs and batches should be limited to the specified language pair to avoid covering evidence from other engines.

samples.source: 一个批次结束时给出汇总：条数、失败数、耗时分布与退出码。
samples.reference: Close a batch with a summary: counts, failures, the latency distribution and an exit code.
samples.hypothesis: A summary is provided at the end of a batch: count of items, number of failures, time consumption distribution, and exit code.

samples.source: 观测数据要能区分自身开销与被测对象的开销。
samples.reference: Observability data must separate its own cost from the measured system's cost.
samples.hypothesis: Observational data should be able to distinguish its own overhead from that of the measured object.

samples.source: 一次故障复现要留下最小可重放输入。
samples.reference: Leave a minimal replayable input for every reproduced failure.
samples.hypothesis: A single failure recurrence requires leaving a minimal replayable input.

samples.source: 指标命名要带单位与口径，避免同名指标两种含义。
samples.reference: Name metrics with unit and definition, or one label carries two meanings.
samples.hypothesis: The names of indicators should include units and definitions to avoid two different meanings for the same indicator.

samples.source: 长时运行的告警要基于趋势与噪声带，不基于单点。
samples.reference: Long-run alerts should key off trend and noise band, not a single point.
samples.hypothesis: Long-running alarms should be based on trends and noise bands, not single points.

samples.source: 一次变更的影响要用同机同负载前后对比。
samples.reference: Judge a change on the same machine and load, comparing before and after.
samples.hypothesis: The impact of a change should be shown through comparison before and after under the same machine and load conditions.

samples.source: 评测结果要能重跑出同样的身份名，便于版本追溯。
samples.reference: A rerun must land under the same identity name, for traceability across versions.
samples.hypothesis: The evaluation results should allow re-running with the same identity name for easy version tracking.

samples.source: 日志要能按请求标识聚合，而不是只能按时间顺序读。
samples.reference: Aggregate logs by request identity, not only by time order.
samples.hypothesis: Logs should be aggregated by request identification, not only read in chronological order.

samples.source: 一个指标的绝对值不可比，跨环境只引用相对差。
samples.reference: Absolute metric values are not comparable across environments; cite the relative difference.
samples.hypothesis: The absolute value of a metric is not comparable; only the relative difference across environments is referenced.

samples.source: 观测接口的字段要向后兼容并标注未知含义。
samples.reference: Keep observability fields backward compatible and say what an unknown means.
samples.hypothesis: Fields of the observation interface should be backward compatible and marked with unknown meanings.

samples.source: 失败行要单独落盘，便于重跑而不重复成功部分。
samples.reference: Persist failed rows separately, so a rerun does not repeat what already succeeded.
samples.hypothesis: Failed rows should be saved separately to facilitate re-running without duplicate successful parts.

samples.source: 一个流程的可观测性以能否定位到阶段为准。
samples.reference: A process is observable when a fault can be localised to a stage.
samples.hypothesis: The observability of a process depends on whether it can be identified at a specific stage.

samples.source: 评测要报告分母，未答出的行不能被算成质量差。
samples.reference: Report the denominator; unanswered rows must not be scored as low quality.
samples.hypothesis: The evaluation report should include the denominator; rows without answers cannot be counted as quality issues.

samples.source: 一次跑批的环境要记录芯片、内存、并发与常驻服务。
samples.reference: Log chip, memory, concurrency and resident services for every run.
samples.hypothesis: The environment for a run batch operation should record the chip, memory, concurrency, and persistent services.

samples.source: 一个指标的抖动要给出噪声带而不是只给两点。
samples.reference: Present jitter as a noise band, not as two numbers to compare.
samples.hypothesis: The jitter of a metric should indicate a noise band rather than just two points.

samples.source: 运维手册要写清哪些指标能判断需要扩容。
samples.reference: State which metrics indicate a need to scale, in the operations runbook.
samples.hypothesis: What metrics should be clearly defined in the operation and maintenance manual to determine the need for scale-out?

samples.source: 一次修复后要先确认旧遮盖手段已移除。
samples.reference: After a fix, confirm the workaround that hid it is gone.
samples.hypothesis: After a fix, it is necessary to confirm that the old covering method has been removed.

samples.source: 评测样本的顺序会造出假退化，回访同一批才能分辨。
samples.reference: Sample order can fake degradation; revisit the same rows to tell them apart.
samples.hypothesis: The order of the evaluation sample will cause false degradation, and only by retesting the same batch can it be distinguished.

samples.source: 一个未度量的环节不要声称已经优化。

samples.source: 重采样从 48 千赫兹降到 16 千赫兹要先做抗混叠低通滤波，不然高频会折叠进语音带。
samples.reference: Resampling from 48 kHz to 16 kHz must apply an anti-aliasing low-pass filter first, otherwise high frequencies fold into the speech band.
samples.hypothesis: The resampling from 48 kHz to 16 kHz requires an anti-alias low-pass filter first, otherwise the high frequencies will be folded into the speech band.

samples.source: 信噪比低于 10 分贝的现场录音通常要先做降噪再送 ASR。
samples.reference: Field recordings with a signal-to-noise ratio below 10 dB usually need denoising before being sent to ASR.
samples.hypothesis: A recording with a signal-to-noise ratio below 10 decibels usually needs noise reduction before being sent to ASR.

samples.source: 预加重滤波把高频抬起来，能让后续特征提取对小擦音更敏感。
samples.reference: Pre-emphasis filtering lifts high frequencies so that later feature extraction is more sensitive to weak fricatives.
samples.hypothesis: Pre-emphasis filtering raises the high frequencies, making the subsequent feature extraction more sensitive to minor noise.

samples.source: 分帧时常用的汉明窗能显著削弱矩形窗带来的吉布斯振铃。
samples.reference: A Hamming window is standard during framing and noticeably reduces the Gibbs ringing a rectangular window would introduce.
samples.hypothesis: The Hamming window commonly used during framing can significantly reduce the Gibbs ringing caused by rectangular windows.

samples.source: 帧率 25 fps 是影视的常规，50 fps 会让观众觉得 "太像新闻"。
samples.reference: A 25 fps frame rate is normal for film; 50 fps makes viewers feel it "looks too much like news footage".
samples.hypothesis: A frame rate of 25 fps is standard for films and television, while 50 fps would make the audience feel "too like news".

samples.source: 位深度从 16 升到 24 位不会让响度更大，但动态范围与量化噪声显著改善。
samples.reference: Raising bit depth from 16 to 24 does not increase loudness but improves dynamic range and quantization noise noticeably.
samples.hypothesis: The increase in bit depth from 16 to 24 bits does not increase loudness, but significantly improves the dynamic range and quantization noise.

samples.source: 音画同步在编码链路上要留一个音视频缓冲差，视频通常比音频晚 20 毫秒。
samples.reference: Audio-video sync has to leave a small buffer skew in the encoding chain -- video is typically about 20 ms behind audio.
samples.hypothesis: Audio-video synchronization requires a buffer gap in the encoding chain, and video usually arrives 20 milliseconds later than audio.

samples.source: 声道布局从 5.1 下混到立体声要用 Dolby Pro Logic 而不是简单相加。
samples.reference: Down-mixing from 5.1 to stereo should use Dolby Pro Logic rather than a straight sum.
samples.hypothesis: The audio channel layout changes from 5.1 downmix to stereo using Dolby Pro Logic instead of simple addition.

samples.source: 频谱质心、零过率、能量这三个特征就能把音乐与语音分开。
samples.reference: Spectral centroid, zero-crossing rate and energy are enough to separate music from speech.
samples.hypothesis: The centroid of the spectrum, zero rate, and energy are three features that can distinguish music from speech.

samples.source: 梅尔刻度是仿人耳感知非线性；线性刻度做 FFT 直接分箱不符合听觉心理。
samples.reference: The mel scale mirrors the non-linear frequency perception of human hearing; a linear FFT binning does not match psychoacoustics.
samples.hypothesis: The Mel scale is non-linear in imitation of human hearing perception; linear scales used for FFT direct binning do not conform to auditory psychology.

samples.source: 基音周期与共振峰是语音产生物理模型里最基础的两个概念。
samples.reference: Pitch period and formants are the two most basic concepts in the physical model of speech production.
samples.hypothesis: The fundamental frequency period and resonance peak are the two basic concepts in the physical model of speech production.

samples.source: 声纹识别与说话人分离是两回事：前者固定身份集合做识别，后者只做聚类不分身份。
samples.reference: Voiceprint recognition and speaker diarization are not the same: the first identifies a fixed set of speakers, the second only clusters without identities.
samples.hypothesis: Fingerprint recognition and speaker diarization are two different things: the former identifies based on a fixed set of identities, while the latter only performs clustering without distinguishing identities.

samples.source: 音频缓冲不足会引发 dropout，视频缓冲不足会引发跳帧，两者表现不同但根因都是背压。
samples.reference: Insufficient audio buffering causes dropouts, insufficient video buffering causes frame skips -- different symptoms but the same root cause is backpressure.
samples.hypothesis: Insufficient audio buffering leads to dropout, while insufficient video buffering causes frame skipping. Although the symptoms are different, the root cause is backpressure.

samples.source: 流式协议里 chunk 与 packet 常被混用，但对时延统计而言是两个概念。
samples.reference: In streaming protocols chunk and packet are often used interchangeably, but for latency accounting they are two different concepts.
samples.hypothesis: In streaming protocols, chunk and packet are often used interchangeably, but they represent two different concepts when it comes to latency measurement.

samples.source: 抖动缓冲动态调整目标延迟，网络好时压到 20 毫秒，网络差时拉到 200 毫秒。
samples.reference: A jitter buffer dynamically retargets delay -- pushing it down to 20 ms when the network is good and stretching it to 200 ms when the network is bad.
samples.hypothesis: Jitter buffering adjusts the target latency dynamically, reaching 20 milliseconds when the network is good and 200 milliseconds when the network is poor.

samples.source: 流水线里任何一级的吞吐瓶颈都会把上游顶爆，反压信号必须能一路传回输入端。
samples.reference: Any throughput bottleneck in a pipeline will back up everything upstream, so the backpressure signal has to propagate all the way to the input.
samples.hypothesis: Any throughput bottleneck at any level of the pipeline will overwhelm the upstream, and the reverse pressure signal must be able to reach the input terminal.

samples.source: TCP 的重传会破坏实时性，音视频低延迟场景普遍走 UDP 加前向纠错。
samples.reference: TCP retransmission ruins real-time behaviour; low-latency audio and video usually ride on UDP with forward error correction.
samples.hypothesis: TCP retransmissions will disrupt real-time performance, and low-latency audio and video scenarios generally use UDP with forward error correction.

samples.source: 关键帧间隔太长会让 seek 卡顿，太短会让相同画质下比特率翻倍。
samples.reference: Keyframes spaced too far apart make seeking stutter; too close and the bitrate doubles for the same quality.
samples.hypothesis: Too long keyframe interval interval causes seek lag, while too short one doubles the bitrate under the same image quality.

samples.source: 分块处理时相邻块要有 50% 重叠，不然边界处的能量估计会跳变。
samples.reference: Chunked processing needs 50 percent overlap between adjacent chunks, otherwise the energy estimate jumps at the boundaries.
samples.hypothesis: During chunking, adjacent chunks should have a 50% overlap, otherwise the energy estimation at the boundaries will jump.

samples.source: 冲刷操作的语义是 "把当前缓冲里的内容全部吐出去并结束本段"。
samples.reference: Flush means "emit everything currently in the buffer and terminate this segment".
samples.hypothesis: The semantics of the flush operation is "to completely output the content in the current buffering and end this segment".

samples.source: 端到端流水线里背压没设计好时，最下游的消费者慢就整条链堵死。
samples.reference: If backpressure is not designed in an end-to-end pipeline, a slow consumer at the tail stalls the entire chain.
samples.hypothesis: When backpressure is not properly designed in the end-to-end pipeline, the downstream consumer slows down, causing the entire chain to get stuck.

samples.source: 缓冲预取一般按帧数而不是按时长，因为帧才是模型的原子单位。
samples.reference: Buffer prefetch usually counts in frames, not in seconds, because a frame is the atomic unit of the model.
samples.hypothesis: Buffering prefetching is generally based on the number of frames rather than the duration, as the frame is the atomic unit of the model.

samples.source: 流式合成的边界要落在词或短语之后，切在助词或连词中间会明显刺耳。
samples.reference: Streaming synthesis boundaries should land after a word or phrase; cutting at a particle or conjunction is audibly jarring.
samples.hypothesis: The boundary of streaming synthesis should be placed after a word or phrase, and cutting it between particles or conjunctions will sound harshly obvious.

samples.source: 数据报传输协议丢一两个包时解码器要能优雅丢帧而不是崩。
samples.reference: When the datagram transport protocol drops one or two packets, the decoder should gracefully conceal rather than crash.
samples.hypothesis: The datagram transmission protocol should allow the decoder to gracefully drop frames instead of failing.

samples.source: 恒定比特率适合广播，可变比特率适合存储；两者的缓冲模型完全不同。
samples.reference: Constant bitrate suits broadcast, variable bitrate suits storage -- their buffering models are completely different.
samples.hypothesis: Constant bitrate is suitable for broadcasting, while variable bitrate is suitable for storage; their buffering models are completely different.

samples.source: 容器只负责封装与同步，编解码器负责压缩；把 mkv 转成 mp4 不需要重编码。
samples.reference: The container only handles packaging and synchronisation; the codec handles compression. Turning an mkv into an mp4 needs no re-encoding.
samples.hypothesis: The container is only responsible for encapsulation and synchronization, while the codec is responsible for compression; converting MKV to MP4 does not require re-encoding.

samples.source: 比特流的网络抽象层携带时序与合成信息，缺失会让解码器无法正确解码。
samples.reference: The network abstraction layer of the bitstream carries timing and composition information; missing it leaves the decoder unable to render correctly.
samples.hypothesis: The network abstraction layer of the bit stream carries temporal and synthesis information, and its absence would prevent the decoder from decoding correctly.

samples.source: 编码器要显式声明 profile 与 level，播放器据此判断能不能吃下这条流。
samples.reference: The encoder must declare its profile and level explicitly so the player can decide whether it can accept this stream.
samples.hypothesis: The encoder must explicitly declare the profile and level, and the player uses this information to determine whether it can handle the stream.

samples.source: 解复用就是把一个容器拆开成若干条音视频字幕轨，不做任何解码。
samples.reference: Demultiplexing means splitting a container into its video, audio and subtitle tracks without decoding anything.
samples.hypothesis: Unreleasing is the process of splitting a container into several audio and video subtitle tracks without any decoding.

samples.source: 无损压缩对波形做熵编码，可以逐比特还原；有损压缩引入量化误差。
samples.reference: Lossless compression entropy-codes the waveform and can restore it bit-for-bit; lossy compression introduces quantization error.
samples.hypothesis: Lossless compression performs entropy coding on the waveform, allowing bit-by-bit restoration; lossy compression introduces quantization errors.

samples.source: 转码时如果源和目标编解码器不同，一定要经过帧缓冲重排。
samples.reference: Transcoding between different source and target codecs must go through a frame buffer for reorder.
samples.hypothesis: During transcoding, if the source and target codecs are different, it is necessary to perform buffering rearrangement.

samples.source: 帧内预测只依赖当前帧，帧间预测要引用参考帧，二者的错误传播特性不同。
samples.reference: Intra-frame prediction depends only on the current frame; inter-frame prediction references other frames, and the two propagate errors differently.
samples.hypothesis: Intra-frame prediction relies only on the current frame, while inter-frame prediction requires referencing a reference frame. Their error propagation characteristics are different.

samples.source: 运动估计的搜索半径越大越精确但也越慢，默认 16 像素是常见折中。
samples.reference: A larger motion-estimation search radius is more accurate but slower; 16 pixels is the common default.
samples.hypothesis: The larger the motion estimation search radius, the more accurate it is but also slower. A common compromise is 16 pixels by default.

samples.source: 熵编码用霍夫曼或算术编码；算术编码效率略高但专利与复杂度都是负担。
samples.reference: Entropy coding uses Huffman or arithmetic coding -- the latter is slightly more efficient but carries patent and complexity overhead.
samples.hypothesis: Entropy coding uses Huffman or arithmetic coding; arithmetic coding has slightly higher efficiency but involves patents and complexity issues.

samples.source: 码率控制要感知内容，静态场景压低码率，运动场景放开码率。
samples.reference: Rate control should be content-aware: lower bitrate for static scenes, higher bitrate for motion-heavy scenes.
samples.hypothesis: Rate control should adapt to the content, lowering the rate in static scenes and increasing it in motion scenes.

samples.source: AVC、HEVC、VVC 每一代同画质下比特率大致降一半，复杂度大约翻倍。
samples.reference: Each generation from AVC to HEVC to VVC roughly halves the bitrate for the same quality but doubles the complexity.
samples.hypothesis: AVC, HEVC, and VVC: At the same image quality, the bitrate is approximately half, and the complexity is roughly doubled.

samples.source: Opus 在 6 到 512 千比特率之间自适应，是互联网语音的默认选择。
samples.reference: Opus adapts between 6 and 512 kbps and is the default choice for voice on the internet.
samples.hypothesis: Opus adapts between 6 and 512 kbitrate, and is the default choice for internet speech.

samples.source: FLAC 无损压缩率大约 5:1，适合母带归档；MP3 是有损，别用来做二压。
samples.reference: FLAC compresses losslessly around 5:1 and is suited to archiving masters; MP3 is lossy and should never be secondarily compressed.
samples.hypothesis: FLAC has a lossless compression ratio of about 5:1, making it suitable for master file archiving; MP3 is lossy, so it should not be used for secondary compression.

samples.source: 视频字幕要处理换行宽度、字符编码与字体缺字三个独立问题。
samples.reference: Video subtitles have to handle three independent problems: line-width wrapping, character encoding and missing glyphs.
samples.hypothesis: The video subtitle needs to address three distinct issues: line break width, character encoding, and missing characters in the font.

samples.source: SubRip 只有时间轴与文本两栏，样式能力弱；ASS 有事件与样式两栏，能表达卡拉OK。
samples.reference: SubRip only has timing and text fields, weak styling; ASS adds event and style sections and can express karaoke effects.
samples.hypothesis: SubRip has only two columns: timeline and text, with weak styling capabilities; ASS has two columns: events and styles, and can express karaoke content.

samples.source: WebVTT 是 W3C 定义的网页字幕格式，天然与 HTML5 播放器对接。
samples.reference: WebVTT is the W3C-defined subtitle format for the web and slots straight into HTML5 players.
samples.hypothesis: WebVTT is a web subtitle format defined by the W3C, which naturally integrates with HTML5 players.

samples.source: 逐字时间戳需要强制对齐输出，纯 ASR 只有段级时间戳。
samples.reference: Word-level timestamps require forced-alignment output; ASR alone only provides segment-level timing.
samples.hypothesis: The word-level timestamp needs to be output with forced alignment, while pure ASR only has segment-level timestamp.

samples.source: 字幕断行要按语义而不是按字符数：把 "声画同步" 拆到两行会破坏阅读。
samples.reference: Subtitle line breaks should follow meaning rather than character count; splitting "audio-video sync" across two lines wrecks readability.
samples.hypothesis: Subtitle line breaks should be based on semantics rather than character count: splitting "audio-video sync" into two lines will disrupt readability.

samples.source: 硬字幕化流程 = 抽帧、烧字、重编码；每一步都可能引入代际损失。
samples.reference: Burning in subtitles means extracting frames, drawing captions and re-encoding -- each step can add a generation of loss.
samples.hypothesis: Subtitle hardcoding process = frame extraction, burned-in subtitle, re-encoding; each step may introduce generation loss.

samples.source: 对口型算法在真人上主要看嘴部关键点，在动画上要看帧与语音能量包络。
samples.reference: Lip-sync algorithms track mouth keypoints on real people and match frame-by-frame energy envelopes on animation.
samples.hypothesis: The lip sync algorithm focuses on the mouth key points in real people, while for animations, it depends on the frame and speech energy envelope.

samples.source: 配音时原声要压低 12 分贝做 ducking，不然观众听不清配音。
samples.reference: When dubbing, duck the original audio by 12 dB or viewers will miss the new voice.
samples.hypothesis: During the dubbing, the original sound should be lowered by 12 decibels for ducking, otherwise the audience won't be able to hear the dubbing.

samples.source: 解说场景往往需要保留少量背景音，纯静音配音会让人出戏。
samples.reference: Voiceover scenes usually keep a little background ambience; pure silence makes the viewer drop out of the scene.
samples.hypothesis: In commentary scenes, a little background sound is often needed, and pure silence dubbing makes it feel out of place.

samples.source: 多角色配音要按说话人分离结果分别合成，再按时间戳混流。
samples.reference: Multi-role dubbing must synthesise each speaker separately by diarization result, then remux by timestamp.
samples.hypothesis: Multiple character dubbing should be synthesized separately based on the speaker diarization results, and then mixed into a stream according to the timestamp.

samples.source: 双语字幕对齐时如果两边段落数不同，宁可拆段也不要错开。
samples.reference: When bilingual subtitles have mismatched segment counts, split segments rather than let them drift out of phase.
samples.hypothesis: If the number of lines differs during subtitle alignment, it's better to split the lines instead of leaving them apart.

samples.source: 时间轴漂移在长视频里会累积，每 10 分钟要人工核对一次锚点。
samples.reference: Timeline drift accumulates on long videos; check the anchors by hand every ten minutes.
samples.hypothesis: The timeline drift accumulates in long videos, and the anchor points need to be manually checked once every 10 minutes.

samples.source: 音轨抽取常用 ffmpeg 的 -vn 参数，代价是重封装而不是重编码。
samples.reference: Extracting an audio track usually uses ffmpeg's -vn flag; the cost is remuxing, not re-encoding.
samples.hypothesis: Audio track extraction commonly uses the -vn parameter of ffmpeg, at the cost of re-encoding rather than re-packaging.

samples.source: 字幕嵌入视频流会让不支持字幕的播放器也能显示，代价是不可关闭。
samples.reference: Embedding subtitles into the video stream lets even non-subtitle players display them, at the cost of losing the on/off toggle.
samples.hypothesis: Subtitle embedding in the video stream allows players that do not support subtitles to display it, but at the cost of being unable to turn it off.

samples.source: 视频重封装时如果编码格式没变，可以逐包拷贝，秒级完成。
samples.reference: Remuxing a video where the codec has not changed can copy packet-by-packet and finish in seconds.
samples.hypothesis: If the encoding format remains unchanged during video remuxing, it can be copied packet by packet and completed in seconds.

samples.source: 帧精确的字幕对齐要求毫秒级时间戳，段级精度在快语速时不够用。
samples.reference: Frame-accurate subtitle alignment requires millisecond timestamps; segment-level accuracy is not enough for fast speech.
samples.hypothesis: Frame-accurate subtitle alignment requires millisecond-level timestamps, while segment-level precision is insufficient at fast speech speeds.

samples.source: 时间码 SMPTE 12 小时制在 30 帧率下有掉帧与非掉帧两种，跨系统同步时要显式声明。
samples.reference: SMPTE 12-hour timecode has drop-frame and non-drop-frame variants at 30 fps; state which one when synchronising across systems.
samples.hypothesis: Timecode SMPTE 12-hour format at 30 frame rate has both dropouts and non-dropouts, which should be explicitly stated when achieving system cross-synchronization.

samples.source: 配音脚本的时长要与原视频对齐，写译文时要按 "口型开放度" 估算音节上限。
samples.reference: Dubbing scripts must match the duration of the original video; when writing translations, estimate the syllable budget from visible mouth openness.
samples.hypothesis: The duration of the dubbing script should be aligned with the original video, and when writing the translation, the maximum number of syllables should be estimated based on "mouth opening degree".

samples.source: 模型检查点最好同时保存权重、优化器状态与 tokenizer，方便续训与推理。
samples.reference: A model checkpoint should store weights, optimiser state and the tokenizer together, so resuming training and inference are both easy.
samples.hypothesis: It is best for a model checkpoint to save weights, optimizer state, and tokenizer simultaneously for easy retraining and inference.

samples.source: 子词切分把未登录词拆成可组合的部件，词表大小与切分粒度直接相关。
samples.reference: Subword tokenization breaks unknown words into combinable pieces; vocabulary size and merge granularity are directly related.
samples.hypothesis: Subword segmentation breaks unlogged words into combinable components, and the size of the vocabulary is directly related to the segmentation granularity.

samples.source: 字节对编码从字符级开始反复合并高频对，构造出面向该语料的最优词表。
samples.reference: Byte-pair encoding starts from characters and repeatedly merges the most frequent pairs, producing a vocabulary optimised for that corpus.
samples.hypothesis: Byte-pair encoding starts from the character level and repeatedly merges high-frequency pairs to construct the optimal vocabulary for that corpus.

samples.source: 词嵌入把符号映射到连续空间，语义相近的词在向量空间里距离更近。
samples.reference: Word embeddings map symbols into continuous space so that semantically similar words lie close together in the vector space.
samples.hypothesis: Word embedding maps symbols to a continuous space, where words with similar semantics are closer in the vector space.

samples.source: 注意力机制允许解码器在每一步软选择性地查看源句的所有位置。
samples.reference: Attention allows the decoder at every step to softly inspect every position in the source sentence.
samples.hypothesis: The attention mechanism allows the decoder to softly and selectively examine all positions of the source sentence at each step.

samples.source: Transformer 用自注意力替代循环结构，训练时并行度高但推理时 KV 缓存吃内存。
samples.reference: The Transformer replaces recurrence with self-attention -- high parallelism during training, but KV-cache cost at inference time.
samples.hypothesis: Transformer replaces the cyclic structure with self-attention, having high parallelism during training but using KV cache that consumes memory during inference.

samples.source: 量化到 int8 后模型体积大约压到三分之一，速度提升视硬件与算子而定。
samples.reference: Quantising to int8 shrinks the model to about a third of its size; the speed gain depends on hardware and operators.
samples.hypothesis: After quantization to int8, the model size is reduced to about one-third, and the performance improvement depends on the hardware and operator.

samples.source: 半精度 fp16 保留浮点动态范围，训练时用得多；int8 推理时用得多。
samples.reference: Half-precision fp16 keeps the dynamic range of floats and is used heavily in training; int8 is used heavily in inference.
samples.hypothesis: Half precision fp16 retains the floating-point dynamic range and is used more during training; int8 is used more for inference.

samples.source: 知识蒸馏把大模型的软标签灌给小模型，让后者逼近前者的准确率。
samples.reference: Knowledge distillation feeds the soft labels of a large model into a small model so the latter approaches the former's accuracy.
samples.hypothesis: Knowledge distillation injects soft labels from a large model into a small model, enabling the latter to approach the accuracy of the former.

samples.source: 教师模型可以是 30B 参数，学生模型压到 1B，蒸馏后小模型在窄任务上不掉太多。
samples.reference: The teacher might have 30B parameters and the student only 1B; a distilled student loses surprisingly little on a narrow task.
samples.hypothesis: The teacher model can have 30B parameters, while the student model is reduced to 1B. After distillation, the small model performs well on narrow tasks without significant loss.

samples.source: 微调在特定领域语料上继续训练，学习率要显著低于预训练阶段。
samples.reference: Fine-tuning continues training on a domain-specific corpus at a much lower learning rate than pretraining.
samples.hypothesis: Fine-tuning is continued on domain-specific data for further training, with a learning rate significantly lower than during pre-training.

samples.source: LoRA 只训练两个低秩矩阵，参数量与原模型相比不到百分之一。
samples.reference: LoRA only trains two low-rank matrices, less than one percent of the base model's parameter count.
samples.hypothesis: LoRA only trains two low-rank matrices, and the parameter count is less than one percent of that of the original model.

samples.source: 推理时 batch size 越大吞吐越高但延迟也越长，实时场景往往锁死 batch=1。
samples.reference: At inference time, larger batch size raises throughput but also latency; realtime pipelines usually lock batch=1.
samples.hypothesis: When performing inference, the larger the batch size, the higher the throughput, but the latency also increases. In real-time scenarios, batch=1 is often locked in.

samples.source: 线程数不是越多越好；ONNX 的 inter-op 与 intra-op 要分开调。
samples.reference: More threads are not always better; ONNX's inter-op and intra-op thread counts have to be tuned separately.
samples.hypothesis: The thread count is not the more the better; the inter-op and intra-op in ONNX should be adjusted separately.

samples.source: 算子融合把多个小算子合并成一个大算子，减少内存往返与调度开销。
samples.reference: Operator fusion collapses several small operators into one, reducing memory round-trips and scheduling overhead.
samples.hypothesis: Operator fusion combines multiple small operators into one large operator, reducing memory traversal and scheduling overhead.

samples.source: 计算图优化是推理框架的核心工作，图切分决定哪些算子留在 CPU 哪些上 GPU。
samples.reference: Computation-graph optimisation is the core work of an inference framework; graph partitioning decides which operators stay on CPU and which move to GPU.
samples.hypothesis: Graph optimization is the core task of the inference framework, and graph splitting determines which operators remain on the CPU and which are sent to the GPU.

samples.source: 运行时提供程序的选择影响极大，同一模型在 CUDA 与 CPU 上可能差 5 到 10 倍。
samples.reference: Choosing the runtime provider matters a lot -- the same model can be 5 to 10 times faster on CUDA than on CPU.
samples.hypothesis: The choice of runtime provider has a significant impact, and the same model may differ by 5 to 10 times between CUDA and CPU.

samples.source: 显存不足时 Ollama 会自动把部分层卸载到内存，速度骤降但不会崩。
samples.reference: When VRAM is insufficient Ollama offloads some layers to main memory; throughput collapses but the process survives.
samples.hypothesis: When VRAM is insufficient, Ollama will automatically unload some layers to memory, resulting in a significant slowdown but no system crash.

samples.source: 批大小与序列长度的乘积决定 KV 缓存的显存开销。
samples.reference: The product of batch size and sequence length determines the VRAM cost of the KV cache.
samples.hypothesis: The product of batch size and sequence length determines the VRAM overhead of the KV cache.

samples.source: 多语言模型用一份参数覆盖 100 多种语言，冷门语向的质量通常明显低于热门语向。
samples.reference: A multilingual model covers more than a hundred languages with one set of weights, and quality on cold pairs is usually much lower than on hot pairs.
samples.hypothesis: A multilingual model uses a single parameter to cover over 100 languages, and the quality of less popular languages is usually significantly lower than that of popular languages.

samples.source: 分词器与模型的词表必须严格匹配，错配会导致输出乱码但不报错。
samples.reference: The tokenizer and the model's vocabulary must match exactly; a mismatch produces garbled output without raising an error.
samples.hypothesis: The tokenizer and the model's vocabulary must match exactly; any mismatch will result in garbled output without an error message.

samples.source: 温度采样把概率分布拉平，让模型输出更多样，但翻译场景通常希望更低温度。
samples.reference: Temperature sampling flattens the probability distribution and yields more varied output, but translation typically wants lower temperature.
samples.hypothesis: Temperature sampling smooths out the probability distribution, resulting in a more diverse output from the model, but in translation scenarios, lower temperature is usually preferred.

samples.source: 上下文窗口是 LLM 的硬约束，长文档翻译要么截断要么分段喂。
samples.reference: The context window is a hard constraint on the LLM; long documents must be truncated or fed one sentence at a time.
samples.hypothesis: The context window is a hard constraint for LLMs; either long documents need to be truncated or segmented for processing.

samples.source: 系统提示里显式列出术语表可以显著降低专业词错译，但会占用输入 token。
samples.reference: Listing the glossary explicitly inside the system prompt significantly reduces terminology errors but consumes input tokens.
samples.hypothesis: Explicitly listing the glossary in the system prompt can significantly reduce mistranslations of professional terms, but it will consume input tokens.

samples.source: 少样本示例把 "用户希望的译法" 直接摆到模型眼前，比抽象指令更有效。
samples.reference: Few-shot examples put the user's preferred rendering directly in front of the model, which beats any abstract instruction.
samples.hypothesis: Few-shot examples directly present the "translation desired by the user" before the model, which is more effective than abstract instructions.

samples.source: 术语表要按当前请求的语言对与领域过滤，把不相关条目喂给模型只会稀释注意力。
samples.reference: Glossaries must be filtered by the current request's language pair and domain; feeding irrelevant rows only dilutes attention.
samples.hypothesis: The glossary should filter by the current request's language pair and domain. Feeding irrelevant entries to the model will only dilute its attention.

samples.source: 翻译记忆是精确匹配，命中即零成本；模糊匹配是另一码事，会引入排序噪声。
samples.reference: Translation memory matches exactly -- a hit is zero-cost; fuzzy matching is a different problem and brings ranking noise.
samples.hypothesis: Translation memory is precise matching, with zero cost upon cache hit; fuzzy matching is a different matter and introduces sorting noise.

samples.source: 置信度门控是本地结果与 AI 升级之间的开关，阈值定太松会白白多花一次 API。
samples.reference: Confidence gating is the switch between local output and AI upgrade; too permissive a threshold wastes API calls.
samples.hypothesis: Confidence gating is the switch between local results and AI upgrade. If the threshold is too loose, it will result in an unnecessary API call.

samples.source: 质量分记录每条 TM 的历史可信度，AI 写入通常是 0.95，本地是估算，手动是 1.0。
samples.reference: The quality score records each TM entry's historical reliability -- AI writes at 0.95, local estimates its own, manual writes 1.0.
samples.hypothesis: The quality score records the historical credibility of each TM. The default value for AI writing is 0.95, while for local estimates it is an estimate, and for manual entries it is 1.0.

samples.source: 兜底降级必须携带原因说明，让调用方知道 "翻不出" 和 "翻错了但降级返回" 是两回事。
samples.reference: Fallback degradation must carry a reason so the caller can tell "could not translate" apart from "translated wrong but degraded anyway".
samples.hypothesis: The fallback degradation must include a reason explanation so that the caller knows that "unable to retrieve" and "incorrectly retrieved but returned via fallback" are two different things.

samples.source: 不静默降级是本产品的硬约束：任何路径回落都要写进 message 字段。
samples.reference: No silent degradation is this product's hard constraint: every fallback must be written into the message field.
samples.hypothesis: No silent degradation is a hard constraint of this product: any fallback path must be included in the message field.

samples.source: 蒸馏从 AI 精译结果中抽术语回灌本地引擎，形成 "越用越省" 的性价比飞轮。
samples.reference: Distillation extracts terms from AI quality translations and feeds them back into local engines, forming a "cheaper the more you use it" flywheel.
samples.hypothesis: Distillation extracts terms from AI translation results and feeds them back into the local engine, creating a cost-effective cycle that becomes more efficient with use.

samples.source: 命中率与质量分是彼此冲突的：低质量记忆对反复命中会污染输出。
samples.reference: Hit rate and quality score fight each other -- repeatedly hitting a low-quality memory pair poisons the output.
samples.hypothesis: The hit rate and quality score are contradictory: low-quality memories can contaminate the output due to repeated cache hits.

samples.source: LRU 缓存要预留一定命中率作为预热指标，冷启动阶段不能过早淘汰。
samples.reference: The LRU cache should reserve a hit-rate threshold as the warm-up signal; the cold-start phase must not evict too aggressively.
samples.hypothesis: The LRU cache should maintain a certain hit rate as a warmup metric, and no elimination should occur too early during the cold start phase.

samples.source: 端到端评估的样本要覆盖三种场景：完全命中、缓存质量不足重译、无缓存纯翻译。
samples.reference: End-to-end evaluation samples must cover three scenarios: perfect hit, cache-quality-refused re-translation, and cold translation without cache.
samples.hypothesis: The sample for the end-to-end evaluation should cover three scenarios: complete cache hit, insufficient cache quality, and no cache.

samples.source: 神经机器翻译对训练域极其敏感；把 Wiki 语料训出来的模型直接搬到会议记录，质量掉得很明显。
samples.reference: Neural machine translation is extremely sensitive to the training domain -- a model trained on Wikipedia drops heavily when used on meeting transcripts.
samples.hypothesis: Neural machine translation is extremely sensitive to the training domain; the model trained on Wiki data directly transferred to meeting transcripts results in a significant drop in quality.

samples.source: 大语言模型在冷启动阶段能靠世界知识翻译专有名词，但没有术语注入时同名词在长文档里译法会漂。
samples.reference: A large language model can translate proper nouns in a cold start using world knowledge, but without term injection the same term can drift across a long document.
samples.hypothesis: A large language model can translate proper nouns using world knowledge during the cold start phase, but without term injection, the translation of the same nouns in long documents may vary.

samples.source: 统计机器翻译依赖短语表与对齐语料，工程上比神经翻译更难维护但延迟可控。
samples.reference: Statistical machine translation relies on phrase tables and aligned corpora; harder to maintain in production but latency is predictable.
samples.hypothesis: Statistical machine translation relies on phrase tables and alignment data, which is more difficult to maintain engineering-wise than neural translation, but its latency can be controlled.

samples.source: 实时因子 RTF 是模型耗时代价除以音频时长，小于 1 才可能做实时。
samples.reference: The real-time factor RTF is the model's compute cost divided by the audio length; only RTF below 1 makes realtime feasible.
samples.hypothesis: Real-time factor RTF is the cost of the model per unit of audio duration; it can be real-time only if it is less than 1.

samples.source: 首字延迟决定用户对 "快不快" 的第一印象；总时长决定 "等得起等不起"。
samples.reference: Time-to-first-token decides the user's gut feeling of "fast"; total time decides whether they can "wait".
samples.hypothesis: The time to first token determines the user's first impression of "fast or not"; the total duration determines "can they wait or not".

samples.source: 挂钟时间是端到端测出来的，包含排队与网络往返，与 CPU 时间不是一回事。
samples.reference: Wall-clock time is measured end-to-end and includes queuing and network round-trips; it is not the same as CPU time.
samples.hypothesis: The wall-clock time is measured end-to-end, including queueing and network round trips, and is not the same as CPU time.

samples.source: 冷启动阶段第一次推理会加载权重、构建计算图，比稳态慢一个数量级。
samples.reference: The first inference during a cold start loads weights and builds the computation graph, taking an order of magnitude longer than steady state.
samples.hypothesis: The first inference during the cold start phase will load weights and build a computation graph, which is one order of magnitude slower than in a steady state.

samples.source: 预热一般用几条虚拟请求把权重从磁盘拉到内存并触发惰性优化。
samples.reference: Warmup usually fires a few synthetic requests to bring weights from disk into memory and to trigger lazy graph optimisation.
samples.hypothesis: The warmup typically uses several virtual requests to transfer the weight from disk to memory and trigger lazy optimization.

samples.source: 内存占用对桌面产品是硬约束，用户能接受 CPU 慢但不能接受 OOM。
samples.reference: Memory footprint is a hard constraint for desktop products -- users will accept CPU slowness but not OOM.
samples.hypothesis: The memory footprint is a hard constraint for desktop products. Users can accept a slow CPU, but cannot tolerate OOM.

samples.source: 每秒查询数是服务端指标，对单机桌面产品意义不大。
samples.reference: Queries per second is a server metric and says little about a single-machine desktop product.
samples.hypothesis: Queries per second is a server-side metric and has little significance for standalone desktop products.

samples.source: 性能剖析要区分推理耗时、编解码耗时与 IO 耗时，不然优化容易打偏。
samples.reference: Profiling must separate inference time, codec time and I/O time, otherwise optimisation ends up targeting the wrong thing.
samples.hypothesis: Profiling should distinguish between inference time, encoding/decoding time, and IO time; otherwise optimization efforts may be misdirected.

samples.source: 端到端吞吐受限于最慢的一段，优化前先找出瓶颈段。
samples.reference: End-to-end throughput is capped by the slowest stage; find the bottleneck before optimising.
samples.hypothesis: The end-to-end throughput is limited by the slowest segment; identify the bottleneck segment before optimization.

samples.source: 基准测试要固定 seed、固定采样策略，两次跑同一模型输出应可复现。
samples.reference: Benchmarks must pin the seed and the sampling policy, otherwise two runs on the same model are not comparable.
samples.hypothesis: The benchmark should fix the seed and sampling strategy, and the outputs of the same model run twice should be reproducible.

samples.source: 延迟测试期间不能有并发下载或杀毒扫描，否则会污染数字。
samples.reference: Latency measurements are ruined by concurrent downloads or antivirus scans; run them on an idle machine.
samples.hypothesis: No concurrent downloads or antivirus scans are allowed during latency testing, otherwise it will contaminate the data.

samples.source: 缓冲区在 AV 域是 audio buffer；在化学语境下是 buffer solution。
samples.reference: In AV context a buffer is an audio buffer; in chemistry it is a buffer solution.
samples.hypothesis: In the AV domain, the buffer is called audio buffer; in the chemical context, it is called buffer solution.

samples.source: stream 在流式合成里是 "流"；在统计语境是 "数据流"，在地理语境是 "溪流"。
samples.reference: A stream in streaming synthesis is a data stream; in statistics it is a data stream too, but in geography it is a brook.
samples.hypothesis: stream in streaming synthesis is "流"; in statistical context is "data stream"; in geographical context is "stream".

samples.source: channel 在音频里是 "声道"；在消息队列里是 "通道"；在营销里是 "渠道"。
samples.reference: A channel in audio is a channel; in a message queue it is a channel; in marketing it is also a channel -- different meanings.
samples.hypothesis: In audio, channel is "audio channel"; in message queue, it is "channel"; in marketing, it is "channel".

samples.source: segment 在 VAD 里是 "语音段"；在商业语境是 "市场份额"；在几何是 "线段"。
samples.reference: A segment in VAD is a speech segment; in business it is a market segment; in geometry it is a line segment.
samples.hypothesis: Segment in VAD is "speech segment"; in business context, it is "market share"; in geometry, it is "line segment".

samples.source: voice 在 TTS 里更常见的是 "音色 / 说话人声线"，不是物理意义的 "声音"。
samples.reference: In TTS, voice most often means the speaker's timbre, not the physical sense of sound.
samples.hypothesis: In TTS, "voice" is more commonly referred to as "speaker timbre" rather than the physical "sound".

samples.source: speech 强调 "口语演讲" 与 "语音信号"；voice 更偏 "嗓音" 与 "说话主体"。
samples.reference: Speech emphasises spoken language and the acoustic signal; voice leans toward the voice quality and the speaking subject.
samples.hypothesis: Speech emphasizes "oral speech" and "audio signals"; voice is more related to "voice" and "the speaker".

samples.source: frame 在编码域是 "帧"，在窗口/画框域也是 "frame"，靠上下文区分。
samples.reference: Frame means frame in the codec context and also frame in the picture/window context -- only surrounding text disambiguates.
samples.hypothesis: In the encoding domain, "frame" is "frame", and in the window/box domain, it is also "frame", which is distinguished by the context.

samples.source: sample 在音频域是 "样本 / 采样点"，在统计域是 "样本 / 抽样单位"。
samples.reference: Sample in audio is a discrete sample; in statistics it is a sampled unit -- the English word is the same.
samples.hypothesis: In the audio domain, sample is "sample / sample point", and in the statistical domain, it is "sample / sampling unit".

samples.source: model 在 ML 域是 "模型"，在时尚/模型汽车域也是 "model"。
samples.reference: Model in machine learning is a trained predictor; in fashion or scale cars it is also a model.
samples.hypothesis: In the ML field, model means "model", and in the fashion/model car field, it also means "model".

samples.source: pitch 在语音域是 "音高"，在棒球域是 "投球"，在商务域是 "提案"。
samples.reference: Pitch in speech is fundamental frequency; in baseball it is a throw; in business it is a proposal.
samples.hypothesis: pitch in speech domain is "pitch", in baseball domain is "throwing", and in business domain is "proposal".

samples.source: prosody 只在语音学域用，其他语境几乎不出现，可作纯领域锚点。
samples.reference: Prosody appears only in phonetics -- a pure domain anchor.
samples.hypothesis: Prosody is used only in the field of phonetics and rarely appears in other contexts; it can serve as a pure domain anchor.

samples.source: vocoder 是语音工程独有的 "声码器"，普通用户不认识，UI 中要加解释。
samples.reference: Vocoder is unique to speech engineering ("声码器"); most users will not recognise it, so the UI has to explain.
samples.hypothesis: The vocoder is a unique "vocoder" in speech engineering that ordinary users do not recognize; an explanation should be added in the UI.

samples.source: diarization 是 "说话人分离"，与 recognition 组合成 "谁在什么时候说了什么"。
samples.reference: Diarization means speaker separation; combined with recognition it answers "who said what when".
samples.hypothesis: diarization is "speaker diarization", combined with recognition to form "who said what at what time".

samples.source: alignment 在字幕域是 "对齐"，在 NLP 域是 "对齐（跨语言）"，在几何域是 "排列"。
samples.reference: Alignment in subtitle context is temporal alignment; in NLP it is cross-lingual alignment; in geometry it is arrangement.
samples.hypothesis: Alignment in the subtitle domain is "alignment", in the NLP domain is "alignment (cross-language)", and in the geometry domain is "arrangement".

samples.source: decoder 在编解码域是 "解码器"，在神经机器翻译域也是解码器，两侧含义相关但实现不同。
samples.reference: Decoder is a hardware or software component in the codec sense, and also the second half of an NMT model -- related meaning, different implementation.
samples.hypothesis: In the encoding and decoding domain, "decoder" is "decoder", and in neural machine translation, it is also "decoder". The meanings are related but the implementations are different.

samples.source: encoder 与 decoder 对称；神经网络里两侧都用同名，工程里可能一个是软件一个是硬件。
samples.reference: Encoder and decoder are symmetric; in neural networks both share the name, but in engineering one may be software and the other hardware.
samples.hypothesis: The encoder and decoder are symmetric; in neural networks, both are named the same, while in engineering, one may be software and the other hardware.

samples.source: codec 是 encoder + decoder 的合体，通常只在压缩域使用。
samples.reference: A codec is encoder plus decoder fused; the word is usually restricted to the compression domain.
samples.hypothesis: Codec is a combination of encoder and decoder, and is usually used only in the compression domain.

samples.source: container 在视频工程是 "容器格式"（mkv/mp4），在软件部署是 "容器"（Docker）。
samples.reference: In video engineering a container is a container format (mkv/mp4); in software deployment a container is a Docker container.
samples.hypothesis: In video engineering, "container format" refers to mkv/mp4, while in software deployment, it refers to "container" (Docker).

samples.source: latency 在实时音视频是网络与解码延迟总和；在计算体系结构里是流水线延迟。
samples.reference: In real-time audio and video, latency is the sum of network and decoding delays; in computer architecture it is pipeline latency.
samples.hypothesis: In real-time audio and video, latency is the sum of network and decoding latency; in computing architecture, it is pipeline latency.

samples.source: jitter 在网络语境是 "抖动"，在时钟语境也是 "抖动"，两者机制不同要区分。
samples.reference: Jitter means network jitter in one context and clock jitter in another -- the mechanisms differ and translation must separate them.
samples.hypothesis: Jitter in the network context means "jitter", and in the clock context also means "jitter". The mechanisms are different and need to be distinguished.

samples.source: throughput 与 bandwidth 常被混用；前者是实际吞吐，后者是理论上限。
samples.reference: Throughput and bandwidth are often conflated; the first is achieved work, the second is the theoretical ceiling.
samples.hypothesis: Throughput and bandwidth are often used interchangeably; the former refers to actual throughput, while the latter denotes the theoretical limit.

samples.source: chunk 与 packet 与 frame 在流媒体里是三个不同粒度，翻译不能一律译成 "块"。
samples.reference: Chunk, packet and frame are three different granularities in streaming media and cannot all be translated as "块".
samples.hypothesis: Chunk, packet, and frame are three different scales in streaming media, and the term "block" should not be used uniformly.

samples.source: prompt 在 LLM 域是 "提示词"，在 OS 终端域是 "命令提示符"，两者完全不同。
samples.reference: In the LLM domain a prompt is an instruction to the model; in the OS shell it is a command prompt -- entirely different meanings.
samples.hypothesis: In the LLM domain, prompt is "prompt", while in the OS terminal domain, it is "command prompt"; the two are completely different.

samples.source: token 在 NLP 域是 "词元"，在身份认证域是 "令牌"。
samples.reference: A token in NLP is a subword unit; in authentication it is an access token.
samples.hypothesis: token in NLP domain is "token", and in identity authentication domain is "token".

samples.source: transcode 是重新编码；remux 是只重封装不重编码，两者的画质损失完全不同。
samples.reference: Transcode re-encodes; remux only rewraps. Their quality loss profiles differ fundamentally.
samples.hypothesis: Transcode is re-encoding; remux is only packaging without encoding, and the quality loss between the two is completely different.

samples.source: burn-in 是硬字幕化，overlay 是叠加显示，两者在渲染管线上不同。
samples.reference: Burn-in hard-codes subtitles into the pixels; overlay draws them at render time. They sit at different stages of the pipeline.
samples.hypothesis: Subtitle hardcoding is the process of burning-in, and overlay refers to the overlay display, both having different rendering pipelines.

samples.source: 录音时先检查麦克风增益再检查系统音量，避免底噪被算法当语音。
samples.reference: When recording, check microphone gain before system volume -- clipping at the input cannot be undone by any algorithm.
samples.hypothesis: Before starting the recording, check the microphone gain first, then the system volume, to prevent background noise from being recognized as speech by the algorithm.

samples.source: 扬声器切换在 Windows 上需要重启音频图，多数应用会掉一帧。
samples.reference: Switching the output speaker on Windows rebuilds the audio graph, and many applications drop a frame during the change.
samples.hypothesis: Switching the loudspeaker requires restarting the audio service, and most applications will drop a frame.

samples.source: 播放条拖动要显式触发关键帧 seek，不然会看到花屏过渡。
samples.reference: Dragging the playhead should explicitly seek to a keyframe; otherwise viewers see a block of corrupted frames during the transition.
samples.hypothesis: The drag on the playback bar must explicitly trigger a keyframe seek, otherwise a screen flicker transition will be seen.

samples.source: 预览窗口默认按软字幕渲染，导出时可以选择烧进画面。
samples.reference: The preview pane renders soft subtitles by default; hard-burn is an explicit export option.
samples.hypothesis: The preview window renders by default using soft subtitle, and when exporting, you can choose to burn into the picture.

samples.source: 时间轴面板支持逐帧微调，用左右方向键可以一帧一帧移动。
samples.reference: The timeline panel supports frame-level nudge -- left and right arrows step exactly one frame.
samples.hypothesis: The timeline panel supports fine-tuning per frame, and you can move step by step using the left and right arrow keys.

samples.source: 剪辑导出前要先做静音剪裁，不然成片里会有无意义空白。
samples.reference: Cut silence before exporting an edit, otherwise the final piece has meaningless gaps.
samples.hypothesis: Before clip and export, you need to perform silence cutting, otherwise there will be meaningless blanks in the final video.

samples.source: 导入 AV 素材时最好显式选择帧率解释策略，跨制式素材容易掉帧。
samples.reference: When importing AV footage, explicitly pick the frame-rate interpretation policy -- mixed-source clips drop frames otherwise.
samples.hypothesis: It is recommended to explicitly select the frame rate when importing AV materials, as materials across different formats are prone to frame loss.

samples.source: 音频波形视图可以让用户手工微调 VAD 段边界，识别错切时特别有用。
samples.reference: The waveform view lets the user hand-tune VAD boundaries, which is invaluable when the auto-segmentation mis-cuts.
samples.hypothesis: The audio waveform view allows users to manually fine-tuning the VAD segment boundaries, which is particularly useful for identifying misalignment.

samples.source: 导出双语字幕时两个轨要用独立时间戳，不要共用一个。
samples.reference: When exporting bilingual subtitles, keep independent timestamps for each track -- sharing one drifts fast.
samples.hypothesis: When exporting bilingual subtitles, each track should have a separate timestamp, not sharing the same timestamp.

samples.source: 预览延迟过高的机器可以把 VAD 阈值调松，让用户先看到大致分段。
samples.reference: On machines with high preview latency, loosen the VAD threshold so users see the rough segmentation before refining.
samples.hypothesis: Machines with high preview latency can adjust the VAD threshold to make users see a rough segmentation first.

samples.source: 导入音频时检测采样率与位深，不匹配时给出重采样建议而不是静默转换。
samples.reference: Detect sample rate and bit depth on import; if they mismatch, offer a resampling choice instead of silently converting.
samples.hypothesis: When importing audio, check the sample rate and bit depth, and provide resampling suggestions instead of a silent conversion if they do not match.

samples.source: 本地引擎矩阵覆盖 argos、madlad、ollama 三个真实引擎，加一个内置 demo 兜底。
samples.reference: The local engine matrix covers three real engines -- argos, madlad and ollama -- plus a built-in demo as the last fallback.
samples.hypothesis: The local engine matrix covers three real engines: Argos, Madlad, and Olama, with a built-in demo as a fallback.

samples.source: sidecar 只监听 127.0.0.1 保证隐私不变量：任何外部进程都不能访问这台机器上的翻译流。
samples.reference: The sidecar binds only to 127.0.0.1 to enforce the privacy invariant: no external process can touch this machine's translation stream.
samples.hypothesis: Sidecar only monitors 127.0.0.1 to ensure privacy immutability: no external process can access the translation stream on this machine.

samples.source: 语言对是本地模型分档的核心维度，同一模型在不同语言对上质量差 15 分以上。
