samples.reference: In dialogue-dense material, break subtitles on pauses rather than punctuation.
samples.hypothesis: In material with dense dialogue, the segmentation of subtitle should primarily be based on pauses rather than punctuation marks.

samples.source: 音轨替换后重新混流时，要保留原轨的语言标签与默认轨标记。
samples.reference: After swapping an audio track, preserve its language tag and default-track flag when re-muxing.
samples.hypothesis: After replacing the audio track, when re-mixing the stream, the language tags and default track markers of the original track should be retained.

samples.source: 字幕时序校正要以可懂度为准，不为齐帧牺牲断句。
samples.reference: Let intelligibility rule subtitle timing fixes rather than aligning to frames.
samples.hypothesis: Subtitle timing correction should be based on intelligibility, without sacrificing punctuation for the sake of aligning frames.

samples.source: 配音时长超出画面时，优先调整语速而不是删内容。
samples.reference: When a dubbing runs long against the picture, adjust pacing before cutting content.
samples.hypothesis: When the dubbing duration exceeds the picture duration, prioritize adjusting the speaking speed rather than removing content.

samples.source: 把双语字幕上下排布会让每屏行数翻倍，需下调停留时间。
samples.reference: Stacking bilingual subtitles doubles lines per screen, so dwell time must shrink.
samples.hypothesis: Arranging the bilingual subtitles vertically will double the number of lines per screen, so the retention time needs to be reduced.

samples.source: 字幕文件的时间戳若早于视频起始偏移，播放器会丢弃该行。
samples.reference: The player drops subtitle lines whose timestamps precede the video's start offset.
samples.hypothesis: If the timestamp of the subtitle file is earlier than the video start offset, the player will discard that line.

samples.source: 导出前检查相邻字幕重叠，重叠会让阅读者不知读哪一行。
samples.reference: Check for overlapping subtitles before export; overlap leaves the reader unsure which line to read.
samples.hypothesis: Check the overlap of adjacent subtitle before export; overlap would make it unclear to the reader which line to read.

samples.source: 配音演员的分段间隔要留静音余量，便于后期对齐。
samples.reference: Leave silence padding between dubbing takes to make later alignment possible.
samples.hypothesis: The dubbing artist should leave a silence buffer between segments for easier alignment in later stages.

samples.source: 长视频的字幕分段建议按语义段落而不是固定秒数切。
samples.reference: Split subtitles for long video by semantic paragraphs rather than fixed seconds.
samples.hypothesis: It is recommended to segment the subtitle of long videos based on semantic paragraphs rather than fixed seconds.

samples.source: 字幕时序导出为帧率非整数素材时，必须用时间基而不是帧计数。
samples.reference: For non-integer frame rates, export subtitle timing in a timebase instead of frame counts.
samples.hypothesis: When exporting subtitle timing as a non-integer frame rate material, a time base must be used instead of frame counting.

samples.source: 音轨的响度目标要在混流前定，混完再压会牵连对白。
samples.reference: Set the loudness target before muxing; compressing afterwards also affects dialogue.
samples.hypothesis: The loudness target for the audio track should be determined before mixing, as mixing and compression together will affect the dialogue.

samples.source: 字幕断行遇到缩写与专有名词要有保护规则，避免误断。
samples.reference: Line breaking needs protection rules for abbreviations and proper names.
samples.hypothesis: Subtitle line breaks should follow a protection rule for abbreviations and proper nouns to prevent misinterpretation.

samples.source: 对口型素材若帧率不一致，要先统一到时间轴基准。
samples.reference: Normalize differing frame rates onto one timeline before any lip-sync work.
samples.hypothesis: If the lip sync materials have different frame rates, they need to be unified at the timeline baseline first.

samples.source: 字幕的省略号与破折号在语音合成里需要单独停顿规则。
samples.reference: Ellipses and dashes in subtitles need their own pause rules for speech synthesis.
samples.hypothesis: Subtitle ellipses and dashes require separate pause rules in text-to-speech.

samples.source: 配音质检要按语段回放，整片一次过会漏掉局部不同步。
samples.reference: Review dubbing speech segment by segment; one pass over the whole show misses local desync.
samples.hypothesis: The dubbing quality inspection should be done via speech segment playback, otherwise partial mismatches may be missed during a single pass through the whole film.

samples.source: 多语言交付里，字幕文件命名要含语言代码与来源标记。
samples.reference: In multilingual delivery, subtitle filenames carry the language code and provenance.
samples.hypothesis: In multi-language delivery, the subtitle file name should include the language code and source marker.

samples.source: 时间轴导出要包含轨道偏移与有效帧率两项元数据。
samples.reference: Timeline export must include track offsets and the effective frame rate.
samples.hypothesis: The timeline export should include two metadata items: track offset and effective frame rate.

samples.source: 字幕行的停留时长下限由字数决定，不由切换节奏决定。
samples.reference: A subtitle line's minimum dwell time is set by its length, not by cut rhythm.
samples.hypothesis: The minimum duration for a subtitle line is determined by the number of characters, not by the switching rhythm.

samples.source: 旁白与配乐同轨时，配音替换需要额外的分离步骤。
samples.reference: When narration shares a track with music, dubbing needs an extra separation step.
samples.hypothesis: When the voiceover and music are synced, additional separation steps are required for the dubbing.

samples.source: 字幕轨的字符集要在导出日志里记录，供现场排障。
samples.reference: Record the subtitle track's character set in the export log for field debugging.
samples.hypothesis: The character set of the subtitle track should be recorded in the export log for on-site troubleshooting.

samples.source: 声画同步测量要用人耳可辨的事件点，例如掌声与敲击。
samples.reference: Measure audio-video sync on audible events such as claps and strikes.
samples.hypothesis: Audio-video sync measurement should use event points that can be distinguished by the human ear, such as applause and tapping.

samples.source: 字幕对齐的人工抽检要覆盖首尾与中途，长素材中段最容易漂。
samples.reference: Spot-check subtitle alignment at the start, middle and end; the middle drifts most.
samples.hypothesis: Manual spot checks for subtitle alignment should cover both the beginning and end, as well as the middle, especially for long material where the middle part is prone to drift.

samples.source: 配音要按目标语言重排断句，直译长度常常超出画面。
samples.reference: Dubbing must re-break lines for the target language; literal length usually exceeds the picture.
samples.hypothesis: The dubbing should be reassembled with the target language punctuation, and literal translation often exceeds the picture duration.

samples.source: 字幕时序在丢帧素材上要记录丢帧位置，否则校正无据。
samples.reference: Log dropped-frame positions on subtitle timelines, or corrections have no basis.
samples.hypothesis: Subtitle timing should record the frame loss position on the frame loss material, otherwise the correction will be meaningless.

samples.source: 多轨合并时默认轨与强制轨标记要显式写入，不靠播放器猜。
samples.reference: Write default and forced track flags explicitly when merging tracks.
samples.hypothesis: When merging multiple tracks, the default track and forced track markers must be explicitly written, not relying on the player to guess.

samples.source: 导出双语字幕时，两种语言的停留时长要共同满足阅读速度约束。
samples.reference: When exporting bilingual subtitles, dwell time must satisfy one reading-speed bound for both languages.
samples.hypothesis: When exporting bilingual subtitles, the duration of each language should meet the reading speed constraints together.

samples.source: 缓冲不足会让字幕渲染出现整行闪烁，与内容无关。
samples.reference: Underrun in the buffer makes whole subtitle lines flicker, independent of content.
samples.hypothesis: Insufficient buffering will cause the subtitle to flicker line by line, which has nothing to do with the content.

samples.source: 分段计时表要能导出为对照清单，供配音现场按行取用。
samples.reference: Export the segment timing sheet as a checklist dubbing sessions can follow line by line.
samples.hypothesis: The segment timing sheet should be able to be exported as a checklist for use on the dubbing site by rows.

samples.source: 时间轴上的静默段也要保留编号，删除会造成后续错位。
samples.reference: Keep numbering for silent spans on the timeline; deleting one shifts everything after it.
samples.hypothesis: The silent segments on the timeline should also be retained with numbers; deletion would cause misalignment in the subsequent sequence.

samples.source: 音轨替换要同步替换时长元数据，只换负载会留下错长度。
samples.reference: Replacing an audio track must update its duration metadata, not just the payload.
samples.hypothesis: The audio track replacement should also synchronize the duration metadata, otherwise the wrong length will remain.

samples.source: 缓存命中率高不等于翻译质量好，缓存只说明这句话以前见过。
samples.reference: A high cache hit rate does not mean good translation quality; it only means the sentence was seen before.
samples.hypothesis: A high cache hit rate does not mean good translation quality; cache simply indicates that this sentence has been seen before.

samples.source: 这里的缓存指的是音频帧缓存，不要译成网页缓存。
samples.reference: The cache here is the audio frame cache, not a web cache.
samples.hypothesis: The cache here refers to audio frame cache, not web page cache.

samples.source: 预取缓存开太大时，最后一个语段的等待时间反而变长。
samples.reference: An over-large prefetch cache lengthens how long the last speech segment waits.
samples.hypothesis: When the prefetch cache is too large, the waiting time for the last speech segment becomes longer.

samples.source: 磁盘缓存在断电后仍然有效，所以失效策略要写清版本标识。
samples.reference: A disk cache survives power loss, so its invalidation policy needs a version tag.
samples.hypothesis: The disk cache remains valid after a power outage, so the invalidation strategy must include a version identifier.

samples.source: 缓存键必须含语言对与领域，否则跨领域复用会错配语境。
samples.reference: A cache key must include the language pair and domain, or cross-domain reuse mismatches context.
samples.hypothesis: The cache key must include a language pair and domain, otherwise cross-domain reuse will result in a mismatch in context.

samples.source: 编解码器升级后旧码流仍能解码，兼容矩阵要写进发布说明。
samples.reference: After a codec upgrade old streams still decode, and the compatibility matrix belongs in the release notes.
samples.hypothesis: After the codec upgrade, the old bitstream can still be decoded, and the compatibility notes should be included in the release instructions.

samples.source: 这个文件需要软编解码器而不是系统自带的那个。
samples.reference: This file needs the software codec rather than the system one.
samples.hypothesis: This file requires a software codec rather than the one built into the system.

samples.source: 编解码器协商要看双方都支持的档位，不能只看自己声明的列表。
samples.reference: Codec negotiation must look at what both sides support, not just one's own advertised list.
samples.hypothesis: Codec negotiation requires both parties to support the same level, not just the list they declare.

samples.source: 容器格式选错会让字幕轨被丢弃，即使视频轨看起来正常。
samples.reference: A wrong container format can drop the subtitle track even while video looks fine.
samples.hypothesis: Choosing the wrong container format will cause the subtitle track to be discarded, even if the video track appears normal.

samples.source: 同一段素材换容器格式封装后，时长元数据可能有几毫秒差异。
samples.reference: Re-muxing the same material into another container can shift duration metadata by a few milliseconds.
samples.hypothesis: After converting the same material into a container format, there may be a few milliseconds difference in the duration metadata.

samples.source: 混音要把对白、配乐与音效分轨处理，而不是在一条轨上叠。
samples.reference: A mix should treat dialogue, music and effects as separate stems rather than stacked on one track.
samples.hypothesis: The mixing process involves separating dialogue, music, and sound effects into separate tracks, rather than stacking them together on one track.

samples.source: 混音后的响度目标要按交付平台要求设定，不是越响越好。
samples.reference: Set the loudness target of the mix to the delivery platform's requirement, not as loud as possible.
samples.hypothesis: The target loudness of the mix should be set according to the delivery platform requirements, not the higher the better.

samples.source: 混音阶段保留头部空间，避免后期压缩再次抬升噪声。
samples.reference: Leave headroom during mixing so later compression does not lift the noise floor.
samples.hypothesis: Keep the headspace during mixing to avoid noise increase due to later compression.

samples.source: 分轨导出时每条轨的起始时间必须一致，否则合回会错位。
samples.reference: Exported stems must share one start time, or reassembling them misaligns.
samples.hypothesis: The start time of each track must be consistent during track export, otherwise the combination will be misaligned.

samples.source: 干声里残留的伴奏会被识别成语音，导致转写出现幻听内容。
samples.reference: Accompaniment left in the dry vocal is recognised as speech and invents transcript content.
samples.hypothesis: The background music remaining in the speech will be recognized as speech, resulting in幻听 content in the transcription.

samples.source: 配音的干声要单独留档，混音之后就无法再分离。
samples.reference: Keep the dubbing dry vocal archived on its own; after the mix it can no longer be separated.
samples.hypothesis: The dry sound in the dubbing should be stored separately and cannot be separated after mixing.

samples.source: 音轨表里的声道映射要按容器写，不按播放器显示顺序。
samples.reference: Map channels in the track table according to the container, not the player's display order.
samples.hypothesis: The audio channel mapping in the audio track table should be written according to the container, not the playbacker display order.

samples.source: 路由规则改一次就要重跑覆盖矩阵，否则报表描述的不是当前配置。
samples.reference: Rerun the coverage matrix after any change to the routing table, or the report describes a stale configuration.
samples.hypothesis: Every time the routing rules are changed, the coverage matrix needs to be rerun, otherwise the report will not reflect the current configuration.

samples.source: 这里的路由指引擎选择路由，不是网络路由表。
samples.reference: The routing here means engine selection, not a network routing table.
samples.hypothesis: The routing engine here selects routes, not the network routing table.

samples.source: 视频片段切片要以关键帧为界，否则会解出花屏。
samples.reference: Video clip cuts must land on keyframes, or the result decodes as corrupted.
samples.hypothesis: The video clip segments should be divided at keyframes to avoid screen distortion.

samples.source: 切片工具对无关键帧的长图像组支持有限，需要先重编码。
samples.reference: Splitting tools handle long groups of pictures poorly without re-encoding first.
samples.hypothesis: The slicing tool has limited support for long group of pictures without keyframes, and re-encoding is required first.

samples.source: 表格数据作为字幕源时要防公式注入，导出侧也要转义。
samples.reference: Spreadsheet data used as subtitle source needs formula-injection guards on both sides.
samples.hypothesis: When using table data as a subtitle source, prevent formula injection, and the export side should also escape characters.

samples.source: 表结构变更要向后兼容，旧素材没有新字段是常态。
samples.reference: Keep the table schema backward compatible; old assets without the new field are the norm.
samples.hypothesis: Table structure changes must be backward compatible, and it is common for old materials to lack new fields.

samples.source: 帧率是媒体属性不是剪辑属性，导出侧不要二次换算。
samples.reference: Frame rate is a media property, not an editing one; do not convert it twice on export.
samples.hypothesis: Frame rate is a media attribute, not a clip attribute, so no further conversion is needed from the export side.

samples.source: 模型的部分权重损坏时应整体拒绝加载，而不是静默补齐。
samples.reference: If part of the model weights are corrupt, refuse the checkpoint instead of silently filling in.
samples.hypothesis: When some weights of the model are damaged, the loading should be completely rejected instead of being silently restored.

samples.source: 词表不匹配时子词切分会退化成逐字符，推理质量随之崩塌。
samples.reference: On a vocabulary mismatch, subword tokenisation degrades to per-character and quality collapses.
samples.hypothesis: When the vocabulary does not match, the subword segmentation will degrade to character-by-character, and the inference quality will collapse.

samples.source: 流水线在队列满时给的是拒绝还是等待，必须是可观测的。
samples.reference: Whether the pipeline rejects or waits on a full queue has to be observable.
samples.hypothesis: The pipeline should indicate rejection or waiting when the queue is full, and this must be observable.

samples.source: 队列策略变更会影响首包延迟，回归里要一起看。
samples.reference: A queue policy change moves time to first packet, so keep it in the same regression.
samples.hypothesis: The queue strategy change will affect the first-packet latency, which needs to be checked together during the regression.

samples.source: 缓冲与缓冲区的译法在中文里同形，英文要统一为 buffer。
samples.reference: Buffering and buffer both read the same in Chinese; keep one English word for them.
samples.hypothesis: The translation for buffering and buffer is identical in Chinese; in English, it should be consistently rendered as buffer.

samples.source: 数据流与流式传输在文档里要区分，一个是内容一个是传输方式。
samples.reference: Separate the data stream from streaming transport in docs: one is content, the other is how it travels.
samples.hypothesis: The data stream and streaming transport should be distinguished in the document; one is the content and the other is the transmission method.

samples.source: 检查点是指模型权重还是任务断点，句子里要靠上下文消除歧义。
samples.reference: Say from context whether checkpoint means model weights or a resume point.
samples.hypothesis: Whether a checkpoint refers to model weights or task breaks, ambiguity in the sentence needs to be resolved through context.

samples.source: 流水线的段与语音分段段是两个概念，命名要分开。
samples.reference: A pipeline stage and a speech segment are different notions; name them apart.
samples.hypothesis: Segmentation of the pipeline and speech segmentation are two different concepts, and the naming should be distinct.

samples.source: 声道与通道在英文里是同一个词，所以中文界面必须按领域强制选一个。
samples.reference: Channel covers both senses in English, so the Chinese interface must pick one by domain instead of defaulting.
samples.hypothesis: Audio channel and channel are the same word in English, so the Chinese interface must force a choice based on the field.

samples.source: 关键帧与首帧不是同一件事，预览逻辑要按可解码帧判断。
samples.reference: A keyframe is not the first frame; preview logic must decide on decodable frames.
samples.hypothesis: A keyframe and the first frame are not the same thing; the preview logic should be based on decodable frames.

samples.source: 词元与子词在计费与切分上口径不同，报表不能混用。
samples.reference: Tokens and subwords differ for billing and for segmentation; do not share one metric.
samples.hypothesis: Tokens and subwords have different definitions in billing and segmentation, so they cannot be used interchangeably in reports.

samples.source: 比特率与码率在文档里统一用一个词，避免读者以为两项指标。
samples.reference: Keep bitrate and rate control terminology distinct but consistent, or readers see two metrics.
samples.hypothesis: In the document, bitrate and bitrate are used interchangeably to avoid confusing readers about the two metrics.

samples.source: 分块与批处理是两回事，分块是流式内的窗口。
samples.reference: Chunking is not batching; chunking is a window inside streaming, batching is a group of requests.
samples.hypothesis: Chunking and batch processing are two different things; chunking is a window within a stream.

samples.source: 重采样与重新量化都要声明，混在一起会掩盖质量损失。
samples.reference: Declare resampling and requantisation separately, or one hides the other's damage.
samples.hypothesis: Both resampling and re-quantization must be declared, as mixing them together will hide the quality loss.

samples.source: 编码器预设档位与质量参数冲突时应报错，不是静默取一个。
samples.reference: Error out when an encoder preset and an explicit quality flag conflict, rather than silently choosing one.
samples.hypothesis: When there is a conflict between the encoder preset gear and quality parameters, an error should be reported, not remain silent.

samples.source: 解码器在硬件与软件之间回退时，要记录回退原因。
samples.reference: Record why the decoder fell back from hardware to software.
samples.hypothesis: When the decoder retreats between hardware and software, the reason for the retreat should be recorded.

samples.source: 容器与编解码器的能力列表不一致，以容器约束为准。
samples.reference: When container and codec capabilities disagree, the container's constraint wins.
samples.hypothesis: The capability list for containers and codecs is inconsistent; follow the container constraints.

samples.source: 混音轨数超过容器上限时，要先给可执行提示再失败。
samples.reference: Warn before failing when the mix exceeds the container's track limit.
samples.hypothesis: When the number of audio tracks exceeds the container limit, an execution prompt must be given before the failure occurs.

samples.source: 干声质量决定配音可懂度，伴奏残留的代价是转写错字。
samples.reference: Dry vocal quality drives dubbing intelligibility; leftover accompaniment shows up as transcript errors.
samples.hypothesis: The dubbing intelligibility depends on the audio quality, and the cost of background music residues is transcription errors.

samples.source: 表格导入的字幕时长若缺列，要按行报错而不是补默认值。
samples.reference: Report the row when a subtitle sheet lacks a duration column, instead of defaulting it.
samples.hypothesis: If the subtitle duration of the table import is missing columns, errors should be reported per row instead of default values being filled in.

samples.source: 帧序号在跨段拼接后必须重排，否则解码顺序与显示顺序倒挂。
samples.reference: Renumber frames after concatenation, or decode order and display order invert.
samples.hypothesis: The frame sequence must be rearranged after segment concatenation, otherwise the decoding order will be reversed from the display order.

samples.source: 路由决策要能回读，只给结果不给路径无法排障。
samples.reference: Routing decisions must be readable back; a result without a path cannot be debugged.
samples.hypothesis: The routing decision should be readable back; only providing the result without the path makes it impossible to troubleshoot.

samples.source: 词表的领域覆盖决定子词切分好坏，通用词表在专名上会碎。
samples.reference: A vocabulary's domain coverage decides subword quality; a general one shreds proper nouns.
samples.hypothesis: The coverage of the vocabulary determines the quality of subword segmentation, and a general vocabulary will break down for specific terms.

samples.source: 缓存失效在跨版本场景要按语言对粒度，而不是全局清空。
samples.reference: Expire the cache per language pair across versions rather than clearing it globally.
samples.hypothesis: Cache invalidation in cross-version scenarios should be performed at the language pair level, rather than a global clear.

samples.source: 自动评测不能替代人工评测，窄域上指标与人工打分相关性明显下降。
samples.reference: Automatic evaluation cannot replace human review; on narrow domains the correlation drops sharply.
samples.hypothesis: Automatic evaluation cannot replace manual evaluation, and the correlation between metrics and manual scoring in narrow domains decreases significantly.

samples.source: 抽样评测要按子领域分层，否则长尾问题看不见。
samples.reference: Sample evaluations must stratify by sub-domain, or the long tail stays invisible.
samples.hypothesis: The sampling evaluation should be stratified by sub-domains; otherwise, long-tail issues will be invisible.

samples.source: 中文语音评测以字符错误率为主指标，词错误率依赖分词口径。
samples.reference: Chinese speech evaluation leans on character error rate, because word error rate depends on a tokenisation convention.
samples.hypothesis: The Chinese speech evaluation focuses primarily on the character error rate, while the word error rate depends on the word segmentation criteria.

samples.source: 对照实验只改一个变量，同时改注入策略与上限会让结果无法归因。
samples.reference: Change one variable per experiment; altering injection policy and its cap together makes results unattributable.
samples.hypothesis: In contrast experiments, changing only one variable while also altering the injection strategy and upper limit makes it impossible to attribute the results.

samples.source: 评测样本要覆盖短句、中句、长句三档，失败模式各不相同。
samples.reference: Evaluation samples should cover short, medium and long sentences; their failure modes differ.
samples.hypothesis: The testing sample should cover short sentences, medium sentences, and long sentences, with different failure modes.

samples.source: 回归基线一旦发布就要固定种子与时间戳，便于复现。
samples.reference: Once a regression baseline is published, fix the seed and timestamp so it can be reproduced.
samples.hypothesis: Once the regression baseline is released, the seed and timestamp should be fixed for easy reproduction.

samples.source: 统计显著性不等于实际显著，零点几个百分点要看是否影响体感。
samples.reference: Statistical significance is not practical significance; check whether a few tenths reach the user.
samples.hypothesis: Statistical significance is not equal to practical significance; a few percentage points are not enough to determine whether it affects the perception.

samples.source: 负结论也要同样口径报告，不能只报成功的那一轮。
samples.reference: Report negative results under the same discipline, not only the round that worked.
samples.hypothesis: Negative conclusions should also be reported in the same format, and only the successful rounds should be reported.

samples.source: 评测重跑要限定范围参数，否则会把其他引擎的既有证据覆盖掉。
samples.reference: Scope a rerun explicitly, or it overwrites evidence belonging to other engines.
samples.hypothesis: The retest should limit the scope of parameters, otherwise it will cover up the existing evidence of other engines.

samples.source: 分母里不能混入失败行，否则会把引擎故障报成质量下降。
samples.reference: Do not leave failed rows in the denominator, or an engine fault reads as a quality drop.
samples.hypothesis: No failed rows should be mixed in the denominator, otherwise it will report engine failure as a quality decline.

samples.source: 同臂复采给出噪声地板，落在地板内的差值不足以归因。
samples.reference: Same-arm repeats give the noise floor; a delta inside it cannot be attributed.
samples.hypothesis: The same arm re-collection produces noise on the floor, and the difference within the floor is insufficient to be attributed.

samples.source: 指标行要能追到一次可复现运行，含脚本、样本与时间。
samples.reference: Every metric row must trace to one reproducible run with script, samples and time.
samples.hypothesis: The metric row should allow tracking a reproducible run, including the script, sample, and time.

samples.source: 人工抽检的污染率要有实测来源，不能沿用旧一轮的估计。
samples.reference: Keep a measured source for spot-checked contamination rates instead of reusing an old estimate.
samples.hypothesis: The contamination rate for manual random inspections must have empirical data, and cannot rely on previous estimates.

samples.source: 评测脚本要进版本控制，仓外的一次性脚本无人能复核。
samples.reference: Keep evaluation scripts under version control; a one-off script outside the repo cannot be re-checked.
samples.hypothesis: The testing script should be under version control, and one-off scripts outside the repository cannot be reviewed.

samples.source: 配对比较要按同一批句子，不同窗口的均值差不是效果。
samples.reference: Pair on the same sentences; a difference between unlike windows is not an effect.
samples.hypothesis: The pairing comparison should be based on the same set of sentences; the mean difference across different windows is not relevant.

samples.source: 留出集要真留出，参与过调优的样本不能当评测集。
samples.reference: Hold-out means held out; samples that took part in tuning cannot be the evaluation set.
samples.hypothesis: The holdout set must be truly held out, and sample that has participated in optimization should not be used as the evaluation set.

samples.source: 报告要写清局限，分布差异不外推到未覆盖的领域。
samples.reference: State limitations plainly; do not extrapolate a distribution beyond the domains it covers.
samples.hypothesis: The report should clearly state the limitations, and differences in distribution should not be inferred to uncovered areas.

samples.source: 每个对外数字都要有实测来源，估计值一律标注为估算。
samples.reference: Every published number needs a measured source; label estimates as estimates.
samples.hypothesis: Every external figure must have a measured source, and estimates are marked as such.

samples.source: 同一指标的多次运行要区分身份，避免新跑覆盖旧证。
samples.reference: Give repeated runs of one metric distinct identities so a new run cannot replace the old evidence.
samples.hypothesis: Multiple runs of the same metric should differentiate identities to prevent new runs from overwriting old records.

samples.source: 评测语料的许可要过门禁，不允许传染性许可进入产物。
samples.reference: Evaluation corpora must pass the license gate; no copyleft licence may enter the artefacts.
samples.hypothesis: The permission for the evaluation data must pass the access control, and infectious permissions are not allowed to enter the products.

samples.source: 子领域分组的边界要写进配置，不能靠人记住行号。
samples.reference: Record sub-domain group boundaries in config, not in someone's memory of line numbers.
samples.hypothesis: The boundaries of sub-domain groups should be included in the configuration, and it cannot rely on people remembering line numbers.

samples.source: 自动分数的绝对值不适合作承诺，相对差与人工判断才可靠。
samples.reference: Absolute automatic scores make poor promises; relative deltas plus human review hold.
samples.hypothesis: The absolute value of the automatic score is not a reliable guarantee; only the relative difference and manual judgment are trustworthy.

samples.source: 抽样规模不足时报告要拒绝判定，而不是给出乐观数字。
samples.reference: Refuse to conclude under an insufficient sample rather than printing an optimistic number.
samples.hypothesis: When the sampling size is insufficient, the report should reject the determination, rather than providing optimistic figures.

samples.source: 评测脚本的失败要非零退出，静默通过会骗过后续流程。
samples.reference: Fail non-zero in evaluation scripts; a silent pass misleads everything downstream.
samples.hypothesis: The test script failure must have a non-zero exit code; a silent pass would deceive the subsequent process.

samples.source: 回归集扩样时旧行的顺序不可改动，否则历史数字不再可比。
samples.reference: Never reorder existing rows when growing a regression set, or past numbers stop being comparable.
samples.hypothesis: The order of old rows cannot be changed during the regression set expansion, otherwise historical numbers become incomparable.

samples.source: 指标口径变更要另立一次变更，不与数据扩充同批合入。
samples.reference: Land a metric-definition change in its own commit, not together with corpus growth.
samples.hypothesis: The change in indicator criteria requires a separate change, and it is not combined with data expansion in the same batch.

samples.source: 评测环境要有前置声明，宿主服务在跑与否会改变结论。
samples.reference: State the evaluation environment up front; whether a host service is running changes the conclusion.
samples.hypothesis: The evaluation environment should have a pre-release statement, as whether the host service is running or not will affect the conclusion.

samples.source: 人工评测的标注规范要先写，事后统一会引入回看偏差。
samples.reference: Write the annotation guideline before human review, or hindsight biases the labels.
samples.hypothesis: The annotation guidelines for manual evaluation should be established first, and the review deviations will be incorporated later.

samples.source: 对照组与实验组必须同机同版本，跨机对比不成立。
samples.reference: Control and treatment need the same machine and build; cross-machine comparison is void.
samples.hypothesis: The control group and experimental group must use the same machine and version; comparison across machines is not valid.

samples.source: 指标下降要先排除测量层，再怀疑模型能力。
samples.reference: Rule out the measurement layer before blaming the model when a metric drops.
samples.hypothesis: The decline in metrics should first rule out the measurement layer, and then doubt the model's capabilities.

samples.source: 可复现要求包含数据、脚本、时间与环境四项，缺一即不成立。
samples.reference: Reproducibility needs data, script, timestamp and environment; one missing voids it.
samples.hypothesis: The reproducibility requirements include four aspects: data, script, time, and environment. Any omission makes it non-compliant.

samples.source: 评测结果入库前要校验自描述字段，缺身份的证据不可引用。
samples.reference: Verify self-describing fields before storing evidence; anonymous artefacts cannot be cited.
samples.hypothesis: Verify the self-description field before storing the evaluation results, and evidence lacking identity cannot be referenced.

samples.source: 统计区间要同时报置信区间与样本量，只报均值没有意义。
samples.reference: Report the confidence interval with the sample size; a bare mean carries no information.
samples.hypothesis: The statistical interval should report both the confidence interval and the sample size, as reporting only the mean is meaningless.

samples.source: 边界样本要专挑易歧义词，随机抽样测不出领域敏感度。
samples.reference: Build boundary probes around ambiguous words; random sampling cannot measure domain sensitivity.
samples.hypothesis: Boundary sample should specifically choose words with ambiguous meanings, and random sampling cannot detect domain sensitivity.

samples.source: 涉密项目的批量本地化通常要现场部署，遥测与外呼都要能整体关闭。
samples.reference: Classified batch localization normally runs on site, with telemetry and any outbound call closeable as a whole.
samples.hypothesis: For confidential projects, batch localization usually requires on-site deployment, and both remote sensing and external calls must be disabled as a whole.

samples.source: 离线整合包交付时模型与词表都不能靠运行时下载。
samples.reference: In an offline delivery bundle, neither models nor vocabularies may rely on runtime downloads.
samples.hypothesis: When the offline bundle is delivered, neither the model nor the vocabulary can be downloaded during runtime.

samples.source: 隐私模式关闭的是升级通路，而不是把原文送去云端处理。
samples.reference: Privacy mode closes the upgrade path rather than sending source text to the cloud.
samples.hypothesis: The privacy mode turns off the upgrade path, rather than sending the data to the cloud for processing.

samples.source: 日志里不得出现原文片段，用户素材本身就是敏感内容。
samples.reference: Logs must not carry source fragments; the user's material is itself sensitive.
samples.hypothesis: No original text fragments should appear in the logs, and the user materials themselves are sensitive content.

samples.source: 导出文件时要检查元数据，轨道名与作者字段常会带上项目信息。
samples.reference: Check metadata on export: track titles and author fields often leak project names.
samples.hypothesis: Check the metadata when exporting the file, and the track name and author fields often contain project information.

samples.source: 审计记录只保留决策依据，不保留被翻译的正文。
samples.reference: Audit records keep the basis of a decision, never the translated text.
samples.hypothesis: Audit records only retain the decision basis, not the translated text.

samples.source: 本地化产物交给第三方前，要确认术语表里没有内部代号。
samples.reference: Before handing deliverables to a third party, confirm the glossary holds no internal codenames.
samples.hypothesis: Before handing over the localized products to a third party, ensure that there are no internal codes in the glossary.

samples.source: 禁用联网要能在配置层整体生效，而不是逐条网络调用点拦截。
samples.reference: Cutting network access has to work as one configuration switch, not per call site.
samples.hypothesis: Disabling networking must be effective at the configuration level, rather than intercepting each network call point individually.

samples.source: 用户清空记忆库要连带清除派生的术语条目，否则残留仍会回显。
samples.reference: Clearing the translation memory must also clear term rows derived from it, or they keep resurfacing.
samples.hypothesis: The user clears the memory database and also removes the derived terms, otherwise the remnants will still appear.

samples.source: 现场部署的机器没有外网，安装介质要自带全部依赖与校验和。
samples.reference: A site machine has no outbound access, so the media must carry every dependency and its checksum.
samples.hypothesis: The on-site deployed machines have no external network, and the installation media must carry all dependencies and checks by itself.

samples.source: 版本回滚要能连带回滚术语表与记忆库结构，避免旧版读坏新格式。
samples.reference: A rollback must cover the glossary and memory schema, or an old build misreads a new format.
samples.hypothesis: Version rollback should include the rollback glossary and memory database structure to prevent old formats from affecting new formats.

samples.source: 许可审计要覆盖运行时才出现的依赖声明，不只是构建清单里的。
samples.reference: The licence audit must cover dependencies that appear only at runtime, not just the build manifest.
samples.hypothesis: Permission auditing should cover dependency declarations that appear only during runtime, not just those in the build manifest.

samples.source: 敏感素材要按项目隔离记忆库，避免跨项目串味。
samples.reference: Keep separate memory stores per project for sensitive material, to avoid cross-project bleed.
samples.hypothesis: Sensitive materials should be isolated in a memory database by project to prevent cross-project interference.

samples.source: 诊断接口在隐私模式下也要可用，它自身不得发出网络请求。
samples.reference: The diagnostics endpoint must stay available under privacy mode and issue no requests itself.
samples.hypothesis: The diagnostic interface must remain available in privacy mode, and it itself shall not send any network requests.

samples.source: 禁用云引擎后仍要如实说明结果来自本地，不让人误以为已升级。
samples.reference: After disabling cloud engines, still state plainly that the result is local rather than implying an upgrade.
samples.hypothesis: Even after disabling the cloud engine, it is still necessary to clearly state that the result comes from local sources to avoid giving the impression that it has been upgraded.

samples.source: 现场排障的日志级别要能临时提升并自动回落，避免长期输出细节。
samples.reference: On-site log levels should be raised temporarily and revert, rather than emitting detail forever.
samples.hypothesis: The log level for on-site troubleshooting should be able to be temporarily increased and automatically reduced, avoiding the long-term display of details.

samples.source: 交付前的检查清单要包含字体、编码与语言代码三项一致性。
samples.reference: A pre-delivery checklist must cover consistency of font, encoding and language code.
samples.hypothesis: The checklist before delivery should include consistency in font, encoding, and language code.

samples.source: 批量任务的中断与续跑按片段记录进度，不保留原文正文。
samples.reference: Record resume progress per segment for batch jobs, without keeping the source text.
samples.hypothesis: Batch tasks are interrupted and resumed in segments, without retaining the original content.

samples.source: 访问控制未实现前，对外服务面必须保持为本机回环。
samples.reference: Until access control exists, the exposed service surface must stay loopback-only.
samples.hypothesis: Before access control is implemented, the external service interface must remain as local loopback.

samples.source: 术语表按领域发布时不得携带用户私有条目。
samples.reference: A published domain glossary must not carry a user's private rows.
samples.hypothesis: When publishing the glossary by domain, private user entries must not be included.

samples.source: 导出包要能出具内容清单，供客户方核对是否含敏感字段。
samples.reference: Export bundles should ship a manifest so the customer can check for sensitive fields.
samples.hypothesis: The export package should provide a content list for the client to verify whether there are sensitive fields.

samples.source: 遥测默认关闭比默认开启加开关更安全，误操作的成本不对称。
samples.reference: Telemetry off by default is safer than on by default with a switch; the cost of a mistake is asymmetric.
samples.hypothesis: Defaultly turning telemetry off is safer than turning it on, and the cost of accidental operation is asymmetric.

samples.source: 文档示例要用合成素材，不能直接粘贴客户真实稿件。
samples.reference: Use synthetic material in docs, never a client's real transcript.
samples.hypothesis: Document examples should use composite materials, not directly paste the client's actual manuscripts.

samples.source: 密钥与访问令牌不写入仓库，包括测试用的假值。
samples.reference: Keep keys and tokens out of the repository, including fake ones used in tests.
samples.hypothesis: Keys and access tokens are not stored in the repository, including fake values for testing.

samples.source: 清除数据要给出可核对的完成回执，而不是静默返回成功。
samples.reference: Clearing data must return a verifiable receipt rather than a bare success.
samples.hypothesis: A confirmation receipt confirming the completion of data deletion must be provided, rather than silently returning a success status.

samples.source: 离线环境的模型获取要能校验来源，避免下载链路成为攻击面。
samples.reference: Verify model provenance in offline environments, so the download path does not become the attack surface.
samples.hypothesis: The model obtained in the offline environment should be verified for origin to prevent the download link from becoming a attack surface.

samples.source: 合规检查里最容易被忽略的是导出文件的元数据字段。
samples.reference: The metadata fields of exported files are the most overlooked compliance item.
samples.hypothesis: The metadata fields of the export files are the most easily overlooked in compliance checks.

samples.source: 客户现场的问题复现要用最小样本，避免整批素材外流。
samples.reference: Reproduce field issues with a minimal sample, so a whole batch never leaves the site.
samples.hypothesis: Use the minimum sample to reproduce the customer's issues on site, and prevent the entire batch of materials from leaking out.

samples.source: 权限分级未实现前，共享终端上的记忆库要按目录隔离。
samples.reference: Until roles exist, isolate memory stores by directory on shared terminals.
samples.hypothesis: Before permission grading is implemented, the memory library on shared terminals should be isolated by directory.

samples.source: 审计日志的保留期要与交付合同一致，不默认长期保存。
samples.reference: Align audit retention with the delivery contract instead of keeping records by default.
samples.hypothesis: The retention period of audit logs should be consistent with the delivery contract, and long-term storage is not enabled by default.

samples.source: 删除操作的语义要区分逻辑标记与物理清除，两者不可混写。
samples.reference: Separate logical flagging from physical erasure in delete operations.
samples.hypothesis: The semantics of deletion operations should distinguish between logical markers and physical removal; they cannot be mixed together.

samples.source: 敏感域的评测样本不能出现在公开基准里。
samples.reference: Sensitive-domain evaluation samples cannot appear in a public benchmark.
samples.hypothesis: Sample from the sensitive domain cannot appear in public benchmarks.

samples.source: 交付前要把用户数据目录从打包产物中排除并复核。
samples.reference: Exclude and re-check the user data directory from packaged artefacts before delivery.
samples.hypothesis: Before delivery, the user data directory should be excluded from the packaged product and verified again.

samples.source: 本地化项目交接时，术语表与记忆库要分别签署授权范围。
samples.reference: On project handover, sign the scope for the glossary and the memory store separately.
samples.hypothesis: When handing over a localization project, the glossary and the memory database should have separate authorization scopes.

samples.source: 隐私不变量由测试锁死比由文档承诺更可靠。
samples.reference: Privacy invariants held by a test are worth more than privacy promises in a document.
samples.hypothesis: The privacy invariant is more reliable than the documentation promise, as it is locked in by testing.

samples.source: 被禁用的功能要在界面上明说被禁用，而不是隐藏入口。
samples.reference: Disable a feature visibly, rather than hiding its entry point.
samples.hypothesis: Disabled features should be clearly indicated on the interface rather than hiding the access.

samples.source: 客户环境的网络代理会改变探测结论，检查要区分不可达与未配置。
samples.reference: A customer's proxy changes probe results, so separate unreachable from unconfigured.
samples.hypothesis: The network proxy in the customer environment can change the detection results; it is necessary to distinguish between unreachable and not configured.

samples.source: 默认配置要选保守的一档，把放开选项写进需要显式操作的地方。
samples.reference: Ship the conservative default and require an explicit action to loosen it.
samples.hypothesis: The default configuration should be set to the conservative level, and the relaxation options should be written in places that require explicit operation.

samples.source: 导出失败时不要把部分文件留在目标目录，先写临时再改名。
samples.reference: Leave no partial file behind on export failure: write to a staging name then rename.
samples.hypothesis: Don't leave some files in the target directory when the export fails. Write them as temporary files first and then rename them.

samples.source: 临时文件的名称必须唯一，固定名在并发下会互相删错。
samples.reference: Staging names must be unique; a fixed one deletes the wrong file under concurrency.
samples.hypothesis: The name of a temporary file must be unique, and fixed names may be deleted incorrectly during concurrency.

samples.source: 断网演练要覆盖首次安装，验证没有隐藏的外部请求。
samples.reference: Run a disconnected drill of first install to prove no hidden outbound requests exist.
samples.hypothesis: The network disconnection experiment should cover the first installation and verify that there are no hidden external requests.

samples.source: 模型文件的完整性校验要包含大小与摘要两项。
samples.reference: Integrity checking of model files should cover both size and digest.
samples.hypothesis: The integrity verification of the model file should include both size and summary.

samples.source: 现场版本升级要能只回滚配置而不丢用户已确认的术语。
samples.reference: A field upgrade must be able to roll back config alone, keeping confirmed terms.
samples.hypothesis: The on-site version upgrade should allow rollback of configurations without losing the terms confirmed by users.

samples.source: 可复核性要求日志能指出决策来自哪一层，而不是只给结果。
samples.reference: Logs must name the layer a decision came from, not just the outcome.
samples.hypothesis: Revisability requirement ensures that logs indicate which layer the decision originated from, rather than just providing the result.

samples.source: 数据出境受限时，云端引擎即便可达也不得进入路由。
samples.reference: When data may not leave the country, cloud engines stay out of routing even if reachable.
samples.hypothesis: When data export is restricted, the cloud engine cannot enter the routing even if it can reach it.

samples.source: 交付包的哈希与版本号一起记录，便于追溯现场实际装了什么。
samples.reference: Record the delivery package's digest with its version to trace what was installed.
samples.hypothesis: The hash and version number of the delivery package are recorded together to facilitate tracking what was actually installed on site.

samples.source: 删除记忆库后术语表仍可能被蒸馏回填，要能关闭该通路。
samples.reference: After clearing the memory, term harvesting can still refill it, so allow closing that path.
samples.hypothesis: After deleting the memory library, the glossary may still be backfilled by distillation, and this pathway should be disabled.

samples.source: 用户确认过的条目要能标注为不可再分发。
samples.reference: Rows a user confirmed can be marked non-redistributable.
samples.hypothesis: Items confirmed by the user should be marked as non-re distributable.

samples.source: 内部构建产物要能整体签名，安全策略才会放行加载。
samples.reference: Internal build artefacts need full signing, or platform security blocks loading.
samples.hypothesis: The internal build output must be fully signed for the security policy to allow its loading.

samples.source: 评估一份交付风险要看数据流向而不是看功能数量。
samples.reference: Judge delivery risk by where data flows, not by how many features exist.
samples.hypothesis: Evaluating delivery risks should focus on the data stream rather than the number of functions.

samples.source: 交付离线整合包时要一次带上引擎、模型、词表与校验清单。
samples.reference: An offline bundle ships the engine, models, vocabularies and a checksum manifest together.
samples.hypothesis: When delivering the offline bundle, include the engine, model, vocabulary, and verification checklist in one go.

samples.source: 安装包要能在无管理员权限下装到用户目录。
samples.reference: The installer must work into a user directory without elevation.
samples.hypothesis: The installation package should be able to be installed in the user directory without admin privileges.

samples.source: 构建产物全部签名，否则系统的应用控制会拦截本地加载。
samples.reference: Sign every build artefact, or platform application control blocks local loading.
samples.hypothesis: All build artifacts must be signed; otherwise, the system's application control will block local loading.

samples.source: 安装路径含非拉丁字符时，动态库加载要能正确解析。
samples.reference: Handle non-Latin characters in the install path when loading the native library.
samples.hypothesis: When the installation path contains non-Latin characters, the dynamic library loading must be able to parse correctly.

samples.source: 升级安装要保留用户数据目录，并迁移其结构版本。
samples.reference: An upgrade keeps the user data directory and migrates its schema version.
samples.hypothesis: The upgrade installation requires preserving the user data directory and migrating its structural version.

samples.source: 卸载时数据目录的处置要显式询问，不默认删除。
samples.reference: Ask what to do with the data directory on uninstall; never delete by default.
samples.hypothesis: The handling of the data directory should be explicitly requested during uninstallation, and deletion is not done by default.

samples.source: 打包脚本要列出被收录的二进制清单，避免漏签与漏装。
samples.reference: The packaging step should enumerate included binaries, so nothing is unsigned or missing.
samples.hypothesis: The packaging script should list the included binary list to avoid missing signatures and installations.

samples.source: 绿色版与安装版共用同一份配置解析规则，避免行为分叉。
samples.reference: Keep one config resolution rule across portable and installed forms, or behaviour forks.
samples.hypothesis: The green version and installation version share the same configuration parsing rules to avoid behavior divergence.

samples.source: 运行时依赖版本要锁定，浮动的次版本会改变推理结果。
samples.reference: Pin runtime dependency versions; a floating minor version can change inference output.
samples.hypothesis: The runtime dependency version must be locked, and floating minor versions will alter the inference results.

samples.source: 构建机与开发机不一致时，以可复现的干净环境为准。
samples.reference: When build and dev machines differ, the clean reproducible one is authoritative.
samples.hypothesis: When the build machine and development machine are inconsistent, prioritize a reproducible clean environment.

samples.source: 交付清单要写清哪些模型需另行获取，避免装机后才发现缺件。
samples.reference: State which models must be fetched separately, so a gap is not found after installation.
samples.hypothesis: The delivery list should specify which models need to be obtained separately to avoid discovering missing components after installation.

samples.source: 打包体积增长要能归因到具体新增项，别只报总大小。
samples.reference: Attribute growth in package size to a specific addition, rather than reporting a total.
samples.hypothesis: The increase in packaging volume should be attributed to specific added items, not just the total size.

samples.source: 安装后自检要覆盖动态库加载与模型可读两项。
samples.reference: A post-install self-check must cover loading the native library and reading a model.
samples.hypothesis: After installation, the self-check should cover both dynamic library loading and model readability.

samples.source: 现场无外网时，更新机制要支持离线补丁包。
samples.reference: With no outbound access, the update path must accept an offline patch package.
samples.hypothesis: When there is no external network at the site, the update mechanism should support offline patch packages.

samples.source: 配置热更新未实现前，改配置要能在文档里指明需重启哪一层。
samples.reference: Until hot reload exists, document which layer a config change restarts.
samples.hypothesis: Before hot update configuration is implemented, the layer that requires restarting should be indicated in the documentation.

samples.source: 崩溃报告默认不收集正文，只收集调用位置与版本。
samples.reference: Crash reports collect location and version by default, never the text.
samples.hypothesis: The crash report does not collect the main text by default, only the call location and version.

samples.source: 打包时排除缓存目录，避免把开发机的记忆库一起发出去。
samples.reference: Exclude cache directories when packaging, so a developer's memory store is never shipped.
samples.hypothesis: Exclude the cache directory during packaging to prevent sending the development machine's memory cache along.

samples.source: 双平台各配一个薄壳入口，逻辑只放在脚本主体里。
samples.reference: Keep one thin launcher per OS and put the logic in the shared script.
samples.hypothesis: Each of the two platforms has a thin shell entry, and the logic is placed within the script body.

samples.source: 构建脚本要能只跳过已完成且哈希未变的阶段。
samples.reference: The build script must skip a stage whose inputs are unchanged by digest.
samples.hypothesis: The build script should skip only the stages that have been completed and have no change in hash.

samples.source: 干净构建要能一条命令复现，避免依赖历史产物。
samples.reference: A clean build must be reproducible with one command, without relying on prior artefacts.
samples.hypothesis: Clean build should be reproducible with a single command to avoid reliance on historical artifacts.

samples.source: 版本信息要在界面与诊断接口一致显示。
samples.reference: Show the same version string in the UI and in diagnostics.
samples.hypothesis: Version information should be displayed consistently with the interface and diagnostic interface.

samples.source: 交付物要包含许可矩阵，覆盖随包分发的一切第三方成分。
samples.reference: Ship a licence matrix covering every third-party component in the package.
samples.hypothesis: The delivery must include the permission matrix, covering all third-party components distributed with the package.

samples.source: 模型文件过大时按语言对拆分下载，避免首装全量拉取。
samples.reference: Split model downloads per language pair so a first install fetches nothing wholesale.
samples.hypothesis: When the model file is too large, split it by language pair for download to avoid downloading the entire file at first installation.

samples.source: 装机脚本要幂等，重复执行不产生第二份配置。
samples.reference: Keep install scripting idempotent; running it twice must not create a second config.
samples.hypothesis: The installation script must be idempotent; repeated execution should not create a second configuration.

samples.source: 安装失败要留下可读的原因文件，而不是只有弹窗。
samples.reference: On failure leave a readable reason file, not just a dialog.
samples.hypothesis: Leave a readable reason file for installation failure, instead of just a pop-up.

samples.source: 现场排障优先加诊断输出，而不是先改代码复现。
samples.reference: Prefer extra diagnostics when debugging in the field, rather than editing code to reproduce it.
samples.hypothesis: Prioritize on-site troubleshooting and diagnostic output, rather than immediately fixing the code to reproduce the issue.

samples.source: 打包链路的每一步产物都要有校验和，避免半传文件进入安装。
samples.reference: Checksum every stage of the packaging chain so a truncated file never reaches an installer.
samples.hypothesis: Every output of the packaging step of the link should have a verification, to prevent half-transferred files from entering the installation.

samples.source: 交付版本与仓库提交要能一一对应，便于事后追溯。
samples.reference: Map each delivered version to a repository commit for later tracing.
samples.hypothesis: The delivery version and repository submission must be matched precisely for easy traceability later.

samples.source: 默认数据目录的解析规则要在各语言绑定之间保持一致。
samples.reference: Keep the default data-directory rule identical across bindings.
samples.hypothesis: The parsing rules for the default data directory should be consistent across different language bindings.

samples.source: 跨机器复现问题需要同时给出版本、配置与模型清单。
samples.reference: Reproducing an issue across machines needs version, config and a model inventory.
samples.hypothesis: To reproduce the issue across machines, it is necessary to provide the version, configuration, and model list simultaneously.

samples.source: 安装介质要校验自身完整性再开始复制文件。
samples.reference: Verify installer integrity before copying any file.
samples.hypothesis: The installation medium must verify its integrity before starting file copying.

samples.source: 交付时把复现命令一起写进说明，客户才能自己重跑。
samples.reference: Include the reproduction command so a customer can rerun measurements alone.
samples.hypothesis: Write the reproduction command into the description during delivery so the customer can run it again by themselves.

samples.source: 打包要区分开发构建与发布构建的产物路径。
samples.reference: Separate development and release output paths in packaging.
samples.hypothesis: Packaging should differentiate the output paths of development build and release build.

samples.source: 无网络环境下要能只装文档与工具而不装模型。
samples.reference: Allow installing docs and tools without models where there is no network.
samples.hypothesis: In a no-network environment, only documents and tools should be installed, not the model.

samples.source: 包内脚本文本模式写入会带平台换行，按字节写更稳。
samples.reference: Write packaged scripts byte-wise; text mode sneaks platform line endings in.
samples.hypothesis: The script text mode writing within the package includes platform line breaks, and writing in bytes is more stable.

samples.source: 发布构建要能在流水线里复现同一哈希，否则版本不可信。
samples.reference: A release build must be reproducible to the same hash in CI, or a version number means little.
samples.hypothesis: The release build must produce the same hash in the pipeline, otherwise the version is not trustworthy.

samples.source: 装机后的首次启动体验要有明确路径，避免用户停在空白界面。
samples.reference: The first launch after install needs a guided path, not an empty window.
samples.hypothesis: The first startup experience after installation should have a clear path to avoid users getting stuck on a blank screen.

samples.source: 安装包的版本号要与运行时自检报出的版本一致。
samples.reference: Keep the installer's version equal to what the runtime self-check reports.
samples.hypothesis: The version number of the installation package must be consistent with the version reported by the runtime self-check.

samples.source: 依赖锁定文件要随包发布，便于现场复核。
samples.reference: Ship the lockfile with the package so a site can re-check dependencies.
samples.hypothesis: The dependency lock files should be released with the package for easy verification on site.

samples.source: 构建产物目录要与源码目录分离，避免误提交二进制。
samples.reference: Keep build output separate from sources so binaries never get committed.
samples.hypothesis: The build output directory should be separated from the source code directory to avoid accidental submission of binaries.

samples.source: 现场升级前先备份数据目录，失败时能整目录还原。
samples.reference: Back up the data directory before a field upgrade so a failure restores wholesale.
samples.hypothesis: Back up the data directory before the on-site upgrade, and it can be restored by restoring the entire directory in case of failure.

samples.source: 打包时剔除测试夹具与开发脚本，减少体积与误用面。
samples.reference: Strip test fixtures and dev scripts from packaging, cutting size and misuse.
samples.hypothesis: Remove test fixtures and development scripts during packaging to reduce size and minimize misuse.

samples.source: 交付文档里的命令要与实际入口一致，避免过期写法。
samples.reference: Keep commands in delivered docs matching real entry points, or they rot.
samples.hypothesis: The commands in the delivery document should be consistent with the actual entry points to avoid outdated wording.

samples.source: 构建脚本失败要非零退出并指明失败阶段。
samples.reference: A failing build step must exit non-zero and name the stage.
samples.hypothesis: The build script failed; non-zero exit code and failure stage should be indicated.

samples.source: 发布说明要写清哪些行为变化会影响既有指标的对比。
samples.reference: Release notes must state which behaviour changes break comparison with prior metrics.
samples.hypothesis: The release instructions should specify which behavioral changes will affect the comparison of existing metrics.

samples.source: 安装介质体积上限由首装网络条件决定，而不是由功能数量决定。
samples.reference: Package size is bounded by first-install network conditions, not by feature count.
samples.hypothesis: The maximum volume of the installation medium is determined by the initial network conditions, not by the number of functions.

samples.source: 现场环境差异要靠诊断接口回读，而不是靠聊天记录推断。
samples.reference: Read field differences back through diagnostics instead of inferring them from chat.
samples.hypothesis: The differences in the on-site environment should be determined by reading back from the diagnostic interface, rather than inferring from chat records.

samples.source: 交付物要能在目标机上离线验证哈希一致。
samples.reference: Artefacts must be verifiable offline on the target machine.
samples.hypothesis: The delivery must be able to verify consistent hash offline on the target machine.

samples.source: 打包链路要能只重建受影响的部分，缩短反馈。
samples.reference: Rebuild only what a change affects, to keep packaging feedback short.
samples.hypothesis: The packaging link should only rebuild the affected parts to reduce feedback.

samples.source: 版本兼容承诺要写明弃用窗口长度，便于客户排期。
samples.reference: State the deprecation window in compatibility promises so customers can plan.
samples.hypothesis: The version compatibility commitment should specify the deprecation window length for easier customer scheduling.

samples.source: 发布构建的产物清单要包含每个文件的来源与许可。
samples.reference: A release manifest lists each file's provenance and licence.
samples.hypothesis: The build artifact list should include the source and license of each file.

samples.source: 装机脚本要检测缺依赖并给出具体的获取命令。
samples.reference: Detect missing dependencies at install and print the exact fetch command.
samples.hypothesis: The installation script should detect missing dependencies and provide specific retrieval commands.

samples.source: 现场没有包管理器时，依赖要能整体随包交付。
samples.reference: Ship dependencies whole where a site has no package manager.
samples.hypothesis: When there is no package manager on site, dependencies must be delivered together with the package.

samples.source: 构建与发布分离，避免开发机凭据进入产物。
samples.reference: Separate building from publishing so developer credentials never enter artefacts.
samples.hypothesis: Separate construction and deployment, to prevent development machine credentials from entering the product.

samples.source: 可复现构建要固定环境变量与路径归一化规则。
samples.reference: Fix environment variables and path normalization for reproducible builds.
samples.hypothesis: Reproducible builds require fixing environment variables and path normalization rules.

samples.source: 交付验收要包含一次干净机器安装，避免只在开发机可用。
samples.reference: Include one clean-machine install in acceptance, or it only works on a dev box.
samples.hypothesis: The delivery inspection should include a clean machine installation to prevent it from being available only on development machines.

samples.source: 包内不要残留绝对路径默认值，否则他人环境不可复现。
samples.reference: Leave no absolute default paths inside a package, or another machine cannot reproduce.
samples.hypothesis: Do not leave the default absolute path in the package, otherwise it cannot be reproduced in other environments.

samples.source: 发布前跑一次全量门禁并把末行结果记进台账。
samples.reference: Run the full gate before release and record its last line in the ledger.
samples.hypothesis: Run a full inventory check before release and record the last result in the ledger.

samples.source: 交付介质要能长期保存，校验和与包同存放。
samples.reference: Store the checksum beside the media so an archive stays verifiable years later.
samples.hypothesis: The delivery medium should be able to be stored long-term, and the verification should be stored together with the package.

samples.source: 升级路径要覆盖从最旧交付版本到最新一跳的验证。
samples.reference: Test the upgrade path from the oldest delivered version in one hop.
samples.hypothesis: The upgrade path must cover verification from the oldest delivery version to the latest hop.

samples.source: 现场回滚演练要在交付前做一次，别把第一次留给客户。
samples.reference: Practise the rollback before delivery; the first attempt should not be a customer's.
samples.hypothesis: The on-site rollback exercise should be conducted before the delivery, don’t leave it to the customer for the first time.

samples.source: 打包时把第三方素材的许可文本一并装入目录。
samples.reference: Bundle third-party licence texts alongside the packaged material.
samples.hypothesis: Include the license text of third-party materials in the directory during packaging.

samples.source: 构建环境要固定工具链小版本，避免优化级差异影响性能数字。
samples.reference: Pin toolchain minor versions so optimisation differences do not move performance numbers.
samples.hypothesis: The build environment should use a fixed version of the toolchain to avoid performance impacts due to optimization level differences.

samples.source: 交付包要能单独校验某一个文件的完整性，便于定位损坏。
samples.reference: Allow verifying one file at a time, to localise corruption.
samples.hypothesis: The delivery package should be able to verify the integrity of a specific file independently, which facilitates the identification of damage.

samples.source: 安装后的自检输出要能复制给支持人员，含版本与路径摘要。
samples.reference: Make post-install self-check output copyable to support, with versions and path digests.
samples.hypothesis: The post-installation self-check output should be copyable to support personnel, including version and path summary.

samples.source: 无网环境下的文档要随包离线可读。
samples.reference: Ship documentation readable offline for disconnected environments.
samples.hypothesis: Documents in a no-network environment should be available offline for reading.

samples.source: 包内示例语料要确认可公开，避免带入客户素材。
samples.reference: Confirm sample corpora are public-safe, never client material.
samples.hypothesis: The sample corpus within the package must be confirmed as publicly available to avoid incorporating client materials.

samples.source: 发布构建日志要归档，便于事后核对当时环境与结果。
samples.reference: Archive release build logs to reconstruct the environment and outcome later.
samples.hypothesis: Publish build logs for archiving, to facilitate verification of the environment and results at a later time.

samples.source: 交付版本要能回答某个功能在哪个版本引入。
samples.reference: A delivered version must answer which release introduced a feature.
samples.hypothesis: The delivery version should be able to answer which version introduces a specific feature.

samples.source: 构建脚本的缓存目录要能指定到盘外，避免污染工作区。
samples.reference: Allow pointing the build cache outside the tree, to keep the working copy clean.
samples.hypothesis: The cache directory for the build script should be located outside the disk to avoid contaminating the workspace.

samples.source: 打包前的静态检查要拦住明显的界面与文案错误。
samples.reference: Run static checks before packaging to catch obvious UI and text faults.
samples.hypothesis: Static checks before packaging should identify obvious interface and copy errors.

samples.source: 装机脚本要在结束时打印已安装组件与版本一览。
samples.reference: Print the installed components and versions at the end of setup.
samples.hypothesis: The installation script should print a list of installed components and versions at the end.

samples.source: 现场依赖缺失时，安装器要能指出缺的那一个而不是整体失败。
samples.reference: Report the single missing dependency, rather than failing the whole install.
samples.hypothesis: When the on-site dependencies are missing, the installer should indicate which one is missing instead of failing entirely.

samples.source: 交付物的可复现性以他人能跑通为准，而不是本机能跑通。
samples.reference: Reproducibility means someone else can run it, not that this machine can.
samples.hypothesis: The reproducibility of the delivery must be ensured by others being able to run it successfully, not by the system itself.

samples.source: 同一张显卡上并行跑推理与合成会互相争用，评测要分阶段进行。
samples.reference: Sharing one GPU between inference and synthesis starves both; measure them in separate phases.
samples.hypothesis: Running inference and synthesis concurrently on the same GPU will compete with each other, and the evaluation needs to be conducted in stages.

samples.source: 显存占用达到临界时系统会开始用内存换页，延迟随之出现长尾。
samples.reference: Near the memory ceiling the system starts paging, and latency grows a long tail.
samples.hypothesis: When VRAM usage reaches a critical level, the system will start using memory paging, resulting in a long tail latency.

samples.source: 热降频会让同一模型在连续负载后段变慢，短测看不出这一影响。
samples.reference: Thermal throttling slows the same model late in a sustained load, which a short test will miss.
samples.hypothesis: Heat reduction frequency can slow down the same model after continuous load, but this impact is not evident during short tests.

samples.source: 笔记本在电池供电时的功耗墙会改变吞吐，性能数字要注明供电状态。
samples.reference: Battery power caps throughput on laptops, so note the power state next to any number.
samples.hypothesis: The power consumption wall of the laptop during battery operation changes the throughput, and performance figures should indicate the power supply status.

samples.source: 批处理的吞吐提升要除以显存代价来看，否则只是用资源换时间。
samples.reference: Judge batch throughput against the memory it costs, or it is only buying time with resources.
samples.hypothesis: The throughput improvement of batch processing should be evaluated against the VRAM cost; otherwise, it's just swapping resources for time.

samples.source: 磁盘读入模型的时间应计入首装等待，而不是被当成推理耗时。
samples.reference: Loading a model from disk belongs to first-start wait, not to inference time.
samples.hypothesis: The time of the disk read-in model should be counted as the initial setup delay, not as inference time.

samples.source: 同一份权重在不同优化级别下的输出可能不同，回归要固定构建。
samples.reference: The same weights can behave differently across optimisation levels, so pin the build for regressions.
samples.hypothesis: The output may vary at different optimization levels for the same weight, and the regression should be fixed during construction.

samples.source: 采样噪声与真实性能变化靠重复测量区分，单次运行不足以判断。
samples.reference: Repeat a measurement to tell sampling noise from a real change; one run cannot decide.
samples.hypothesis: Sampling noise and the change in actual performance can be distinguished through repeated measurements; a single run is not sufficient for judgment.

samples.source: 缓存命中率变化会同时影响延迟与成本，两者要一起看。
samples.reference: A shift in hit rate moves latency and cost together, so read them as a pair.
samples.hypothesis: The change in cache hit rate will affect both latency and cost, and they need to be considered together.

samples.source: 慢盘上的并发读写会让队列等待被误读成模型变慢。
samples.reference: On a slow disk, queueing under concurrent IO reads as a slower model.
samples.hypothesis: Concurrent read and write operations on a slow disk will cause the queue to wait, which may be misinterpreted as a slowdown in the model.

samples.source: 性能回归要给出分布而不是均值，长尾正是用户体感所在。
samples.reference: Report a distribution for a regression, not a mean; the tail is where the experience lives.
samples.hypothesis: Performance regression should provide a distribution rather than a mean, and the tail behavior is precisely what users perceive.

samples.source: 量化后的精度损失要用任务指标衡量，而不是只看权重误差。
samples.reference: Judge quantisation loss on task metrics, not on weight error alone.
samples.hypothesis: The precision loss after quantization should be measured by task metrics, rather than just focusing on weight error.

samples.source: 多核扩展在队列同步点上会停下来，加速曲线不是线性的。
samples.reference: Multi-core scaling stalls at queue synchronisation points, so the speedup curve is not linear.
samples.hypothesis: Multi-core expansion will stop at the queue synchronization point, and the acceleration curve is not linear.

samples.source: 首次请求包含惰性初始化，冷启动时间要单独列出。
samples.reference: The first request carries lazy initialisation, so report cold start separately.
samples.hypothesis: The first request includes an inert initialization, and the cold start time should be listed separately.

samples.source: 长时间运行后的内存增长要区分缓存驻留与真实泄露。
samples.reference: Distinguish cache residency from a real leak when memory grows over time.
samples.hypothesis: The memory growth after long-term operation should be distinguished between cache retention and actual leakage.

samples.source: 换页与内存回收会在采样窗口里制造毛刺，需要复采确认。
samples.reference: Paging and garbage collection create spikes, so confirm with a repeat sample.
samples.hypothesis: Page replacement and memory reclamation will create burrs in the sampling window, requiring re-sampling for confirmation.

samples.source: 同一批任务在不同顺序下耗时不同，基准要固定输入顺序。
samples.reference: The same workload takes different times in different orders, so fix input order in a benchmark.
samples.hypothesis: The time taken for the same batch of tasks varies with the order, so the input order should be fixed.

samples.source: 性能承诺要绑定运行环境说明，包括芯片、供电与并发规模。
samples.reference: Attach the environment to any performance promise: chip, power state and concurrency.
samples.hypothesis: Performance commitments should be tied to the operating environment, including the chip, power supply, and concurrency level.

samples.source: 推理与预处理重叠时，单段耗时会小于两段之和，别误判成加速。
samples.reference: Overlapping inference with pre-processing makes a segment look shorter than the sum, not faster.
samples.hypothesis: When inference and preprocessing overlap, the single segment processing time will be less than the sum of two segments, and avoid misjudging as acceleration.

samples.source: 一个更小的模型在延迟敏感场景可能胜过更大的模型，质量差要看任务。
samples.reference: A smaller model can beat a larger one where latency matters; check the quality cost per task.
samples.hypothesis: A smaller model may outperform a larger one in latency-sensitive scenarios, and the quality depends on the task.

samples.source: 缓存预取要按语料重复度决定，随机输入下预取只是额外开销。
samples.reference: Size cache prefetch to corpus repetition; on random input prefetch is pure overhead.
samples.hypothesis: Cache prefetching should be determined by the repetition rate of the corpus, and prefetching under random input is just an additional overhead.

samples.source: 并发解码不上调吞吐时，说明瓶颈在算力而不是调度。
samples.reference: If concurrent decoding does not raise throughput, the bottleneck is compute rather than scheduling.
samples.hypothesis: When concurrent decoding does not increase throughput, it indicates that the bottleneck lies in computing power rather than scheduling.

samples.source: 负载上升时先退化的是尾延迟而不是中位数，指标要成对看。
samples.reference: Under rising load the tail degrades before the median, so read the pair together.
samples.hypothesis: When the load increases, the tail latency degrades first, not the median, and the metrics should be analyzed in pairs.

samples.source: 把等待时间与处理时间混在一个指标里会掩盖排队积压。
samples.reference: Mixing waiting and processing into one metric hides queue build-up.
samples.hypothesis: Combining waiting time and processing time in one metric will mask the queue backlog.

samples.source: 评测用的机器要与交付目标同档，否则数字没有参考价值。
samples.reference: Benchmark on hardware in the delivered class, or the numbers mean nothing.
samples.hypothesis: The testing machine should be of the same level as the delivery target; otherwise, the numbers have no value.

samples.source: 内存上限保护比更大的缓存更能保证长时间运行不崩。
samples.reference: A memory ceiling protects a long run better than a larger cache does.
samples.hypothesis: A cache with a higher cache limit protection ratio can better ensure stability during long-term operation.

samples.source: 多线程解码会增加上下文切换，小文本上反而更慢。
samples.reference: Threaded decoding adds context switches and is slower on short text.
samples.hypothesis: Multithreaded decoding increases context switching, making it slower for small texts.

samples.source: 硬件加速的收益在算子覆盖不全时会打折，需要实测。
samples.reference: Acceleration pays off only as far as operators are covered, so measure it.
samples.hypothesis: The benefits of hardware acceleration are reduced when the operator coverage is incomplete, and actual testing is required.

samples.source: 性能基线要记录采集时间，跨日对比要留意后台任务干扰。
samples.reference: Stamp performance baselines with collection time; background jobs disturb day-to-day comparison.
samples.hypothesis: The performance baseline should record the collection time, and cross-day comparisons should be careful of background task interference.

samples.source: 一个未接上的加速开关不该被写成功能收益。
samples.reference: An acceleration switch that is not wired up must not be reported as a gain.
samples.hypothesis: An unconnected acceleration switch should not be described as a functional benefit.

samples.source: 长文本按段送入会让总耗时上升，但峰值内存会明显下降。
samples.reference: Feeding long text segment by segment raises total time but lowers peak memory.
samples.hypothesis: Sending long texts in segments will increase the total time, but the peak memory usage will decrease significantly.

samples.source: 同一模型的量化版与全精度版要分开报指标。
samples.reference: Report quantised and full-precision variants of one model as separate rows.
samples.hypothesis: The quantization version and full-precision version of the same model should have separate metrics reported.

samples.source: 评测环境里常驻服务会占用显存，测量前要先声明。
samples.reference: Note resident services holding memory before measuring; they change the result.
samples.hypothesis: The resident services in the testing environment will consume VRAM, which needs to be declared before measurement.

samples.source: 性能改善要与质量指标同批检查，避免只快不差的说法站不住。
samples.reference: Check performance and quality together, so "faster and equal" is defensible.
samples.hypothesis: Performance improvement should be evaluated alongside quality metrics to avoid claims of only speed without improvement.

samples.source: 队列积压告警要基于等待时间而不是队列长度。
samples.reference: Alert on queue age rather than queue depth, since depth alone is not user-visible harm.
samples.hypothesis: Queue backlog alerts should be based on waiting time rather than queue size.

samples.source: 一个批次的总耗时不能简单除以条数当单次延迟。
samples.reference: Do not divide a batch's total by its count and call it single-request latency.
samples.hypothesis: The total time for a batch cannot be simply divided by the number of items as a single latency.

samples.source: 首次装载与后续命中的延迟差要同时给出，避免只报好看的一档。
samples.reference: Give both cold-load and warm latency; reporting one flatters the number.
samples.hypothesis: The difference in latency between the initial load and subsequent cache hits should be presented together to avoid just showing a pleasing figure.

samples.source: 设备驱动更新会改变算子实现，性能结论要注明驱动版本。
samples.reference: Driver updates change kernel behaviour, so record the driver version with a result.
samples.hypothesis: The device driver update will change the operator implementation, and the performance conclusions should indicate the driver version.

samples.source: 并发上限的设定要以资源实测为据，而不是按核数猜测。
samples.reference: Set concurrency ceilings from measured resources, not from a core count.
samples.hypothesis: The setting of the concurrency limit should be based on actual resource testing, not guesses based on the number of cores.

samples.source: 性能报表里区分吞吐与延迟两个目标，二者常相互拉扯。
samples.reference: Keep throughput and latency as two goals in reports; they pull apart.
samples.hypothesis: In the performance report, the throughput and latency targets are distinguished, and they often conflict with each other.

samples.source: 长任务的进度回报要能反映实际完成量，而不是固定节奏。
samples.reference: Progress for long jobs should reflect completed work, not a fixed tick.
samples.hypothesis: The progress report for long tasks should reflect the actual completion, not a fixed rhythm.

samples.source: 一个指标的改善要能归因到具体变更，否则只是波动。
samples.reference: Attribute a metric's improvement to a specific change, or it is just noise.
samples.hypothesis: The improvement in a metric should be attributable to specific changes, otherwise it is just fluctuation.

samples.source: 评测脚本自身的日志写入也会拖慢被测服务。
samples.reference: Log writing by the harness itself can slow the service under test.
samples.hypothesis: Writing logs for the evaluation script itself also slows down the service being tested.

samples.source: 性能回归要设置可判定的阈值并允许噪声带。
samples.reference: Give a regression a decided threshold with a noise band around it.
samples.hypothesis: The performance regression should have a discernible threshold and allow for noise variation.

samples.source: 无加速硬件的机器也要能跑通，功能不应依赖特定算子。
samples.reference: Features must run on machines without accelerators, not on a specific kernel.
samples.hypothesis: A machine without acceleration hardware should still be functional, and features should not rely on specific operators.

samples.source: 一个缓存的收益要按命中率与失效成本共同评估。
samples.reference: Judge a cache by hit rate and invalidation cost together.
samples.hypothesis: The benefits of a cache should be evaluated based on both the hit rate and the invalidation cost.

samples.source: 短任务被启动开销主导时，优化算法本身收效有限。
samples.reference: When start-up cost dominates short tasks, optimising the algorithm returns little.
samples.hypothesis: When the startup overhead of short tasks dominates, the optimization algorithm itself has limited effectiveness.

samples.source: 并发数从一到二的收益常小于从二到三，注意边际递减。
samples.reference: The gain from one to two concurrent workers is usually smaller than from two to three.
samples.hypothesis: The benefit from the concurrency range from one to two is often less than that from two to three; note the diminishing marginal effect.

samples.source: 一个性能数字若不能重跑，就只能作为历史事实引用。
samples.reference: Cite an unreproducible performance number only as a historical fact.
samples.hypothesis: If a performance number cannot be rerun, it can only be used as a historical fact.

samples.source: 测量前确认没有其他负载在同一设备上运行。
samples.reference: Confirm nothing else is running on the device before measuring.
