samples.hypothesis: Confirm that no other loads are running on the same device before measurement.

samples.source: 内存换页会让尾延迟出现分钟级尖峰，别当成模型退化。
samples.reference: Paging produces minute-scale spikes in tail latency; do not call it model decay.
samples.hypothesis: Memory page replacement will cause minute-level peaks in tail latency, don't mistake it for model degradation.

samples.source: 一个硬件相关开关未接通时，界面上的选项要如实标注。
samples.reference: Label a hardware switch honestly when it is not actually wired up.
samples.hypothesis: When the hardware-related switch is not turned on, the options on the interface should be clearly indicated.

samples.source: 性能测量要区分单次成本与摊销成本。
samples.reference: Separate per-item cost from amortised cost in performance measurement.
samples.hypothesis: Performance measurement should distinguish between single-time costs and amortized costs.

samples.source: 一个优化的收益若被额外等待吃掉，净效果为零。
samples.reference: An optimisation whose gain is eaten by extra waiting nets out to zero.
samples.hypothesis: The benefits of optimization become zero if they are consumed by extra waiting time.

samples.source: 长时间运行的稳定性用退出码与错误计数衡量。
samples.reference: Measure long-run stability by exit codes and error counts, not by optimism.
samples.hypothesis: The stability of long-running operations is measured by exit codes and error counts.

samples.source: 一个报告的结论要能指向同一台机器上的可复现数据。
samples.reference: A report's conclusion should point to data reproducible on the same machine.
samples.hypothesis: The conclusion of a report should refer to reproducible data on the same machine.

samples.source: 性能与质量的取舍要写成产品决策而不是技术默认值。
samples.reference: Record performance-versus-quality choices as product decisions, not technical defaults.
samples.hypothesis: The trade-off between performance and quality should be presented as a product decision rather than a technical default value.

samples.source: 模型推理的能耗在长时间批量任务里也会成为约束。
samples.reference: Energy becomes a constraint in long batch inference, not only in mobile use.
samples.hypothesis: The energy consumption of model inference can also become a constraint in long-term batch tasks.

samples.source: 一个未固定的构建会让两次测量结果不可比。
samples.reference: An unpinned build makes two measurements incomparable.
samples.hypothesis: An unfixed build will make the two measurement results non-comparable.

samples.source: 把设备差异写进结论限定，比在正文里加免责声明有效。
samples.reference: Stating device scope inside a conclusion beats a disclaimer elsewhere.
samples.hypothesis: Write the equipment differences into the conclusion limitations, which is more effective than adding a disclaimer in the main text.

samples.source: 测量窗口要避开系统更新与索引重建的时间段。
samples.reference: Schedule measurement windows away from system updates and index rebuilds.
samples.hypothesis: The measurement window should avoid the time periods when the system updates and index rebuilding occur.

samples.source: 一个加速路径的正确性要单独测，别只测它有多快。
samples.reference: Test an accelerated path for correctness separately from its speed.
samples.hypothesis: The correctness of an acceleration path should be tested independently, not just by measuring how fast it is.

samples.source: 性能相关的缺陷要给出可复跑入口，便于回归验证。
samples.reference: A performance defect needs a re-runnable entry point for regression checks.
samples.hypothesis: Performance-related defects should provide a reproducible entry point for regression verification.

samples.source: 批量吞吐提升不等于单条延迟改善，两者分别验收。
samples.reference: Higher batch throughput is not lower per-item latency; accept them separately.
samples.hypothesis: Improved batch throughput does not equal improved latency; they should be evaluated separately.

samples.source: 一个指标的抖动若大于版本差异，就不足以支撑结论。
samples.reference: When a metric's jitter exceeds the version difference, it cannot support a conclusion.
samples.hypothesis: If the jitter of a metric exceeds the version difference, it is insufficient to support the conclusion.

samples.source: 飞轮的前提是AI先做对一次，之后本地复用才省成本。
samples.reference: The flywheel assumes the AI got it right once, so local reuse is what saves afterwards.
samples.hypothesis: The premise of the flywheel is that AI makes a correct decision first, and then it can be reused locally to save costs.

samples.source: 蒸馏入库的阈值决定术语表信噪比，过松会污染后续所有请求。
samples.reference: The distillation threshold sets the glossary's signal-to-noise ratio; too loose pollutes every later request.
samples.hypothesis: The threshold for distillation入库 determines the glossary signal-to-noise ratio; too loose would contaminate all subsequent requests.

samples.source: 机器抽取的条目要能与人工确认的条目区分，复核才有效。
samples.reference: Machine-extracted rows must be distinguishable from human-confirmed ones, or review is pointless.
samples.hypothesis: Machine-generated entries must be distinguishable from those verified by humans for review to be effective.

samples.source: 同一术语在不同领域下允许不同译法，主键必须含领域。
samples.reference: One term may translate differently per domain, so the key must include the domain.
samples.hypothesis: The same term can have different translations in different fields, and the primary key must include the field.

samples.source: 用户修改过的条目应优先于任何自动来源，且不被静默覆盖。
samples.reference: A user's edit outranks any automatic source and must not be silently overwritten.
samples.hypothesis: Items modified by the user take precedence over any automatic sources, and are not overwritten by silence.

samples.source: 术语表要能导出复核，且导出不带用户私有条目。
samples.reference: A glossary must be exportable for review, without the user's private rows.
samples.hypothesis: The glossary should allow export for review, and the exported file should not contain user-specific entries.

samples.source: 蒸馏产出的碎片化条目要靠源侧语言校验拦住。
samples.reference: Fragmented distillation output has to be stopped by a source-language check.
samples.hypothesis: The fragmented entries produced by distillation need to be prevented by language validation on the source side.

samples.source: 飞轮收益要靠命中率与质量同时验证，只看其一会误判。
samples.reference: Validate the flywheel with both hit rate and quality; either alone misleads.
samples.hypothesis: The flywheel benefits depend on both cache hit rate and quality verification; focusing on just one would lead to misjudgment.

samples.source: 一次误译被记忆固化后会被反复复用，标坏机制要可用。
samples.reference: A mistranslation stored in memory is reused forever, so the bad-mark path must work.
samples.hypothesis: A mistranslated phrase that is memorized and solidified can be reused repeatedly, and the marking mechanism must be usable.

samples.source: 术语表的规模不等于注入规模，能进上下文的那部分才是效果。
samples.reference: Glossary size is not injection size; only the rows reaching context have effect.
samples.hypothesis: The size of the glossary does not equal the injection size; what can be included in the context is what matters.

samples.source: 注入窗口按置信度排序时，平局必须有确定序，否则不可复现。
samples.reference: When the injection window sorts by confidence, ties need a deterministic order, or runs are irreproducible.
samples.hypothesis: When sorting the injection windows by confidence, a tie must have a definite order; otherwise, it cannot be reproduced.

samples.source: 一条术语是否生效，要靠响应字段回读而不是靠猜测。
samples.reference: Read back whether a term applied from the response, do not guess it.
samples.hypothesis: Whether a term is effective depends on reading the response field, not guessing.

samples.source: 蒸馏回灌的条目要能整体关闭，便于隔离问题。
samples.reference: Returned distillation rows must be switchable off wholesale, to isolate faults.
samples.hypothesis: The entry for distillation backflow should be able to be closed entirely for easy isolation of issues.

samples.source: 术语表变更要能被评测复跑反映，否则改了语义却看不见。
samples.reference: Glossary changes must surface in a re-run, or a semantic change stays invisible.
samples.hypothesis: Changes to the glossary must be reflected by the evaluation re-run, otherwise the semantics are modified but not visible.

samples.source: 一条错误术语的代价是它会被每个含该词的句子复用。
samples.reference: The cost of one wrong term is that every sentence containing it reuses it.
samples.hypothesis: The cost of a wrong term is that it is reused in every sentence containing that word.

samples.source: 术语治理的核心是可追溯：来源、置信度与修改人要能区分。
samples.reference: Glossary governance is traceability: source, confidence and editor must be distinguishable.
samples.hypothesis: The core of terminology management is traceability: the source, confidence, and modifier should be distinguishable.

samples.source: 锁定与删除是两种不同保护，不能相互替代。
samples.reference: Locking and deleting are different protections and cannot substitute for each other.
samples.hypothesis: Locking and deletion are two different types of protection and cannot be replaced each other.

samples.source: 按语言对分别维护术语表，跨语言对复用会串味。
samples.reference: Maintain glossaries per language pair; reusing across pairs bleeds meaning.
samples.hypothesis: Maintain the glossary for each language pair separately; reuse across language pairs would result in confusion.

samples.source: 新领域包的收益要用同批句子对照测，不做跨批比较。
samples.reference: Test a new domain pack on the same sentences, never across batches.
samples.hypothesis: The benefits of the new domain package should be measured using sentences from the same batch, without cross-batch comparisons.

samples.source: 人工复核过的条目要能标注来源批次，便于回退。
samples.reference: Reviewed rows should record which batch they came from, to allow reversal.
samples.hypothesis: Entries that have been manually reviewed should be marked with the source batch number for easy rollback.

samples.source: 术语冲突要报出双方来源，而不是静默选一个。
samples.reference: Term conflicts must name both provenances rather than silently picking one.
samples.hypothesis: Terminology conflicts should indicate both sources, rather than silently choosing one.

samples.source: 蒸馏阈值调整后要重跑质量回归，否则信噪比未知。
samples.reference: Rerun the quality regression after changing the distillation threshold, or the ratio is unknown.
samples.hypothesis: After adjusting the distillation threshold, re-run the quality regression process, otherwise the signal-to-noise ratio is unknown.

samples.source: 一条术语的译文若含变量占位，需要显式转义规则。
samples.reference: Escape rules are needed when a term's translation contains a placeholder.
samples.hypothesis: If a term's translation contains variable placeholders, explicit escaping rules are required.

samples.source: 飞轮的收益上限由重复内容占比决定，不由模型决定。
samples.reference: The flywheel's ceiling is set by how repetitive the content is, not by the model.
samples.hypothesis: The upper limit of flywheel profits is determined by the proportion of repetitive content, not by the model.

samples.source: 术语表要能按领域整体替换，便于客户自带词表交付。
samples.reference: Allow replacing a whole domain glossary so a customer's own terms can ship.
samples.hypothesis: The glossary should allow for overall replacement by domain to facilitate the customer's submission of their own vocabulary.

samples.source: 一次注入失败要区分引擎不支持与本次无命中。
samples.reference: Separate "engine cannot use terms" from "no term matched this sentence".
samples.hypothesis: A failed injection should be distinguished between engine incompatibility and no cache hit this time.

samples.source: 统计口径要说清分母是全部行还是含术语的行。
samples.reference: State whether a denominator is all rows or only rows containing terms.
samples.hypothesis: The statistical scope should be clearly stated whether the denominator includes all rows or only specific terms.

samples.source: 术语表与记忆库的更新要能分别回滚。
samples.reference: Roll back the glossary and the memory store independently.
samples.hypothesis: The update of the glossary and memory database should be able to be rolled back separately.

samples.source: 蒸馏的批处理窗口影响入库顺序，跨批比较需谨慎。
samples.reference: A distillation batch window affects insert order, so cross-batch comparison needs care.
samples.hypothesis: The batch window for distillation affects the storage order, and cross-batch comparisons require caution.

samples.source: 一条被锁定的术语仍可被本人再次修改，锁不是权限墙。
samples.reference: A locked row stays editable by its own author; a lock is not a permission wall.
samples.hypothesis: A locked term can still be modified by the original user; the lock is not a permission wall.

samples.source: 术语治理的效果最终体现在一致性指标，而不是条目数量。
samples.reference: Governance shows up in consistency metrics, not in row counts.
samples.hypothesis: The effectiveness of term governance is ultimately reflected in consistency metrics, not the number of entries.

samples.source: 一个领域包的覆盖率要按语料实测，不靠条目数推断。
samples.reference: Measure a pack's coverage against the corpus, do not infer it from row counts.
samples.hypothesis: The coverage of a domain package should be measured based on actual data, not inferred from the number of items.

samples.source: 新词冷启动阶段，人工先补几条高价值术语比批量灌入更有效。
samples.reference: At cold start, a few hand-picked high-value terms beat bulk import.
samples.hypothesis: During the new term cold start phase, manually adding a few high-value terms is more effective than mass insertion.

samples.source: 同一术语的两种译法并存时，要显式选择并记录原因。
samples.reference: Where two renderings coexist, choose explicitly and record why.
samples.hypothesis: When two translations of the same term exist, explicitly select and document the reasons.

samples.source: 飞轮假设的是正确译法被复用，错误复用会放大问题。
samples.reference: The flywheel assumes correct renderings get reused; reusing wrong ones amplifies them.
samples.hypothesis: The flywheel assumption is that the correct translation is reused, while incorrect reuse will exacerbate the problem.

samples.source: 一个术语包的许可与来源要可追溯，禁止传染性许可进入。
samples.reference: Keep a pack's licence and provenance traceable, and exclude copyleft sources.
samples.hypothesis: The licensing and sources of a term package must be traceable; infectious licenses are prohibited.

samples.source: 术语表条目要能按来源批量清理，便于回退一次误灌。
samples.reference: Allow bulk cleanup by provenance, to undo one bad import.
samples.hypothesis: Items in the glossary should be able to be cleaned up in batches based on source, facilitating a one-time rollback of accidental injection.

samples.source: 一次导入部分失败必须整体拒绝，不留半套条目。
samples.reference: Refuse a partially failed import whole, leaving no half-applied rows.
samples.hypothesis: If some import fails, the entire import must be rejected, and no half-set of entries is allowed.

samples.source: 一条术语的置信度不由导入路径抬高，声明值就是最终值。
samples.reference: Do not raise a declared confidence during import; the authored value is final.
samples.hypothesis: The confidence of a term does not increase due to the import path; the declaration value is the final value.

samples.source: 删除领域行需要按完整主键操作，否则碰到同名通用行。
samples.reference: Deleting a domain row needs the full key, or it hits a generic twin instead.
samples.hypothesis: To delete a domain row, you need to use the full primary key, otherwise you will encounter rows with the same name.

samples.source: 术语治理的评审节奏要与语料扩充同步，否则指标漂移。
samples.reference: Keep glossary review in step with corpus growth, or metrics drift.
samples.hypothesis: The review rhythm of term governance should be synchronized with corpus expansion, otherwise the metrics will drift.

samples.source: 一条被禁用的术语要能保留历史而不参与注入。
samples.reference: Keep a retired term for history while excluding it from injection.
samples.hypothesis: A disabled term should retain its history without participating in injection.

samples.source: 术语表要按客户环境分级：通用、领域、项目三层。
samples.reference: Layer glossaries by scope: generic, domain and project.
samples.hypothesis: The glossary should be categorized by customer environment: general, domain, and project levels.

samples.source: 一个词的多义性要靠上下文消歧，而不是靠强制唯一。
samples.reference: Handle polysemy with context, not by forcing one rendering.
samples.hypothesis: The polysemy of a word is resolved through context, not by enforcing a single meaning.

samples.source: 飞轮的度量要包含升级率，升级频繁说明本地能力不足。
samples.reference: Include the upgrade rate in flywheel metrics; frequent upgrades mean local capability is thin.
samples.hypothesis: The metric of the flywheel should include the upgrade rate. Frequent upgrades indicate insufficient local capabilities.

samples.source: 一次测量若只跑单臂，就没有可比的对照组。
samples.reference: A single-arm measurement has nothing to compare against.
samples.hypothesis: If a single measurement is performed with only one arm, there is no comparable control group.

samples.source: 术语注入与记忆复用是两条通路，效果要分别归因。
samples.reference: Injection and memory reuse are two paths; attribute their effects separately.
samples.hypothesis: Term injection and memory reuse are two pathways, and their effects should be attributed separately.

samples.source: 一个领域包的评审记录要能指向具体条目变更。
samples.reference: Pack review must point to specific row changes.
samples.hypothesis: The review record for a domain package should point to specific item changes.

samples.source: 术语冲突处理要保守，宁可报出歧义也不静默改写。
samples.reference: Handle term conflicts conservatively: report ambiguity instead of rewriting silently.
samples.hypothesis: Terminology conflict handling should be conservative; it's better to indicate ambiguity rather than silently modify it.

samples.source: 一条自动条目的默认置信度要低于人工确认的值。
samples.reference: Automatic rows need a lower default confidence than human-confirmed ones.
samples.hypothesis: The default confidence of an automated entry is lower than the value confirmed manually.

samples.source: 术语表的变更要与评测身份一起记录，便于事后解释数字。
samples.reference: Record glossary changes with the measurement identity, to explain numbers later.
samples.hypothesis: Changes to the glossary should be recorded along with the evaluation status for later explanation.

samples.source: 一次导入的成功与否要按写入数而非条目数判断。
samples.reference: Judge an import by rows written, not rows supplied.
samples.hypothesis: The success of a single import should be determined by the number of entries written, not the number of items.

samples.source: 一个包的收益若测不出，先检查注入是否真到达。
samples.reference: If a pack shows no gain, check first whether injection actually arrived.
samples.hypothesis: If the revenue of a package cannot be measured, first check whether the injection actually reaches.

samples.source: 术语治理的产出是可复用的领域资产，不是一次性配置。
samples.reference: Glossary governance yields a reusable domain asset, not one-off configuration.
samples.hypothesis: The output of term governance is reusable domain assets, not a one-time configuration.

samples.source: 飞轮的每一环都要有可观测点，否则退化无法定位。
samples.reference: Every link of the flywheel needs an observable, or decay cannot be located.
samples.hypothesis: Every ring of the flywheel must have observable points; otherwise, degradation cannot be identified.

samples.source: 一次锁定的解除要能追溯到谁操作。
samples.reference: Unlocking a row must be traceable to an actor.
samples.hypothesis: The release of a lock should be traceable to the person who operated it.

samples.source: 一条术语的译文长度会影响排版与停留时长。
samples.reference: A term's translation length affects layout and dwell time.
samples.hypothesis: The length of the translation for a term affects the formatting and retention time.

samples.source: 术语表的变更要能只回滚本次导入的批次。
samples.reference: Roll back exactly the batch a change introduced.
samples.hypothesis: Changes to the glossary should allow rollback only for this import batch.

samples.source: 一次评测的术语集要与交付时一致，否则结论不适用。
samples.reference: Keep the evaluation term set equal to the delivered one, or the conclusion does not apply.
samples.hypothesis: The terminology set for a single evaluation must be consistent with that for the delivery, otherwise the conclusions will not apply.

samples.source: 一个领域包的可维护性体现在条目粒度均匀。
samples.reference: A pack stays maintainable when row granularity is even.
samples.hypothesis: The maintainability of a domain package is reflected in uniform entry granularity.

samples.source: 术语治理要避免堆积无证据的条目，定期回收低命中的行。
samples.reference: Avoid accumulating unevidenced rows; retire low-hit ones periodically.
samples.hypothesis: Terminology management should prevent the accumulation of unverified entries, and regularly remove low cache hit lines.

samples.source: 一次误译被采纳后会通过飞轮放大，评审门槛要前移。
samples.reference: An accepted mistranslation is amplified by the flywheel, so gate it earlier.
samples.hypothesis: A mistranslation that is adopted will be amplified by the flywheel, and the review threshold will increase.

samples.source: 术语表的最终价值由客户可感一致性决定。
samples.reference: The worth of a glossary is the consistency a customer can perceive.
samples.hypothesis: The ultimate value of the glossary depends on customer perceivable consistency.

samples.source: 引擎标签要显示实际作答者，用户才能判断结果来自哪一档。
samples.reference: Show which engine actually answered, so users can tell which tier produced the result.
samples.hypothesis: The engine tag should display the actual responder so the user can determine which tier the result belongs to.

samples.source: 降级提示要用平实语言说明原因与下一步，不只显示错误码。
samples.reference: State the reason and the next step in plain words, not only an error code.
samples.hypothesis: The downgrade prompt should explain the reason and next steps in plain language, not just display the error code.

samples.source: 长文本结果的复制按钮要在收起面板前保持可见。
samples.reference: Keep the copy button reachable before a panel collapses.
samples.hypothesis: The copy button for long text results should remain visible before hiding the panel.

samples.source: 所有状态变化都要有文本形式，不能只靠颜色区分。
samples.reference: Every status change needs a text form, not colour alone.
samples.hypothesis: All status changes should be presented in text form, not just distinguished by colors.

samples.source: 表格列宽要允许用户调整并记忆，术语表列数会随版本增加。
samples.reference: Let users resize and keep column widths, as the glossary gains columns over versions.
samples.hypothesis: Table column widths should allow users to adjust and remember them, and the number of columns in the glossary will increase with each version.

samples.source: 键盘焦点在翻译后要留在输入区，便于连续操作。
samples.reference: Keep keyboard focus in the input area after a translation, for continuous work.
samples.hypothesis: The keyboard focus should remain in the input area after translation, facilitating continuous operations.

samples.source: 进度条要能取消，取消后明确说明底层调用仍在收尾。
samples.reference: A progress bar must be cancellable, and say the native call still drains afterwards.
samples.hypothesis: The progress bar should be cancellable, and after cancellation, it should be clearly stated that the underlying calls are still in progress.

samples.source: 错误提示要避免术语缩写，把内部名词翻译成人话。
samples.reference: Write errors without internal jargon; translate internal names into plain language.
samples.hypothesis: Error messages should avoid abbreviations, and internal terms should be translated in a clear manner.

samples.source: 界面文案要与帮助文档同一措辞，避免同一功能两个名字。
samples.reference: Use the same wording across UI and help, or one feature gets two names.
samples.hypothesis: The interface copy should use the same wording as the help document, and avoid having two names for the same function.

samples.source: 读屏软件需要每个状态行都有明确标签与角色。
samples.reference: Screen readers need an explicit label and role on every status line.
samples.hypothesis: The reading display software requires clear labels and roles for each status row.

samples.source: 默认焦点不要落在会触发联网的按钮上。
samples.reference: Do not put default focus on a button that triggers a network call.
samples.hypothesis: The default focus should not be on the button that triggers a network connection.

samples.source: 批量任务的完成提示要给出成功与失败条数两项。
samples.reference: A batch completion notice must give both succeeded and failed counts.
samples.hypothesis: The completion notification for batch tasks should include two items: the number of successes and the number of failures.

samples.source: 表格排序要稳定，同值行的顺序不能每次刷新都变。
samples.reference: Keep table sorting stable; equal-valued rows must not reshuffle on refresh.
samples.hypothesis: Table sorting should be stable, and the order of rows with the same value should not change with each refresh.

samples.source: 禁用项要有原因提示，灰掉而不说明会被当成故障。
samples.reference: Explain a disabled control, or a greyed-out one reads as a defect.
samples.hypothesis: Disabled items should have a reason prompt; if they are grayed out without explanation, they should be considered as errors.

samples.source: 首次启动的缺模型提示要包含可复制的获取命令。
samples.reference: The first-launch missing-model notice should carry a copyable fetch command.
samples.hypothesis: The model missing warning during first startup should include a copyable acquisition command.

samples.source: 界面要能只显示用户确认过的条目，便于核对来源。
samples.reference: Let the UI show only user-confirmed rows, to make provenance checkable.
samples.hypothesis: The interface should only display items confirmed by the user for easy verification of sources.

samples.source: 长列表的滚动位置在切换语言对后要重置。
samples.reference: Reset scroll position when switching language pairs in a long list.
samples.hypothesis: The scroll position of the long list needs to be reset after switching the language pair.

samples.source: 输入框的粘贴内容要显式声明长度上限与超限行为。
samples.reference: State the paste length limit and what happens beyond it.
samples.hypothesis: The pasted content in the input field should explicitly declare the maximum length and overflow behavior.

samples.source: 提示文案里的数字要与实际配置值同源，不写死。
samples.reference: Pull numbers in messages from live config, never hardcode them.
samples.hypothesis: The numbers in the prompt text should be consistent with the actual configuration values, not fixed.

samples.source: 取消操作不能造成已完成的成果丢失，只丢弃在飞结果。
samples.reference: Cancelling must not lose finished work, only what was still in flight.
samples.hypothesis: The cancellation operation does not cause the lost of completed results, only discarding the flying results.

samples.source: 表格的单元格换行要保留，长术语不能截断显示。
samples.reference: Wrap cell text so long terms stay fully visible.
samples.hypothesis: Cell line breaks in the table should be preserved, and long terms should not be truncated.

samples.source: 状态栏的临时消息要被新的操作打断而不是堆积。
samples.reference: A transient status message should be replaced, not queued behind others.
samples.hypothesis: Temporary messages in the status bar should be interrupted by new operations instead of piling up.

samples.source: 对话框里的危险操作要写清影响范围与是否可恢复。
samples.reference: Spell out blast radius and reversibility in a destructive dialog.
samples.hypothesis: Write clearly the impact range and whether it can be restored for the dangerous operations in the dialog box.

samples.source: 界面在等待外部服务时不得显示为无响应。
samples.reference: The interface must stay responsive while waiting on an external service.
samples.hypothesis: The interface must not appear unresponsive while waiting for external services.

samples.source: 可访问性检查要包含对比度与焦点顺序两项。
samples.reference: Include contrast and focus order in accessibility checks.
samples.hypothesis: Accessibility check should include two items: contrast and focus order.

samples.source: 一个指标的展示精度要与测量精度一致。
samples.reference: Show a metric to its measurement precision, no further.
samples.hypothesis: The accuracy of the indicator display should be consistent with the measurement accuracy.

samples.source: 错误提示要能复制出完整上下文，供支持人员定位。
samples.reference: Let users copy the full context of an error for support.
samples.hypothesis: The error message should contain the full context for support personnel to locate the issue.

samples.source: 表格要能按来源列筛选，机器条目与人工条目分开看。
samples.reference: Filter the table by source, to view machine and human rows apart.
samples.hypothesis: The table should allow filtering by source column, with machine entries and manual entries separated.

samples.source: 空状态要有下一步指引，不留白屏。
samples.reference: An empty state needs a next step, never a blank pane.
samples.hypothesis: The empty state should have a next step guide, without leaving a blank screen.

samples.source: 按钮的文案要说明结果而不是过程。
samples.reference: Button labels should name the outcome, not the mechanism.
samples.hypothesis: The button text should indicate the result rather than the process.

samples.source: 界面语言与内容语言要能分别显示，不相互覆盖。
samples.reference: Keep interface language and content language distinct.
samples.hypothesis: The interface language and content language should be able to display separately without overlapping.

samples.source: 高级设置项要说明生效时机，是重启还是即时。
samples.reference: Advanced settings must say when they apply: immediately or after restart.
samples.hypothesis: Advanced settings should specify when they take effect, whether it's after a restart or immediately.

samples.source: 一次操作的反馈要与操作在同一区域，避免视线跳跃。
samples.reference: Keep feedback beside the control that produced it.
samples.hypothesis: The feedback of a single operation should be in the same area as the operation to avoid eye movement.

samples.source: 列表的排序依据要在表头显式标注。
samples.reference: Mark the active sort column in the header.
samples.hypothesis: The sorting criteria for the list should be explicitly indicated in the header.

samples.source: 删除确认要显示将被删除的条目数量。
samples.reference: A delete confirmation must show how many rows are involved.
samples.hypothesis: The number of items to be deleted will be displayed upon confirmation.

samples.source: 不可用的功能要在界面上说明缺哪个前置条件。
samples.reference: Name the missing precondition for an unavailable feature.
samples.hypothesis: Unusable features should indicate which prerequisites are missing on the interface.

samples.source: 输入过长时给出分段建议，而不是静默截断。
samples.reference: Suggest splitting on over-long input, rather than truncating quietly.
samples.hypothesis: Provide segmentation suggestions when the input is too long, instead of silently truncating.

samples.source: 界面要能显示当前生效的路径而不是配置意图。
samples.reference: Show the routing that is actually in force, not what configuration intended.
samples.hypothesis: The interface should display the currently active path rather than the configuration intent.

samples.source: 提示语要避免把技术选择说成用户错误。
samples.reference: Avoid framing a technical limitation as the user's mistake.
samples.hypothesis: The instructions should avoid labeling technical choices as user errors.

samples.source: 批量导入结果要区分写入数与给出数。
samples.reference: Import results must separate rows written from rows supplied.
samples.hypothesis: The results of batch import should distinguish between the number of entries written and the number of entries provided.

samples.source: 状态文案里的引擎名要与其注册标识一致。
samples.reference: Keep engine names equal to their registered identifiers.
samples.hypothesis: The engine name in the status文案 should be consistent with its registration identifier.

samples.source: 列表刷新要保留当前选择，除非该条目已消失。
samples.reference: Preserve the current selection across refreshes unless it no longer exists.
samples.hypothesis: The list is refreshed while keeping the current selection, unless the entry has disappeared.

samples.source: 界面文案的变更要与文档同一提交，避免两处不同版本。
samples.reference: Change UI text and docs in one commit, or they diverge.
samples.hypothesis: The changes to the interface copy should be submitted together with the document to avoid two different versions.

samples.source: 键盘快捷键要避开输入法占用组合。
samples.reference: Pick shortcuts that do not collide with input-method bindings.
samples.hypothesis: Keyboard shortcuts should avoid combinations occupied by the input method.

samples.source: 提示中引用路径要能复制，且不含个人目录。
samples.reference: Copyable paths in messages, without a personal directory inside.
samples.hypothesis: The paths referenced in the hint should be copyable and do not include personal directories.

samples.source: 进度百分比在无法计量时改为显示已完成条数。
samples.reference: Show a completed count instead of a percentage that cannot be measured.
samples.hypothesis: When the progress percentage cannot be measured, it is changed to display the number of completed items.

samples.source: 同一状态在界面、日志与诊断接口要同名。
samples.reference: Keep one name for a state across UI, logs and diagnostics.
samples.hypothesis: The same status name should be used in the interface, logs, and diagnostic interfaces.

samples.source: 界面要在长时间等待时说明是否仍在处理。
samples.reference: Reassure the user that work continues during a long wait.
samples.hypothesis: The interface should indicate whether it is still being processed during long wait times.

samples.source: 一个开关的标签要说它控制的对象而不是效果。
samples.reference: Label a switch by what it controls, not by a hoped-for effect.
samples.hypothesis: The label for a switch should indicate what it controls rather than its effect.

samples.source: 表格要能显示条目的来源标记列，为复核提供入口。
samples.reference: Show the provenance column so review has a starting point.
samples.hypothesis: The table should display the source marker column for entries, providing a way to review them.

samples.source: 错误恢复建议要给出可执行命令，而不是泛泛重试。
samples.reference: Offer the exact command to recover, not generic advice to retry.
samples.hypothesis: The error recovery suggestions should provide executable commands instead of general retries.

samples.source: 界面要能只读地预览一个导入包内容。
samples.reference: Preview a pack's contents read-only before import.
samples.hypothesis: The interface should allow a read-only preview of the imported package content.

samples.source: 数字与单位之间要有明确格式，避免歧义写法。
samples.reference: Format numbers with explicit units to avoid ambiguity.
samples.hypothesis: There should be a clear format between numbers and units to avoid ambiguous writing.

samples.source: 用户自定义条目要有可见的编辑标记。
samples.reference: Show an edit marker on rows the user changed.
samples.hypothesis: User-defined entries should have visible edit markers.

samples.source: 长任务的状态转换要留下时间戳。
samples.reference: Timestamp state transitions on long-running tasks.
samples.hypothesis: The state transition of the long task should keep a timestamp.

samples.source: 一次批量操作的错误要能定位到具体行号。
samples.reference: Pinpoint the row number for a batch failure.
samples.hypothesis: The error in batch operations should be able to pinpoint the specific line number.

samples.source: 界面提示不要承诺无法保证的质量等级。
samples.reference: Keep UI copy from promising a quality tier it cannot guarantee.
samples.hypothesis: The interface indicates that no quality level can be guaranteed.

samples.source: 一个待处理状态要能区分等待外部与自身计算。
samples.reference: Separate waiting on an external service from local computation.
samples.hypothesis: A pending status should be able to distinguish between waiting for external input and self-computation.

samples.source: 界面文案要能在不改动代码的情况下校对。
samples.reference: Let UI copy be proofread without a code change.
samples.hypothesis: The interface copy should be able to be proofed without changing the code.

samples.source: 复制出的诊断内容要自带版本与环境信息。
samples.reference: Copied diagnostics must include version and environment.
samples.hypothesis: The copied diagnostic content should include version and environment information.

samples.source: 表格里显示置信度要注明口径而不是裸数字。
samples.reference: Label a confidence column with what it measures.
samples.hypothesis: The confidence level in the table should be indicated with a label instead of just a bare number.

samples.source: 一个功能未覆盖全部平台时要显式标注范围。
samples.reference: Mark scope when a feature is not present on every platform.
samples.hypothesis: When a feature is not available on all platforms, the scope should be explicitly indicated.

samples.source: 界面要能隐藏内部术语列，给非技术用户简化视图。
samples.reference: Offer a simplified view that hides internal columns.
samples.hypothesis: The interface should be able to hide internal term columns to simplify the view for non-technical users.

samples.source: 操作耗时较长要给出预期时长而不是转圈。
samples.reference: Estimate expected duration for slow operations rather than spinning.
samples.hypothesis: The operation takes a long time, so provide an expected duration instead of circularly rotating.

samples.source: 提示里的示例路径要用占位符而不是真实目录。
samples.reference: Use placeholders in example paths, never a real directory.
samples.hypothesis: The example path in the prompt should use a placeholder instead of a real directory.

samples.source: 一次操作的结果要能被再次读取以确认。
samples.reference: Make an operation's effect readable back for confirmation.
samples.hypothesis: The result of an operation should be readable again for confirmation.

samples.source: 界面元素的禁用状态要与原因并列出现。
samples.reference: Show a disabled control together with its reason.
samples.hypothesis: The disabled state of interface elements should appear alongside the reason.

samples.source: 一个批次的失败行要能在界面里筛出。
samples.reference: Let a UI filter show only the failed rows of a batch.
samples.hypothesis: A batch of failed rows should be able to be filtered out on the interface.

samples.source: 状态消息要避免术语缩写与内部代号。
samples.reference: Keep status messages free of internal shorthand.
samples.hypothesis: Status messages should avoid abbreviations and internal codes.

samples.source: 长表格的表头要在滚动时保持可见。
samples.reference: Keep a long table's header pinned while scrolling.
samples.hypothesis: The header of a long table should remain visible during scrolling.

samples.source: 一个数字的展示要与其来源同口径。
samples.reference: Present a number under the same definition as its source.
samples.hypothesis: A number display should be consistent with its source.

samples.source: 界面要能在无网络时完整可用。
samples.reference: The interface must work fully with no network access.
samples.hypothesis: The interface should be fully functional without internet access.

samples.source: 提示文案的默认值要与实际默认值同源。
samples.reference: Keep stated defaults drawn from the same source as real defaults.
samples.hypothesis: The default value of the prompt文案 should be consistent with the actual default value.

samples.source: 提交信息要一行说清改了什么的一部分。
samples.reference: A commit subject names the part of the system a change touches.
samples.hypothesis: The submission information should specify what has been changed in one line.

samples.source: 文档写完之后要跑一次形近字扫描，不靠目测。
samples.reference: Run the lookalike scan after writing prose; do not trust the eye.
samples.hypothesis: After writing the document, run a scan of similar-shaped characters to ensure accuracy rather than relying on visual inspection.

samples.source: 台账里的状态变更要附证据，测试名或命令都可以。
samples.reference: Attach evidence to a ledger status change: a test name or a command.
samples.hypothesis: State changes in the ledger should be supported by evidence, either a test name or a command.

samples.source: 带日期的历史条目只追加订正，不改写。
samples.reference: Append corrections to dated entries; never rewrite them.
samples.hypothesis: Historical entries with dates are only appended and corrected, not rewritten.

samples.source: 一次变更只解决一类问题，混合口径会让归因失效。
samples.reference: Keep one change to one kind of problem, or attribution dies.
samples.hypothesis: A single change addresses only one type of issue; mixed metrics will make attribution ineffective.

samples.source: 并发会话下用路径限定的提交，避免共享暂存区互扫。
samples.reference: Use path-scoped commits with concurrent sessions, so shared staging cannot sweep another's work.
samples.hypothesis: Submit with path limitation under concurrent sessions to avoid mutual scanning in the shared cache area.

samples.source: 脚本入口要成对提供平台薄壳，逻辑只放一处。
samples.reference: Provide one thin launcher per OS and keep the logic in a single place.
samples.hypothesis: The script entry should provide a paired platform shell, and the logic should be placed in one place.

samples.source: 新增测试套件要同时登记进本地门禁与流水线。
samples.reference: Register a new suite in both the local gate and the pipeline.
samples.hypothesis: The new test suite must be registered in both the local access control and the pipeline simultaneously.

samples.source: 一次性探针的结论要落进可复跑入口，否则无法复核。
samples.reference: Promote a one-off probe's finding into a re-runnable entry point, or nobody can re-check it.
samples.hypothesis: The conclusions of the one-time probe must be recorded in the repeatable entry, otherwise they cannot be reviewed.

samples.source: 测试不得依赖开发者机器上的常驻服务。
samples.reference: Tests must not depend on a developer's running services.
samples.hypothesis: Testing should not rely on persistent services on the developer machine.

samples.source: 门禁比眼睛可靠：它会把漏改的旧假设直接报出来。
samples.reference: The gate beats eyeballing: it reports assumptions you forgot to update.
samples.hypothesis: Access control is more reliable than eyes: it will directly reveal the missed revisions of old assumptions.

samples.source: 断言要能失败，写不出失败的断言等于没有断言。
samples.reference: An assertion that cannot fail is not an assertion.
samples.hypothesis: An assertion must be able to fail; failing to write an assertion means there is no assertion at all.

samples.source: 文档不能成为实现依据，现状以代码与测试为准。
samples.reference: Docs are not an implementation basis; code and tests are current truth.
samples.hypothesis: The document cannot serve as a basis for implementation; the current status shall be determined by code and testing.

samples.source: 度量口径的变更要在报告里显式声明。
samples.reference: Declare a metric definition change inside the report.
samples.hypothesis: Changes in measurement dimensions must be explicitly stated in the report.

samples.source: 一次修复要连带删除它当初的遮盖手段。
samples.reference: Remove the workaround that masked a defect when fixing it.
samples.hypothesis: A fix requires deleting its original covering method as well.

samples.source: 测量结论要写清它不能证明什么。
samples.reference: State what a measurement cannot prove.
samples.hypothesis: The measurement conclusion should clearly state what it cannot prove.

samples.source: 行尾由版本控制的属性决定，不由本地配置决定。
samples.reference: Line endings come from repository attributes, not local configuration.
samples.hypothesis: The line end is determined by version-controlled attributes, not by local configuration.

samples.source: 源码注释统一英文，面向用户的文案按产品语言。
samples.reference: Keep source comments in English and user-facing copy in the product language.
samples.hypothesis: All source code comments are in English, and user-facing copy is in the product's language.

samples.source: 每个对外数字都要能追到一次可复现运行。
samples.reference: Trace every published number to one reproducible run.
samples.hypothesis: Every external number should be able to be traced and reproduced once.

samples.source: 评审前要自查规范合规缺口，不等他人指出。
samples.reference: Self-check convention compliance before review, not after being told.
samples.hypothesis: Before the review, conduct self-checks to identify any gaps in standards and compliance, without waiting for others to point them out.

samples.source: 变更后的旧承诺句要一并搜干净，避免残留两处。
samples.reference: Search out stale promises after a change, so no second copy survives.
samples.hypothesis: The modified old commitments must be completely removed to avoid residual entries.

samples.source: 台账与代码不一致时先信代码并回写台账。
samples.reference: Trust code over the ledger on conflict, then correct the ledger.
samples.hypothesis: When the ledger and code are inconsistent, first trust the code and rewrite the ledger.

samples.source: 一次跑批前要确认范围参数与它可能覆盖什么。
samples.reference: Confirm a run's scope and what it can overwrite before starting it.
samples.hypothesis: Before running a batch, confirm the scope parameters and what it may cover.

samples.source: 文档里的命令要能直接执行，不写伪代码。
samples.reference: Keep documented commands executable, never pseudocode.
samples.hypothesis: The commands in the document should be executable directly, not pseudo-code.

samples.source: 测试的跳过原因要打印出来，SKIP 不是通过。
samples.reference: Print a skip reason; a skip is not a pass.
samples.hypothesis: The reason for skipping the test should be printed out; SKIP indicates failure.

samples.source: 一次修复的解释要绑定到具体证据而不是印象。
samples.reference: Bind an explanation to concrete evidence, not to recollection.
samples.hypothesis: The explanation of a fix should be tied to specific evidence rather than impressions.

samples.source: 共享计数只允许一处真相，两处会互相打脸。
samples.reference: Keep one source of truth for a shared counter, or two disagree.
samples.hypothesis: The sharing count allows only one truth; two would be mutually embarrassing.

samples.source: 新旋钮要有上下界与注入接缝，便于测试钉住。
samples.reference: Give a new knob bounds and an injection seam so tests can pin it.
samples.hypothesis: The new knob should have upper and lower boundaries and injection seams for easy testing and fixation.

samples.source: 一次变更的边界要在提交信息里写清未做什么。
samples.reference: State what a change deliberately did not do, in its message.
samples.hypothesis: The boundary of a single change should be clearly stated in the submission information.

samples.source: 缺陷编号要与分项口径一致，避免按编号排工错位.
samples.reference: Keep a defect's sub-item numbering consistent, or work split by number misaligns.
samples.hypothesis: The defect number should be consistent with the respective category, to avoid misalignment in arrangement by number.

samples.source: 可复跑的入口要登记在意图清单里，别只留在聊天记录。
samples.reference: Register a re-runnable entry in the intent table, not in chat history.
samples.hypothesis: The repeatable entry points should be recorded in the intention list, not just left in the chat history.

samples.source: 一次评测的输入与脚本一起入库，便于重放。
samples.reference: Commit an evaluation's inputs with its script, to allow replay.
samples.hypothesis: The input and script of a evaluation are stored together for easy replay.

samples.source: 测量结果要注明环境前提，跨机引用时不可省略。
samples.reference: Note environment preconditions; they are not optional in a cross-machine citation.
samples.hypothesis: The measurement results should indicate the environmental conditions, and cannot be omitted when referenced across machines.

samples.source: 文档的引用要指向能被他人跑起来的东西。
samples.reference: Cite things other people can actually run.
samples.hypothesis: The reference in the document should point to something that can be run by others.

samples.source: 一次修复要连带检查同一形状的其他位置。
samples.reference: After a fix, check for the same shape elsewhere in the tree.
samples.hypothesis: A fix requires checking other positions of the same shape as well.

samples.source: 语音闭环的耗时由分段、识别、翻译与合成四段串联而成。
samples.reference: The voice loop chains segmentation, recognition, translation and synthesis in series.
samples.hypothesis: The time required for speech round-trip consists of segmentation, recognition, translation, and synthesis.

samples.source: 识别错误会向翻译与合成传染，段级评估要独立跑。
samples.reference: Recognition errors propagate into translation and synthesis, so score segments independently.
samples.hypothesis: Translation and synthesis can be infected by recognition errors, and segment-level evaluation should be performed independently.

samples.source: 麦克风增益过高会让削波后的波形失去可识别性。
samples.reference: Excessive microphone gain pushes the waveform into clipping and ruins recognisability.
samples.hypothesis: Too high microphone gain can cause the clipping waveform to lose recognizability.

samples.source: 录音静音裁剪要在分段之后做，不能在波形上做能量阈值一刀切。
samples.reference: Trim silence after segmentation, not by a blanket energy threshold on the waveform.
samples.hypothesis: The silence cut and segmentation should be done after the segmentation, not by applying a uniform energy threshold on the waveform.

samples.source: 扬声器输出的音量归一化要放在编码前而不是编码后。
samples.reference: Normalise speaker output volume before encoding, not after.
samples.hypothesis: The volume normalization of the loudspeaker output should be done before encoding rather than after encoding.

samples.source: 播放头跨段跳变时要触发一次冲刷，避免残留上一段音频。
samples.reference: Flush the buffer when the playhead crosses a segment, or the previous audio lingers.
samples.hypothesis: When the playhead jumps across segments, a flush is triggered to prevent residual previous audio.

samples.source: 多说话人播客要先分流再分配合成通道。
samples.reference: Route multiple speakers apart before assigning synthesis channels.
samples.hypothesis: For multi-speaker podcasts, the stream needs to be split, then allocated, and finally synthesized into a channel.

samples.source: 语音链路的模型体积上限要按首装下载条件定。
samples.reference: Set the voice model size ceiling by first-install download conditions.
samples.hypothesis: The maximum size of the speech link model should be determined by the initial installation download conditions.

samples.source: 演示阶段的转写加翻译不能被称为同传。
samples.reference: A transcript plus translation in a demo must not be called simultaneous interpretation.
samples.hypothesis: The transcription and translation during the presentation stage cannot be called simultaneous translation.

samples.source: 合成侧的音色切换要在段边界生效，避免段内跳变。
samples.reference: Switch timbre at segment boundaries, not mid-segment.
samples.hypothesis: The speaker timbre switch on the synthesis side must take effect at segment boundaries to avoid jumps within the segments.

samples.source: 识别与翻译用同一语言代码集合，避免两侧口径分叉。
samples.reference: Share one set of language codes between recognition and translation, or the two diverge.
samples.hypothesis: Identify and translate using the same language code set to avoid divergent interpretations.

samples.source: 语音素材的采样率要与模型要求对齐。
samples.reference: Match voice material's sample rate to what the model expects.
samples.hypothesis: The sample rate of the speech material should be aligned with the model requirements.

samples.source: 分段策略改变会同时影响可懂度与延迟，需一起评估。
samples.reference: A segmentation change moves both intelligibility and latency, so judge them together.
samples.hypothesis: The change in segmentation strategy will affect both intelligibility and latency, and needs to be evaluated together.

samples.source: 合成失败时保留文本结果，不能连带丢弃转写。
samples.reference: Keep the text result when synthesis fails, rather than losing the transcript too.
samples.hypothesis: Keep the text result in case of synthesis failure; the transcription cannot be discarded.

samples.source: 端到端语音评测的样本要包含噪声与口音两种条件。
samples.reference: Voice evaluation samples must cover both noisy and accented conditions.
samples.hypothesis: Sample for end-to-end speech evaluation should include both noise and accent conditions.

samples.source: 声码器的选择影响自然度上限，与模型规模不完全同向。
samples.reference: A vocoder bounds naturalness, and not in lockstep with model size.
samples.hypothesis: The selection of the vocoder affects the upper limit of naturalness, which is not entirely consistent with the model size.

samples.source: 识别语言检测在中英混排素材上不稳定，需要按语段回退。
samples.reference: Language detection is unstable on mixed Chinese-English material, so fall back per segment.
samples.hypothesis: The language recognition is unstable on code-switching material, and needs to revert by speech segment.

samples.source: 模型量化到 int8 后体积下降明显，自然度损失要按任务测。
samples.reference: Int8 quantisation shrinks size; measure the naturalness cost per task.
samples.hypothesis: The volume decreases significantly after quantization to int8, and the naturalness loss needs to be measured per task.

samples.source: 链路里任何一段换模型，都要重跑端到端指标。
samples.reference: Rerun end-to-end metrics whenever any single model in the chain changes.
samples.hypothesis: Any segment in the link that changes to a model requires re-running the end-to-end metrics.

samples.source: 语音交付要能只给转写与字幕，不强制合成。
samples.reference: Allow delivery of transcript and subtitles without forcing synthesis.
samples.hypothesis: The speech delivery should only provide transcription and subtitle, without forcing synthesis.

samples.source: 离线语音包要能单独更新识别或合成一侧。
samples.reference: Let an offline voice package update recognition or synthesis independently.
samples.hypothesis: The offline speech package should allow for independent updating of recognition or synthesis.

samples.source: 说话人分离在重叠语音上会合并两人，需人工复核。
samples.reference: Speaker diarization merges two voices on overlap, so keep human review.
samples.hypothesis: Speaker diarization merges two individuals in overlapping speech, requiring manual review.

samples.source: 强制对齐的时间戳精度决定字幕可用性与配音定位。
samples.reference: Forced-alignment timestamp accuracy decides subtitle usability and dubbing placement.
samples.hypothesis: The precision of the forced alignment timestamp determines the availability of subtitle and dubbing positioning.

samples.source: 逆文本规整把口语数字转成书面形式，影响下游解析。
samples.reference: Inverse text normalization turns spoken numbers into written form, which downstream parsing depends on.
samples.hypothesis: Inverse text normalization converts spoken numbers into written form, which affects downstream parsing.

samples.source: 词表覆盖不足会让专名切成碎片，识别质量随之下降。
samples.reference: A thin vocabulary shreds proper nouns and drags recognition down.
samples.hypothesis: Insufficient vocabulary coverage will break up proper names, resulting in a decline in recognition quality.

samples.source: 半精度推理在部分硬件上不支持，需要回退路径。
samples.reference: Half-precision inference is unsupported on some hardware, so keep a fallback.
samples.hypothesis: Half precision inference is not supported on some hardware, so a fallback path is required.

samples.source: 模型权重的来源与许可要一并交付，不能只给文件。
samples.reference: Deliver a model's provenance and licence with the weights, not the file alone.
samples.hypothesis: The source and permissions of the model weights must be provided in the delivery, not just the files.

samples.source: 流式合成落地前，语音产品叙述只承诺转写与翻译。
samples.reference: Until streaming synthesis lands, voice product copy promises transcript and translation only.
samples.hypothesis: Before streaming synthesis is implemented, speech products only promise transcription and translation.

samples.source: 语音链路的评测要避免与常驻服务争用同一设备。
samples.reference: Keep voice evaluation off the device a resident service is using.
samples.hypothesis: Evaluating speech links should avoid competing with persistent services for the same device.

samples.source: 识别置信度低的段要在字幕里标注而非静默替换成猜测。
samples.reference: Flag low-confidence segments in subtitles rather than guessing silently.
samples.hypothesis: Mark the segments with low recognition confidence in the subtitle instead of silently replacing them with guesses.

samples.source: 音频格式转换要显式选择是否重采样并声明滤波器。
samples.reference: Make resampling and filter choice explicit in audio format conversion.
samples.hypothesis: Audio format conversion requires explicit selection of resampling and declaration of the filter.

samples.source: 语音模型的更新周期与产品发布周期不同步，要能独立升级。
samples.reference: Voice model updates land off the product release cycle, so allow independent upgrade.
samples.hypothesis: The update cycle of the speech model is not synchronized with the product release cycle, and it should be able to upgrade independently.

samples.source: 转写与译文要能分别导出，供不同下游使用。
samples.reference: Export transcript and translation separately for different downstream needs.
samples.hypothesis: The transcription and translation should be able to be exported separately for different downstream applications.

samples.source: 合成语速与字幕停留时长要共同满足阅读约束。
samples.reference: Match synthesis pace and subtitle dwell to one reading constraint.
samples.hypothesis: The combined speech pace and subtitle duration must meet the reading constraints together.

samples.source: 语音素材的时长统计要按有效语音段而非文件长度。
samples.reference: Measure voice material by active speech span, not file length.
samples.hypothesis: The duration statistics of speech materials should be based on valid speech segments rather than file length.

samples.source: 链路里的每段延迟都要单独可测，否则优化无据。
samples.reference: Make each stage's latency measurable, or optimisation has no basis.
samples.hypothesis: Each segment of the link latency must be individually measurable; otherwise, optimization has no basis.

samples.source: 模型体积与首次可用时间的权衡由产品场景决定。
samples.reference: Balance model size against time-to-first-use by product scenario.
samples.hypothesis: The trade-off between model size and first available time is determined by the product scenario.

samples.source: 语音交付的验收要在目标机型上做，而不是开发机。
samples.reference: Accept voice delivery on the target machine, not the development box.
samples.hypothesis: The acceptance of speech delivery should be carried out on the target model, not on the development machine.

samples.source: 语音闭环的失败要指出是哪一段失败，不整体报错.
samples.reference: Failures in the voice loop must name the failing stage, not the loop as a whole.
samples.hypothesis: Indicate which section causes the failure of the speech round-trip. Do not report an error for the whole system.

samples.source: 识别词表要能按客户领域追加，避免硬改模型。
samples.reference: Extend recognition vocabularies per customer domain instead of patching a model.
samples.hypothesis: The vocabulary for identification should be able to be expanded according to the customer's field, to avoid hardcoding the model.

samples.source: 合成产物要能保留参数记录，便于复现同一效果。
samples.reference: Keep synthesis parameters so the same result can be reproduced.
samples.hypothesis: The synthesis product should retain parameter records to facilitate reproducing the same effect.

samples.source: 语音链路的质量与延迟要在同一报表里对照呈现。
samples.reference: Show voice quality and latency side by side in one report.
samples.hypothesis: The quality of the speech link and latency should be presented in comparison in the same report.

samples.source: 模型清单要注明每个模型的许可、体积与获取方式。
samples.reference: List each model's licence, size and fetch method in the manifest.
samples.hypothesis: The model list should indicate the permissions, size, and acquisition methods for each model.

samples.source: 语音评测的语料许可要与产物许可一致，避免污染。
samples.reference: Keep voice evaluation corpora licence-compatible with the product.
samples.hypothesis: The corpus for speech evaluation should be consistent with the output to avoid contamination.

samples.source: 链路的可观测性要覆盖到每段起止时间。
samples.reference: Instrument start and end times for every stage of the chain.
samples.hypothesis: The observability of the link should cover the start and end times of each segment.

samples.source: 识别与合成的语言支持面要分别声明，不共用一个列表。
samples.reference: Declare recognition and synthesis language support separately, not as one list.
samples.hypothesis: The language support aspects for recognition and synthesis should be stated separately, without sharing a single list.

samples.source: 模型获取失败要给出可复制命令与校验和预期。
samples.reference: On a model fetch failure, print the copyable command and the expected digest.
samples.hypothesis: Provide a reproducible command and expected checksum when the model acquisition fails.

samples.source: 一次请求要能回读它走过的路径、耗时与最终引擎。
samples.reference: A request should read back the path it took, the time each stage spent and the engine that answered.
samples.hypothesis: A request should be able to read the path it took, the time taken, and the final engine.

samples.source: 健康检查要区分存活、就绪与忙碌三种状态。
samples.reference: A health check should separate alive, ready and busy rather than collapsing them.
samples.hypothesis: Health checks should distinguish between three states: alive, ready, and busy.

samples.source: 排队中的请求要计入可见指标，否则运维只能从时间推断。
samples.reference: Requests waiting in a queue need a visible metric, or operators can only infer them from timing.
samples.hypothesis: Requests in the queue should be counted in the visible metrics, otherwise operations and maintenance can only infer them from time.

samples.source: 超时配置要有上界，超出表示范围会直接断开而不是等更久。
samples.reference: A wait limit needs an upper bound; past the representable range it severs instead of waiting.
samples.hypothesis: The timeout configuration should have an upper limit; exceeding the range will cause immediate disconnection instead of waiting longer.

samples.source: 被放弃的请求要记账，因为它仍然消耗了一次真实计算。
samples.reference: Record abandoned requests, since they still consumed a real computation.
samples.hypothesis: Abandoned requests should be recorded, as they still consume a real computation.

samples.source: 一个建议等待时长要来自已完成工作的分位数，而不是平均值。
samples.reference: A suggested wait should come from a quantile of finished work, not from an average.
samples.hypothesis: The suggestion wait time should come from the median of completed tasks, not the average.

samples.source: 重启兜底要能被主动触发，而不是等它自己发生。

samples.source: 语音识别的置信度分数不能直接搬到翻译置信度上，两者校准曲线完全不同。
samples.reference: A speech recognition confidence score cannot be lifted directly into a translation confidence score; their calibration curves are entirely different.
samples.hypothesis: The speech recognition confidence score cannot be directly transferred to the translation confidence; their calibration curves are completely different.

samples.source: Kokoro 的中文男声 sid 45-52 中，52 混排表现最好，48 更贴近播音腔。
samples.reference: Among Kokoro's Mandarin voices at sid 45-52, 52 handles CJK/Latin code-switching best while 48 sits closer to a broadcast tone.
samples.hypothesis: In Kokoro's male voice sid 45-52, 52 provides the best mixed layout, while 48 is closer to the broadcasting tone.

samples.source: Whisper 类模型在长语音上会漂移，切片策略一般按 VAD 边界而不是固定 30 秒。
samples.reference: Whisper-style models drift on long audio, so the standard slicing policy follows VAD boundaries rather than a fixed 30 seconds.
samples.hypothesis: The Whisper model will drift over long speech, and the slicing strategy is generally based on VAD boundaries rather than a fixed 30-second interval.

samples.source: 流式 ASR 的因果性约束意味着当前的识别不能引用未来帧，与离线模型有本质差别。
samples.reference: The causality constraint in streaming ASR means the current hypothesis cannot look ahead to future frames -- a fundamental difference from offline models.
samples.hypothesis: The causal constraints of streaming ASR mean that current recognition cannot reference future frames, which is fundamentally different from offline models.

samples.source: 实时字幕的常见做法是稳定前缀 + 浮动后缀，让阅读体验不至于一句话改三遍。
samples.reference: Real-time subtitles usually stabilize the prefix and let the suffix float, so a single sentence is not rewritten three times for the reader.
samples.hypothesis: The common approach for real-time subtitle is using a stable prefix plus a floating suffix, ensuring the reading experience doesn't need to be changed three times for one sentence.

samples.source: 批量本地化任务往往跨夜跑，日志聚合与断言式失败必须能事后重放。
samples.reference: Batch localization jobs often run overnight, so log aggregation and assertion-style failures must be replayable after the fact.
samples.hypothesis: Batch localization tasks often run overnight, and log aggregation and assertion-based failures must be replayable later.

samples.source: 端到端语音翻译把 ASR、MT、TTS 融成一个模型，牺牲可解释性换更低延迟。
samples.reference: End-to-end speech translation collapses ASR, MT and TTS into a single model, trading interpretability for lower latency.
samples.hypothesis: End-to-end speech translation integrates ASR, MT, and TTS into a single model, sacrificing interpretability for lower latency.

samples.source: 语音采样率与位深决定了奈奎斯特频率上限，16 千赫兹的语音只能表达 8 千赫兹以下的成分。
samples.reference: The audio sample rate and bit depth set the Nyquist ceiling; 16 kHz speech can only carry content below 8 kHz.
samples.hypothesis: The sample rate and bit depth of the speech determine the Nyquist frequency limit, and 16 kHz of speech can only represent components below 8 kHz.

samples.source: 声码器负责把频谱反演回波形，Griffin-Lim 慢而糊，神经网络声码器快且清晰。
samples.reference: A vocoder inverts the spectrum back into a waveform -- Griffin-Lim is slow and muddy, while neural vocoders are fast and clean.
samples.hypothesis: The vocoder is responsible for reversing the spectrum back into a waveform. Griffin-Lim is slow and blurry, while the neural network vocoder is fast and clear.

samples.source: 基频 F0 的估计常用自相关或 YIN 算法，浊音段准，清音段本身就是噪声。
samples.reference: Fundamental-frequency estimation usually uses autocorrelation or YIN; both are accurate on voiced segments, but unvoiced segments are noise by definition.
samples.hypothesis: The estimation of the fundamental frequency F0 commonly uses autocorrelation or YIN algorithms. These methods are accurate for loud segments, while quiet segments are essentially noise.

samples.source: 倒谱系数取前 40 维已经足够覆盖大部分人耳可辨的频谱特征。
samples.reference: The first 40 cepstral coefficients already cover most of the spectral detail the human ear can distinguish.
samples.hypothesis: The first 40 dimensions of the cepstral coefficients are sufficient to cover the spectrum features that most people can hear.

samples.source: 立体声到单声道 down-mix 需要按能量归一而不是简单平均，不然左右声道的相位差会引入染色。
samples.reference: Down-mixing stereo to mono should normalize by energy rather than average samples, otherwise the phase difference between channels colors the output.
samples.hypothesis: Stereo to mono down-mix requires energy normalization rather than simple averaging, otherwise the phase difference between the left and right audio channels will introduce coloration.

samples.source: 静音压缩通过保留 VAD 判定的语音段来实现，会议录音可以省下 30% 到 50% 时长。
samples.reference: Silence compression keeps only the segments VAD flags as speech, saving 30 to 50 percent of the length on typical meeting recordings.
samples.hypothesis: Silence compression is achieved by retaining the speech segments identified by VAD, which can save 30% to 50% of the duration of the meeting recording.

samples.source: 重采样从 48 千赫兹降到 16 千赫兹要先做抗混叠低通滤波，不然高频会折叠进语音带。
samples.reference: Resampling from 48 kHz to 16 kHz must apply an anti-aliasing low-pass filter first, otherwise high frequencies fold into the speech band.
samples.hypothesis: The resampling from 48 kHz to 16 kHz requires a anti-alias low-pass filter, otherwise high frequencies will be folded into the speech band.

samples.source: 信噪比低于 10 分贝的现场录音通常要先做降噪再送 ASR。
samples.reference: Field recordings with a signal-to-noise ratio below 10 dB usually need denoising before being sent to ASR.
samples.hypothesis: A recording with a signal-to-noise ratio below 10 decibels usually requires noise reduction before being sent to ASR.

samples.source: 预加重滤波把高频抬起来，能让后续特征提取对小擦音更敏感。
samples.reference: Pre-emphasis filtering lifts high frequencies so that later feature extraction is more sensitive to weak fricatives.
samples.hypothesis: Pre-emphasis filtering raises the high frequencies, making the subsequent feature extraction more sensitive to minor noise.

samples.source: 分帧时常用的汉明窗能显著削弱矩形窗带来的吉布斯振铃。
samples.reference: A Hamming window is standard during framing and noticeably reduces the Gibbs ringing a rectangular window would introduce.
samples.hypothesis: The Hamming window commonly used during framing can significantly reduce the Gibbs ringing caused by rectangular windows.

samples.source: 帧率 25 fps 是影视的常规，50 fps 会让观众觉得 "太像新闻"。
samples.reference: A 25 fps frame rate is normal for film; 50 fps makes viewers feel it "looks too much like news footage".
samples.hypothesis: A frame rate of 25 fps is standard for films and TV shows, while 50 fps would make the audience feel "too like news."

samples.source: 位深度从 16 升到 24 位不会让响度更大，但动态范围与量化噪声显著改善。
samples.reference: Raising bit depth from 16 to 24 does not increase loudness but improves dynamic range and quantization noise noticeably.
samples.hypothesis: The increase in bit depth from 16 to 24 bits does not increase loudness, but significantly improves the dynamic range and quantization noise.

samples.source: 音画同步在编码链路上要留一个音视频缓冲差，视频通常比音频晚 20 毫秒。
samples.reference: Audio-video sync has to leave a small buffer skew in the encoding chain -- video is typically about 20 ms behind audio.
samples.hypothesis: Audio-video synchronization requires a buffer gap in the encoding chain, and video usually arrives 20 milliseconds later than audio.

samples.source: 声道布局从 5.1 下混到立体声要用 Dolby Pro Logic 而不是简单相加。
samples.reference: Down-mixing from 5.1 to stereo should use Dolby Pro Logic rather than a straight sum.
samples.hypothesis: The audio channel layout needs to switch from 5.1 downmix to stereo using Dolby Pro Logic instead of simple addition.

samples.source: 频谱质心、零过率、能量这三个特征就能把音乐与语音分开。
samples.reference: Spectral centroid, zero-crossing rate and energy are enough to separate music from speech.
samples.hypothesis: The centroid of the spectrum, zero rate, and energy are three features that can distinguish music from speech.

samples.source: 梅尔刻度是仿人耳感知非线性；线性刻度做 FFT 直接分箱不符合听觉心理。
samples.reference: The mel scale mirrors the non-linear frequency perception of human hearing; a linear FFT binning does not match psychoacoustics.
samples.hypothesis: Mell scale mimics human ear perception of non-linearity; linear scale with FFT direct binning does not conform to auditory psychology.

samples.source: 基音周期与共振峰是语音产生物理模型里最基础的两个概念。
samples.reference: Pitch period and formants are the two most basic concepts in the physical model of speech production.
samples.hypothesis: The fundamental frequency period and resonance peak are the two basic concepts in the physical model of speech production.

samples.source: 声纹识别与说话人分离是两回事：前者固定身份集合做识别，后者只做聚类不分身份。
samples.reference: Voiceprint recognition and speaker diarization are not the same: the first identifies a fixed set of speakers, the second only clusters without identities.
samples.hypothesis: Facial recognition and speaker diarization are two different things: the former identifies based on a fixed set of identities, while the latter only performs clustering without distinguishing identities.

samples.source: 音频缓冲不足会引发 dropout，视频缓冲不足会引发跳帧，两者表现不同但根因都是背压。
samples.reference: Insufficient audio buffering causes dropouts, insufficient video buffering causes frame skips -- different symptoms but the same root cause is backpressure.
samples.hypothesis: Insufficient audio buffering leads to dropout, while insufficient video buffering causes frame skipping. Although the symptoms are different, the root cause is backpressure.

samples.source: 流式协议里 chunk 与 packet 常被混用，但对时延统计而言是两个概念。
samples.reference: In streaming protocols chunk and packet are often used interchangeably, but for latency accounting they are two different concepts.
samples.hypothesis: In streaming protocols, chunk and packet are often used interchangeably, but they represent two different concepts when it comes to latency statistics.

samples.source: 抖动缓冲动态调整目标延迟，网络好时压到 20 毫秒，网络差时拉到 200 毫秒。
samples.reference: A jitter buffer dynamically retargets delay -- pushing it down to 20 ms when the network is good and stretching it to 200 ms when the network is bad.
samples.hypothesis: Jitter buffering adjusts the target latency dynamically, reaching 20 milliseconds when the network is good and 200 milliseconds when the network is poor.

samples.source: 流水线里任何一级的吞吐瓶颈都会把上游顶爆，反压信号必须能一路传回输入端。
samples.reference: Any throughput bottleneck in a pipeline will back up everything upstream, so the backpressure signal has to propagate all the way to the input.
samples.hypothesis: Any throughput bottleneck at any level of the pipeline will overload the upstream, and the backpressure signal must be able to reach the input terminal.

samples.source: TCP 的重传会破坏实时性，音视频低延迟场景普遍走 UDP 加前向纠错。
samples.reference: TCP retransmission ruins real-time behaviour; low-latency audio and video usually ride on UDP with forward error correction.
samples.hypothesis: TCP retransmissions will disrupt real-time performance, and low-latency audio and video scenarios typically use UDP with forward error correction.

samples.source: 关键帧间隔太长会让 seek 卡顿，太短会让相同画质下比特率翻倍。
samples.reference: Keyframes spaced too far apart make seeking stutter; too close and the bitrate doubles for the same quality.
samples.hypothesis: A too long keyframe interval can cause seek lag, while a too short one will double the bitrate under the same image quality.

samples.source: 分块处理时相邻块要有 50% 重叠，不然边界处的能量估计会跳变。
samples.reference: Chunked processing needs 50 percent overlap between adjacent chunks, otherwise the energy estimate jumps at the boundaries.
samples.hypothesis: During chunking, adjacent chunks must have a 50% overlap; otherwise, the energy estimation at the boundaries will jump.

samples.source: 冲刷操作的语义是 "把当前缓冲里的内容全部吐出去并结束本段"。
samples.reference: Flush means "emit everything currently in the buffer and terminate this segment".
samples.hypothesis: The semantics of the flush operation is "to discharge all the content in the current buffering and end this segment".

samples.source: 端到端流水线里背压没设计好时，最下游的消费者慢就整条链堵死。
samples.reference: If backpressure is not designed in an end-to-end pipeline, a slow consumer at the tail stalls the entire chain.
samples.hypothesis: When backpressure is not well designed in the end-to-end pipeline, the downstream consumer becomes slow, causing the entire chain to get stuck.

samples.source: 缓冲预取一般按帧数而不是按时长，因为帧才是模型的原子单位。
samples.reference: Buffer prefetch usually counts in frames, not in seconds, because a frame is the atomic unit of the model.
samples.hypothesis: Buffering prefetching is generally based on the number of frames rather than duration, as the frame is the atomic unit of the model.

samples.source: 流式合成的边界要落在词或短语之后，切在助词或连词中间会明显刺耳。
samples.reference: Streaming synthesis boundaries should land after a word or phrase; cutting at a particle or conjunction is audibly jarring.
samples.hypothesis: The boundary of streaming synthesis should be placed after a word or phrase, and cutting it between particles or conjunctions will sound harshly obvious.

samples.source: 数据报传输协议丢一两个包时解码器要能优雅丢帧而不是崩。
samples.reference: When the datagram transport protocol drops one or two packets, the decoder should gracefully conceal rather than crash.
samples.hypothesis: The datagram transmission protocol should allow the decoder to gracefully drop frames instead of failing.

samples.source: 恒定比特率适合广播，可变比特率适合存储；两者的缓冲模型完全不同。
samples.reference: Constant bitrate suits broadcast, variable bitrate suits storage -- their buffering models are completely different.
samples.hypothesis: Constant bitrate is suitable for broadcasting, while variable bitrate is suitable for storage; their buffering models are completely different.

samples.source: 容器只负责封装与同步，编解码器负责压缩；把 mkv 转成 mp4 不需要重编码。
samples.reference: The container only handles packaging and synchronisation; the codec handles compression. Turning an mkv into an mp4 needs no re-encoding.
samples.hypothesis: The container is only responsible for encapsulation and synchronization, while the codec handles compression; converting MKV to MP4 does not require re-encoding.

samples.source: 比特流的网络抽象层携带时序与合成信息，缺失会让解码器无法正确解码。
samples.reference: The network abstraction layer of the bitstream carries timing and composition information; missing it leaves the decoder unable to render correctly.
samples.hypothesis: The network abstraction layer of the bit stream carries timing and synthesis information; its absence will prevent the decoder from decoding correctly.

samples.source: 编码器要显式声明 profile 与 level，播放器据此判断能不能吃下这条流。
samples.reference: The encoder must declare its profile and level explicitly so the player can decide whether it can accept this stream.
samples.hypothesis: The encoder must explicitly declare the profile and level, and the player uses this information to determine whether it can handle the stream.

samples.source: 解复用就是把一个容器拆开成若干条音视频字幕轨，不做任何解码。
samples.reference: Demultiplexing means splitting a container into its video, audio and subtitle tracks without decoding anything.
samples.hypothesis: Unreleasement is the process of breaking down a container into several audio and video subtitle tracks without any decoding.

samples.source: 无损压缩对波形做熵编码，可以逐比特还原；有损压缩引入量化误差。
samples.reference: Lossless compression entropy-codes the waveform and can restore it bit-for-bit; lossy compression introduces quantization error.
samples.hypothesis: Lossless compression performs entropy coding on the waveform, allowing bit-by-bit restoration; lossy compression introduces quantization errors.

samples.source: 转码时如果源和目标编解码器不同，一定要经过帧缓冲重排。
samples.reference: Transcoding between different source and target codecs must go through a frame buffer for reorder.
samples.hypothesis: During transcoding, if the source and target codec are different, it is necessary to perform buffering rearrangement.

samples.source: 帧内预测只依赖当前帧，帧间预测要引用参考帧，二者的错误传播特性不同。
samples.reference: Intra-frame prediction depends only on the current frame; inter-frame prediction references other frames, and the two propagate errors differently.
samples.hypothesis: Intra-frame prediction relies only on the current frame, while inter-frame prediction requires referencing a reference frame. Their error propagation characteristics are different.

samples.source: 运动估计的搜索半径越大越精确但也越慢，默认 16 像素是常见折中。
samples.reference: A larger motion-estimation search radius is more accurate but slower; 16 pixels is the common default.
samples.hypothesis: The larger the motion estimation search radius, the more accurate it is but also slower. A common compromise is 16 pixels by default.

samples.source: 熵编码用霍夫曼或算术编码；算术编码效率略高但专利与复杂度都是负担。
samples.reference: Entropy coding uses Huffman or arithmetic coding -- the latter is slightly more efficient but carries patent and complexity overhead.
samples.hypothesis: Entropy coding uses Huffman or arithmetic coding; arithmetic coding has slightly higher efficiency but involves patents and complexity issues.

samples.source: 码率控制要感知内容，静态场景压低码率，运动场景放开码率。
samples.reference: Rate control should be content-aware: lower bitrate for static scenes, higher bitrate for motion-heavy scenes.
samples.hypothesis: Rate control should adapt to the content, lowering the rate in static scenes and increasing it in dynamic scenes.

samples.source: AVC、HEVC、VVC 每一代同画质下比特率大致降一半，复杂度大约翻倍。
samples.reference: Each generation from AVC to HEVC to VVC roughly halves the bitrate for the same quality but doubles the complexity.
samples.hypothesis: AVC, HEVC, and VVC: At the same image quality, the bitrate is approximately halved, while complexity is roughly doubled.

samples.source: Opus 在 6 到 512 千比特率之间自适应，是互联网语音的默认选择。
samples.reference: Opus adapts between 6 and 512 kbps and is the default choice for voice on the internet.
samples.hypothesis: Opus adapts between 6 and 512 kbitrate, and is the default choice for internet speech.

samples.source: FLAC 无损压缩率大约 5:1，适合母带归档；MP3 是有损，别用来做二压。
samples.reference: FLAC compresses losslessly around 5:1 and is suited to archiving masters; MP3 is lossy and should never be secondarily compressed.
samples.hypothesis: FLAC has a lossless compression ratio of approximately 5:1, making it suitable for master file archiving; MP3 is lossy, so it should not be used for secondary compression.

samples.source: 视频字幕要处理换行宽度、字符编码与字体缺字三个独立问题。
samples.reference: Video subtitles have to handle three independent problems: line-width wrapping, character encoding and missing glyphs.
samples.hypothesis: The video subtitle needs to address three distinct issues: line break width, character encoding, and missing characters in fonts.

samples.source: SubRip 只有时间轴与文本两栏，样式能力弱；ASS 有事件与样式两栏，能表达卡拉OK。
samples.reference: SubRip only has timing and text fields, weak styling; ASS adds event and style sections and can express karaoke effects.
samples.hypothesis: SubRip has only two columns: timeline and text, with weak styling capabilities; ASS has two columns: events and styles, and can express karaoke content.

samples.source: WebVTT 是 W3C 定义的网页字幕格式，天然与 HTML5 播放器对接。
samples.reference: WebVTT is the W3C-defined subtitle format for the web and slots straight into HTML5 players.
samples.hypothesis: WebVTT is a web subtitle format defined by the W3C, and it naturally integrates with HTML5 players.

samples.source: 逐字时间戳需要强制对齐输出，纯 ASR 只有段级时间戳。
samples.reference: Word-level timestamps require forced-alignment output; ASR alone only provides segment-level timing.
samples.hypothesis: The word-level timestamp needs to be output with forced alignment, while pure ASR only has segment-level timestamp.

samples.source: 字幕断行要按语义而不是按字符数：把 "声画同步" 拆到两行会破坏阅读。
samples.reference: Subtitle line breaks should follow meaning rather than character count; splitting "audio-video sync" across two lines wrecks readability.
samples.hypothesis: Subtitle line breaks should be based on semantics rather than character count: splitting "audio-video sync" into two lines will disrupt readability.

samples.source: 硬字幕化流程 = 抽帧、烧字、重编码；每一步都可能引入代际损失。
samples.reference: Burning in subtitles means extracting frames, drawing captions and re-encoding -- each step can add a generation of loss.
samples.hypothesis: Subtitle hardcoding process = frame extraction, burned-in subtitle, re-encoding; each step may introduce generational loss.

samples.source: 对口型算法在真人上主要看嘴部关键点，在动画上要看帧与语音能量包络。
samples.reference: Lip-sync algorithms track mouth keypoints on real people and match frame-by-frame energy envelopes on animation.
samples.hypothesis: The lip sync algorithm focuses on the mouth key points in real people, while for animations, it depends on the frame and speech energy envelope.

samples.source: 配音时原声要压低 12 分贝做 ducking，不然观众听不清配音。
